title: DAT DevOps Engineer
description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  

We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

In this position...

Ford’s ADAS DevOps Team is looking for a DevOps Engineer to help build and operate the platforms and pipelines that support advanced driver-assistance systems software and tooling.

In this role, you’ll focus on reliable, secure, and scalable CI/CD automation—with an emphasis on GitHub Actions, large-scale C/C++ build systems, and Bazel. You’ll partner with software and infrastructure teams to improve build performance, streamline development workflows, and support safety-critical engineering.

What you'll do...

Design, build, and operate enterprise-scale CI/CD platforms supporting ADAS software development.

Develop, maintain, and optimize GitHub Actions workflows for C/C++, Python, and multi-language build pipelines.

Support and improve Bazel-based build systems, including build performance, caching, and CI integration.

Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

Build, maintain, and deploy Docker containers and support Kubernetes-based workloads.

Partner with software engineers to integrate CI/CD best practices into C/C++ development workflows.

Improve reliability and observability of CI/CD systems through monitoring, logging, and alerting.

Collaborate with cross-functional ADAS teams to remove DevOps, build, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

Implement secure CI/CD practices including secrets management, artifact signing, and access controls.

You'll have...

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

2+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.

Hands-on, production experience with GitHub Actions for building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

2+ years of experience with Docker-based containerization.

2+ years of experience with Linux fundamentals

2+ years of experience with scripting Python

2+ years of experience working with C and/or C++ codebases and build tooling.

Strong communication skills and ability to work across diverse engineering teams.

Even better, you may have...

Experience building CI/CD pipelines for large mono-repos or multi-repo environments.

Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure automation.

Strong experience supporting Bazel build systems in CI environments.

Working knowledge of Kubernetes deployments and operational patterns.

Experience with build optimization techniques such as remote caching and parallelization in Bazel.

Familiarity with backend services or APIs built in Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).

Experience implementing CI/CD observability, metrics, and alerting.

Experience operating workloads on public cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

Interest or familiarity with ADAS, embedded systems, robotics, or autonomous vehicle software.

Experience with self-hosted GitHub Actions runners.

Exposure to SRE practices and reliability engineering.

Experience supporting ML or data-intensive CI workflows.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage

* Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more

* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases

* Tuition assistance

* Established and active employee resource groups

* Paid time off for individual and team community service

* A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day

* Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 7 and ranges from $99,600-$166,600.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

title: Cloud/DevOps Engineer
description:
Do you want to support the technology emergency dispatchers rely on when every second counts? Join a team building solutions that make a real difference for public safety professionals around the world!

This role is eligible for our full host of benefits such as health, dental, vision, pet, and legal insurance, PTO, company contributions to a 401K and more while working in an award winning workplace culture. Come see why our teams love working here! This role is based in Salt Lake City, UT and has a hybrid work model.

**Job Summary:**  
The Cloud/DevOps Engineer helps design, build, and support the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines behind our public safety software products, including ProQA, QA products, and other platforms. This role focuses on Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and CI/CD automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions. This role partners closely with development, QA, and security teams to ensure our mission-critical applications—including ProQA 24/7/365 service supporting emergency call centers—are deployed safely, monitored effectively, and supported through a sustainable on-call rotation. This position reports to the Information Systems Manager and plays a key role in scaling our DevOps practices as our product portfolio grows. This role works on a hybrid schedule based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Terraform, Azure cloud security best practices, and building reliable, secure, and repeatable deployment pipelines.

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure to support ProQA, AQUA, and other products.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to provision, version, and manage cloud resources consistently across environments.
* Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions to automate testing, builds, and deployments.
* Implement and enforce Azure cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), network security, and secrets management.
* Monitor production systems and participate in an on-call rotation to support ProQA 24/7/365 always-on service for emergency call center customers.
* Automate deployment, scaling, and recovery processes to reduce manual intervention and improve system reliability.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to integrate security and reliability practices into the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Support containerization and orchestration efforts, including Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), as needed.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues across cloud environments.
* Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and on-call runbooks to support knowledge sharing.
* Stay current with evolving Azure services, DevOps tooling, and cloud security practices, recommending improvements where appropriate.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–5 years of experience in a Cloud/DevOps engineering role or related technical position.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including core compute, networking, and storage services.
* Experience writing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Working knowledge of Azure cloud security practices, including IAM, role-based access control (RBAC), network security, and secrets management.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Scripting experience (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, or Python) for automation and tooling.
* Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker; experience with Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is a plus.
* Experience supporting production systems, including participation in an on-call rotation.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, QA, and security teams.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate) preferred.

**Essential Job Functions/Physical Requirements:**

* Designing, building, and maintaining cloud infrastructure while implementing security best practices
* Monitors production systems, automates deployment, and provides after hours support as needed
* Maintaining clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and on-call runbooks
* Ability to multi-task technical problems efficiently
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both users and programmers effectively.
* Problem-solving
* Frequent computer and telephone use
* Sitting for long periods of time
* Concentrating for long periods of time.
Occasional travel of less than 5% (training) may be required.  

**Our Company:** Priority Dispatch Corp. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are a small, fast-growing provider of consulting, training, and software products for the public safety market. Priority Dispatch is based in the U.S. in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and matching 401(k) programs, etc. Priority Dispatch Corp. (PDC) provides comprehensive, integrated solutions for Police, Fire, and Medical emergency dispatching. We incorporate the Priority Dispatch System® approved by the International Academies of Emergency Dispatch in all our products. PDC offers multi-agency emergency dispatching ProQA® software, as well as a card-set version, AQUA® quality improvement software, training, consulting, and Academy accreditation support. www.prioritydispatch.net

title: Data Engineer-Scientist | Federal/DoD
description:
**Data Engineer/Scientist**  
Onsite | **Fort Belvoir, Virginia** | **IAT Level II Required**  
**No Relocation-**

***If you want to design and build secure, scalable data pipelines that support advanced analytics and emerging technologies within a DoD research environment, we would love to talk.***

**Why This Role Exists**  
*The work we do has real impact, and the people behind it matter just as much.*

D&G is seeking a **Data Engineer/Data Scientist** to support the Defense Logistics Agency’s Applied Research and Testing Emerging Technologies (ARTET) program. This role focuses on building and maintaining modern data pipelines, integrating enterprise datasets, and enabling analytics initiatives within a secure DoD environment.

This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving data integration challenges, improving data quality, and supporting analytics teams with clean, reliable, well-structured data.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured datasets.
* Integrate data from enterprise systems including ERP platforms, operational databases, and legacy systems.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries and data models to support analytics and reporting needs.
* Implement data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes to ensure data integrity.
* Support cloud or hybrid data environments (AWS, Azure, Google).
* Collaborate with analysts and developers to define data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Support AI/ML initiatives by preparing and structuring datasets for downstream model development.
* Contribute to documentation of data architecture, workflows, and security compliance practices.
* Troubleshoot performance and data issues and implement corrective solutions.

**What We Are Looking For**

*Required*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
* 5+ years of experience building and supporting data pipelines in enterprise environments.
* Strong SQL proficiency and experience with relational databases.
* Experience developing ETL/ELT processes and working with structured and unstructured data.
* Experience with Python or similar scripting language.
* Experience working in secure Federal or DoD environments.
* **IAT Level II certification (DoD 8570/8140 compliant)- 100% REQUIRED**

  
*Preferred*

* Experience with cloud data services (Google, AWS Redshift, RDS, EMR, Azure Data Services, etc.).
* Experience supporting AI/ML data preparation workflows.
* Familiarity with distributed processing frameworks (Spark, Kafka, etc.).

title: Data Engineer I - Data Platform
description:
Overview:

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): North Carolina, Arizona, Florida and Texas.

We are seeking a motivated **Data Engineer** to join our **Data Platform Engineering Organization** and help build scalable cloud-based data solutions that enable analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineer with experience in cloud-based data platforms, data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and modern data engineering practices. This individual will contribute to the development and support of scalable data pipelines, integrations, and data products utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related technologies.  
  
As part of our growing Cloud Data & AI Platform organization, you will collaborate with a talented team of engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders to modernize enterprise data platforms and deliver cloud-based data solutions that support critical business initiatives. This is an opportunity to work with modern technologies, solve complex data challenges, and contribute to the bank's data and AI transformation journey.

**Duties and Responsibilities**:

The successful candidate will thrive in a collaborative environment, possess problem-solving skills, and be passionate about building reliable, scalable, and high-quality data solutions.

  

* Design, build, and support scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
* Implement data warehouse solutions, dimensional data models, and ETL/ELT processes that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence capabilities.
* Implement data quality validations, test cases, and controls to ensure accurate, consistent, and reliable data assets.
* Develop and maintain data tests, including dbt tests, to support data quality and reliability requirements.
* Support workflow orchestration, monitoring, troubleshooting, log analysis, and production operations using Airflow and cloud-native technologies.
* Collaborate with business users, product partners, analysts, and technology teams to deliver data solutions that support business objectives.
* Follow established engineering standards, development practices, documentation requirements, and testing procedures to support high-quality solution delivery.
* Participate in pipeline deployments, environment promotion activities, operational support, and performance optimization efforts using established CI/CD processes.
* Leverage AI-powered development and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency, code quality, and delivery outcomes.

**Qualifications****:**

Bachelor's Degree and 1 year experience

OR

High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 5 years' experience

**Preferred Area of Study**: Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field

**Preferred Area of Experience**: Data engineering, database management, or related field. Experience with cloud-based data platforms and big data technologies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with enterprise ETL/ELT tools such as DataStage, SAP BODS, SSIS, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Operational Data Stores (ODS), analytics platforms, and data products.
* Experience working with cloud-based and on-premises data environments.
* Exposure to Data Vault modeling and modern data warehousing methodologies.
* Understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and data quality management practices.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, or other highly regulated industries.
* Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or other analytics and visualization platforms.
* Experience using AI-powered development and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency and delivery outcomes.
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, SnowPro Core Certification, or equivalent cloud and data platform certifications.

#LI-DNI

title: Analytics Platform Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We’re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.  
  
As a member of the Huron corporate team, you’ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.  
  
Join our team and create your future.

The Data Forge team is seeking an Analytics Platform Engineer to help design, build, and operate Huron's enterprise cloud data platform. This role will focus on developing scalable data and analytics solutions within AWS, automating platform capabilities, and improving the reliability, performance, and usability of the platform.  
The ideal candidate is passionate about engineering, automation, and problem solving. They enjoy building services, developing Python applications, working with cloud-native technologies, and improving the developer experience for teams consuming the platform.

**What You'll Do**

**Platform Engineering**

* Design, develop, and maintain platform services supporting data ingestion, transformation, analytics, and reporting.
* Build reusable Python-based frameworks, utilities, and automation tools used across multiple product teams.
* Develop platform capabilities that enable rapid onboarding of datasets and analytics workloads.
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

**Data Engineering & Analytics**

* Develop and maintain data pipelines supporting ingestion and processing of enterprise data.
* Build and optimize ETL/ELT solutions using Python, Spark, and AWS services.
* Support data lake architecture and modernization initiatives.
* Work with structured and semi-structured data including Parquet, Iceberg, JSON, and relational datasets.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Automation**

* Develop Infrastructure-as-Code and platform automation solutions.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment frameworks.
* Implement monitoring, observability, and operational tooling.
* Automate platform provisioning, configuration, and service onboarding.

**Developer Experience & Platform Operations**

* Create tooling, templates, and frameworks that simplify platform adoption.
* Troubleshoot complex platform and data issues.
* Help establish engineering best practices around testing, deployment, security, and maintainability.
* Contribute to platform standards and architecture decisions.

**Emerging Technology & AI**

* Explore and implement AI-enabled solutions that improve platform capabilities and developer productivity.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation and machine learning within platform workflows.
* Evaluate new cloud services and analytics technologies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics, or related field.
* 2-5 years of software engineering, data engineering, or platform engineering experience.
* Strong Python development skills with experience building production-grade applications and automation.
* Hands-on experience developing solutions in AWS.
* Experience working with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, ECS, Step Functions, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Experience building and supporting data pipelines and cloud-native applications.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience with Git-based source control and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working within Agile development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing.
* Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or modern data lake architectures.
* Experience building Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience developing APIs, platform services, or internal developer tooling.
* Experience implementing monitoring, observability, and operational automation.
* AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect, Developer, or Data Engineer.
* Experience supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning, or AI workloads.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps and GitHub Enterprise.

**Technologies You'll Work With**

* Python
* AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, ECS, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
* Apache Spark
* SQL
* Apache Iceberg
* GitHub & CI/CD Pipelines
* Terraform / Infrastructure-as-Code
* Data Lake & Analytics Platforms

**What Success Looks Like**

* Building reusable platform services that accelerate onboarding and delivery.
* Automating manual operational processes.
* Improving platform reliability, observability, and scalability.
* Delivering engineering solutions used by multiple analytics and product teams.
* Helping evolve Data Forge into a modern, self-service cloud analytics platform.

The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. title: Data Engineer, Amazon Music, Amazon Music Finance
description:
**Description**
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.
  
  
The Data, Insights, Science and Optimization, Finance (DISCO Finance) team is looking for a Data Engineer to join a team of Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Data Engineers who analyze data at scale and build the models and algorithms that power the Music product experience. DISCO Finance accelerates Amazon Music customer growth by empowering Product teams to make customer-centric decisions through data and insights. We build the data pipelines, self-service analytics, and predictive models that enable acquisition, engagement, and retention at scale.
  
  
In this role, you will design, build, and own the data infrastructure and pipelines that power the team's analytics and science, and partner with stakeholders across marketing, growth, product, science, and finance to scale those capabilities. The ideal candidate builds reliable large-scale data solutions, prioritizes across competing stakeholders and projects, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with cross-functional teams — data scientists and Finance managers — to architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS using the Cloud Development Kit (CDK).
* Build resilient, scalable data pipelines with SQL, PySpark, and Airflow to ingest, process, and transform large data volumes from diverse sources into structured, high-quality datasets.
* Design and implement a scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using the appropriate NoSQL and SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data.
* Build a consolidated data model that serves as the single source of truth, so metric logic is defined and changed once rather than patched across disconnected jobs.
* Automate ETL and ELT processes to streamline data integration across sources and improve platform reliability and efficiency.
* Own the business intelligence layer end to end: build the data models, metrics, dashboards, and interactive reports that deliver actionable insights to Finance managers and other end users.
* Build AI and generative AI infrastructure that automates recurring Finance reporting and process work, using tools such as EMR and SageMaker to extract predictive and prescriptive insights.
* Build AI agents and agentic infrastructure that let Finance managers self-serve their questions and analytics, reducing ad hoc reporting requests.
* Build KPI and ETL job-monitoring systems with freshness SLAs, anomaly detection, and lineage tracking, so business-critical reports arrive on time and data access stays low-latency for analytics and machine learning.
* Partner with the central infrastructure team to drive infrastructure enhancements for Finance-specific use cases.
* Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to protect sensitive information.
* Work closely with data scientists and Finance managers to understand their reporting and analytics requirements and translate them into platform capabilities.
* Produce clear technical documentation covering the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to support knowledge sharing and maintainability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Data Engineer II (dbt, AWS)
description:
**Who Are We?**
Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.
  
  
**Compensation Overview**
The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.
  
  
**Salary Range**
$126,500.00 - $208,700.00
  
  
**Target Openings**
1
  
  
**What Is the Opportunity?**
Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in growing and transforming our analytics landscape. In addition to your strong analytical mind, you will bring your inquisitive attitude and ability to translate stories found in data by leveraging a variety of data programming techniques. You will leverage your ability to design, build and deploy data solutions that capture, explore, transform, and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights.
  
  
**What Will You Do?**

* Build and operationalize complex data solutions, correct problems, apply transformations, and recommending data cleansing/quality solutions.
* Design complex data solutions
* Perform analysis of complex sources to determine value and use and recommend data to include in analytical processes.
* Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality.
* Collaborate within and across teams to support delivery and educate end users on complex data products/analytic environment.
* Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution for complex defects and incidents and correct as appropriate.
* Test data movement, transformation code, and data components.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?**

* Eight years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience building ETL pipelines using tools such as AWS , dbt or any other ETL tool
* Understanding of AWS cloud services and data architecture patterns (S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch)
* Experience with data modeling techniques (star/snowflake schema) and data warehouse design principles
* Nice to Have: Experience with Ab Initio for enterprise-scale ETL development is a plus
* Strong delivery skills including the ability to determine the software design strategy and methodology to be used for efforts, use automated tests, analysis, and informed feedback loops to ensure the quality and production readiness of work before release, monitor the health of work efforts and that of adjacent systems..
* Strong problem solver who utilizes data and proofs of concepts to find creative solutions to difficult problems involving a significant number of factors with broad implications, reflects on solutions, measures impact, and uses that information to ideate and optimize.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to develop business partnerships, describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives in a concise and clear manner, and empathetically and attentively listen to other thoughts and ideas.

**What is a Must Have?**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
* 4 additional years of data engineering experience.

**What Is in It for You?**

* Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
* Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
* Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
* Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
* Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

**Employment Practices**
Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.
  
  
In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.
  
  
If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.
  
  
Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.
  
  
To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Data Engineer**
**“The Company does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S.”**
**About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.**
At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon-quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers.
  
  
**About The Role**
***This is a hybrid position working from our Legacy West Support Center in Plano, Texas.***
The Data Engineer is responsible for supporting the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise data solutions on the Data Bricks Lake House Platform. This role works closely with senior Data Engineers, Data Architects, Analytics Engineers, and business stakeholders to develop data pipelines, transform and validate data, and support reporting, analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) initiatives. The Data Engineer I will participate in the implementation of modern cloud-based data solutions while developing technical expertise in data engineering best practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
* Build ETL/ELT processes utilizing Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.
* Design and implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
* Develop batch and streaming data ingestion pipelines from enterprise systems, APIs, and cloud platforms.
* Build reusable data transformation frameworks using PySpark and SQL.
* Optimize Spark jobs and Delta Lake tables for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Configure and support Unity Catalog for data governance, security, and lineage.
* Develop workflows using Databricks Workflows and Jobs.
* Support Change Data Capture (CDC) and incremental data processing.
* Build semantic data models supporting reporting, analytics, AI, and machine learning.
* Implement automated testing, monitoring, and alerting for data pipelines.
* Create technical documentation, metadata, and operational standards.
* Research and recommend new technologies and platform enhancements

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Amazon S3, or similar cloud storage platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (Azure preferred).
* Experience supporting enterprise analytics platforms such as Power BI.
* Retail, merchandising, supply chain, or eCommerce experience preferred.

**Competencies & attributes**

* Databricks Lakehouse Platform
* Delta Lake and Delta Live Tables (DLT)
* Unity Catalog
* Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
* ETL/ELT Pipeline Development
* Data Modeling and Data Warehousing
* Lakehouse Architecture
* SQL Development and Performance Optimization
* Python Programming
* REST API and Enterprise System Integration
* Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) or Cloud Object Storage
* Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform
* Business Intelligence and Analytics Support
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
* Strong Written and Verbal Communication
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Planning, Organization, and Time Management
* Results-Oriented with Strong Attention to Detail

**Working Conditions & Physical Requirements**

* The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts which require normal safety precautions typical of such places as offices, meeting and training rooms, retail stores, and residences or commercial vehicles, e.g., use of safe work practices with office equipment, avoidance of trips and falls, observance of fire regulations and traffic signals, etc. The work area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated.
* The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work. However, there may be some walking; standing; bending; carrying of light items such as papers, files, books, small parts; using a keyboard, driving an automobile, etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

**Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary and outstanding benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, paid vacation and sick days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement and 401(k) with company match. In addition, associates of SBH may take advantage of our in-house salon with complementary services and a varied selection of food options at our corporate campus. Also, featured at our corporate campus, is both a Sally Beauty and CosmoProf Professional onsite store, where associates enjoy a great merchandise discount!

title: Data Engineer - Mid-Level
description:

BAE Systems is seeking a Data Engineer to support our work as a prime contractor on a high-profile U.S. Navy weapon system. This is a unique opportunity to be part of the team enabling our Nation’s technological superiority on strategic missions through development of advanced concepts and initiatives throughout the systems lifecycle.
  
  
This position is both an internal and customer facing position and responsible for supporting the roll out and implementation of a new data engineering solutions to support Navy functions. In this role, you will plan and coordinate the preparation of project documentation, such as business process maps, training, job aids, schedules, and presentations, to ensure the data engineering solutions meet internal BAE Systems and customer requirements. You will engage with Navy customers and coordinate with the internal BAE Systems technical team to design, implement, and tailor the developed solutions that may be based on COTS or GOTS technology. In this position, you will perform data engineering, data pipeline building, business process mapping, technical analysis, trade studies, research, development, and test and evaluation to enable quality management and business process system implementation. You will help resolve issues and make recommendations regarding enhanced capabilities for the proposed COTS / GOTS data engineering solutions. You will analyze proposed changes of product design to determine effect on overall product and system and coordinate modification for management control.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver data engineering Design and implement scalable data pipelines that support AI/ML applications, leveraging techniques such as data warehousing, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), and data streaming.

* Conduct feature engineering and feature selection to optimize data for AI/ML model development
* Work closely with Data Solution Architects and AI/ML Developers to prepare data for analytics and modeling tasks
* Implement data pipelines enabling retrieval of data from federated data systems
* Implement monitoring systems to ensure data pipeline reliability and performance
* Implement algorithms required to perform data engineering functions
* Implement data quality checks and monitoring processes
* Stay updated on best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering

Typical education and years of related/relevant experience required: Bachelor’s Degree and minimum of 4 years of proven experience supporting DoD programs or large-scale weapon systems; or Master’s Degree and minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.
  
  
  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related STEM field
* 4+ years of experience in data engineering or a similar role
* Strong understanding of the Data Engineering process
* Proficiency with data modeling notations

* Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, JSON/XML, structured and unstructured query languages, and Jupyter Notebooks)
* Experience with ETL/TS tools and frameworks
* Experience with data analytics, data mining, and statistical analysis
* Experience with data warehousing solutions and technologies, including RedShift, BigQuery, and Snowflake
* Familiarity with big data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka
* Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills

However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

description:
**About Us:**
Camber builds software to improve the quality and accessibility of healthcare. We streamline and replace manual work so clinicians can focus on what they do best: providing great care. For more details on our thesis, check out our write-up: What is Camber?
  
  
We’ve raised $50M in funding from phenomenal supporters at a16z, Craft Ventures, YCombinator, Manresa, and many others who are committed to improving the accessibility of care. For more information, take a look at: Announcing Camber
  
  
**About our Culture:**
Our mission to change behavioral health starts with us and how we operate. We don’t want to just change behavioral health, we want to change the way startups operate. Here are a few tactical examples:
  
  

* Improving accessibility and quality of healthcare is something we live and breathe. Everyone on Camber’s team cares deeply about helping clinicians and patients.
* We have to have a sense of humor. Healthcare is so broken, it's depressing if you don't laugh with us.

**About the role:**
At Camber, we’re building systems that actually work for clinicians—because healthcare deserves better software. As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll be hands-on with the backbone of that system: the infrastructure and pipelines that keep everything flowing smoothly, scalably, and reliably.
  
  
This role isn’t just about writing great code (though that’s part of it). It’s about helping us make smart decisions as we scale, both technically and strategically. You’ll partner closely with other engineers, analysts, and product teams to build data systems we can trust, evolve, and understand. You’ll also be a mentor and be a thought partner as we grow the team.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Design and build a platform that is reliable, observable, and scalable.
* Drive the strategy behind our data architecture and tooling.
* Collaborate across the company with product, reporting, and platform teams to deliver the right data at the right time.
* Level up the organization by mentoring other engineers, establishing best practices, and contributing to a high-trust culture.
* Deliver incremental improvements, especially when things feel ambiguous or messy
* Stay adaptable and flexible. We’re a startup, and that means things change fast!

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience: 6+ years of experience in data engineering or adjacent backend roles
* Relevant background: Proven success building and scaling data pipelines, platform, and infrastructure
* Technical expertise: Deep knowledge of AWS and open-source data tools (e.g. Spark, Iceberg, Kafka, dbt, etc.)
* Comfortable balancing speed and quality: You know when to build a prototype and when to build for scale
* Excellent communication: You can drive communication and prioritization with other internal teams to determine their data tooling needs.
* Technical mentorship: You can help set the vision, explain technical decisions clearly, and bring others along.

**Nice to have:**

* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred).
* Prior experience working in a regulated environment (e.g., healthcare, finance).

**Perks & Benefits at Camber:**

* Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with nationwide coverage, including 24/7 virtual urgent care.
* Mental Health Support: Weekly therapy reimbursement up to $100, so you can prioritize the care that works best for you.
* Paid Parental Leave: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid time off for new parents (birth, adoption, or foster care).
* Financial Wellness: 401K (traditional & Roth), HSA & FSA options, and monthly commuter benefits for NYC employees.
* Time Off That Counts: We offer flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.
* Fitness Stipend: $100/month to use on fitness however you choose.
* Hybrid Flexibility: In NYC? We work in the office 3–5x/week, with flexibility when life happens. Fridays are remote-friendly.

Camber is based in New York City, and we prioritize in-person and hybrid candidates. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location.
  
  
*Building an inclusive culture is one of our core tenets as a company. We’re very aware of structural inequalities that exist, and recognize that underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply for a role if they don’t think they meet all of the requirements. If that’s you and you’re reading this, we’d like to encourage you to apply regardless — we’d love to get to know you and see if there’s a place for you here!*
*In addition, we take security seriously, and all of our employees contribute to uphold security requirements and maintain compliance with HIPAA security regulations.*

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Alchemy**
Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.
  
  
Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.
  
  
**The Role**
Build and run the internal data platform that helps Alchemy understand product usage, revenue, and the cost of serving customers. The existing Data Engineer intake centers on ingestion, Snowflake operations, workflow orchestration, data quality, and collaboration with analytics partners.
  
  
You will own ingestion, schema changes, and checks that show whether shared datasets are current and correct. You will work with analytics engineers and data scientists to define those datasets for reporting, analysis, and AI-assisted tools.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build batch and streaming pipelines that connect operational databases, product events, billing systems, and external sources to the internal data platform.
* Make ingestion recoverable through change-data capture, schema-change handling, idempotent processing, and safe backfills.
* Operate and improve Snowflake, including access controls, workload management, query performance, and compute and storage costs.
* Improve orchestration and deployment workflows so engineers can test, ship, and debug pipelines safely.
* Build data-quality checks that detect stale, missing, duplicated, or inconsistent records before they reach downstream consumers.
* Work with analytics partners on shared data models, source definitions, and documentation. Make dataset ownership and upstream dependencies clear.
* Reduce recurring manual work and build reusable tools for self-service data access.
* Participate in production support and incident response for pipelines and the data platform. Restore data flow, reconcile affected datasets, and fix the causes of recurring failures.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience independently building and operating production data pipelines and the infrastructure around them.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, including testing, debugging, and maintainable software design.
* Experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, including performance tuning and access management.
* Experience with workflow orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow and dbt, or equivalent systems.
* Understanding of data modeling, incremental processing, schema evolution, and data-quality testing.
* The ability to trace a data discrepancy from a downstream report back to its source, explain the cause, and fix it.
* Good judgment about stakeholder needs: turn recurring requests into reusable datasets or tooling, and make trade-offs clear.

**Helpful Experience**
Blockchain experience is not required.
  
  

* Kafka, database replication, or change-data-capture systems.
* Apache Iceberg, Spark, Trino, or other lakehouse and query technologies.
* Infrastructure as code, data observability, lineage, and disaster recovery.
* Usage metering, billing and revenue data, or semantic layers for self-service analytics.

**What Success Looks Like**
Within three months:
  
  

* You own a production pipeline and have shipped an improvement to its freshness, reliability, or operating cost.
* Downstream users can see whether its data is current, recovery procedures have been tested, and a recurring manual request has become a reusable dataset or tool.

**Benefits & Perks**
🏥 Private Health Insurance
  
  
💪 Gym Reimbursement
  
  
🚅 Commuter Benefits
  
  
🌴 Flexible Time Off
  
  
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
  
  
🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
  
  
🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
  
  
🎧 Books & Audiobook subscription with Bookster
  
  
Compensation Range: $205K - $230K

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
As a global organization spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with relevant careers.
  
  
Role Summary:
  
  
We are hiring a DevOps Engineer to own the delivery pipeline and operational automation for LSEG's internal observability platform - a high-ownership role with direct impact on how the platform gets built and delivered!
  
  
The platform is initially deployed in Azure but is developed to be hosting-agnostic and portable. Future deployments may include other cloud providers or on-premises environments, and the delivery and infrastructure patterns must support that flexibility from the beginning.
  
  
The focus of this role is making sure every component of the platform can be deployed, scaled, updated, and rolled back in a controlled and repeatable way - regardless of where it runs. This means owning CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, GitOps workflows, and container operations, and working closely with the Lead Engineer and SRE team to support both engineering velocity and operational stability.
  
  
This is a central role in how a strategic observability platform gets built, shipped, and operated across a global enterprise - with the chance to use the platform you help build to supervise the pipeline itself!
  
  
**What You will be Doing:**

* Develop, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for all platform components, covering testing, validation, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment.
* Implement and evolve GitOps workflows, including branching strategy, environment promotion, approval gates, and rollback patterns.
* Supervise the health and performance of the delivery pipeline itself, using the observability platform where possible.
* Evaluate and introduce tooling improvements that increase deployment safety, pipeline reliability, and developer experience.
* Infrastructure and operations:
* Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, including module design, remote state management, environment separation, and secrets handling.
* Operate container and orchestration infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, including stateful workloads such as ClickHouse and Redis.
* Manage secrets securely across pipelines and environments, ensuring credentials are never stored in version control or state files.
* Develop delivery and infrastructure patterns that work with Azure as the primary environment and remain portable to other cloud providers or on-premises deployments.
* Collaboration and improvement:
* Partner with the Lead Engineer on infrastructure build decisions and with the SRE team on operational runbooks and recovery procedures.
* Maintain clear documentation for deployment processes, environment configuration, and onboarding guides for new engineers.

**What You will Bring:**

* Experience crafting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with ownership of the full pipeline from commit to production.
* Infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, including module design, state management, secrets handling, and environment separation.
* Experience with GitOps practices, including pull-request-driven deployments, environment promotion, and version-controlled configuration.
* Container and orchestration experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, including stateful workloads.
* Secrets management experience using tools such as HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, with the ability to compose patterns that remain portable across providers or to on-premises environments.
* Ability to communicate clearly with engineering and SRE teams about pipeline design, deployment state, and operational risk.
* Desirable skills and experience:
* Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including compute, networking, storage, and identity and access management.
* Experience with on-premises Kubernetes deployments or hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure patterns.
* Experience with other cloud providers such as AWS or GCP, particularly where multi-cloud or provider-agnostic patterns were required.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ClickHouse, or Cribl from a deployment or operational perspective.
* Experience instrumenting CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure with observability tooling.
* Experience in a regulated, financial services, or large enterprise technology environment.

Senior Associate

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the country in which the role is being hired. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
  
  
Mark43's mission is to empower communities and their governments with new technologies that improve the safety and quality of life for all. We build powerful, scalable, and elegant software that sets a new standard for the tools upon which our first responders rely. Our users are diverse, and we are therefore committed to embracing diversity of thought and experience within our team.
  
  
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our team and help build, scale, and maintain the infrastructure that powers our mission-critical public safety platform. In this role, you will focus on improving infrastructure reliability, automating deployments, enhancing observability, and enabling engineering teams to develop and deliver software efficiently.
  
  
You will work closely with Engineering, Security, and other cross-functional teams to ensure our cloud infrastructure is scalable, secure, highly available, and fault tolerant. You will leverage technologies such as AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, and Grafana to improve our infrastructure, streamline developer workflows, and drive operational excellence across the platform.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
If you were a part of our team, here are some things you would have done last week:
  
  

* Manage and optimize our AWS cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and high availability.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.
* Develop, improve, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline application builds, testing, and deployments.
* Drive GitOps practices and automation using technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, and ArgoCD.
* Improve platform observability by implementing and optimizing monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Build internal tools and automation that improve developer productivity, reduce manual processes, and enable engineering teams to deploy software more efficiently.
* Partner with engineering teams to establish DevOps best practices, improve deployment workflows, and strengthen platform reliability.
* Identify and resolve infrastructure performance bottlenecks, operational inefficiencies, and potential points of failure.
* Participate in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation to support production infrastructure and troubleshoot critical incidents.
* Own and drive infrastructure projects that contribute to the long-term scalability, stability, and health of the Mark43 platform.

What We Expect From You
  
  

* 5+ years of professional experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related infrastructure-focused role.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud infrastructure.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for application builds, testing, and deployments.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code technologies, particularly Terraform.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Experience implementing and maintaining monitoring, logging, observability, and alerting solutions.
* Familiarity with GitOps practices and deployment automation tools such as ArgoCD.
* Experience with scripting or programming to automate infrastructure operations, improve developer workflows, and build internal tooling.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance best practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and proactively identify opportunities to improve system performance and reliability.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, take ownership of technical projects, and partner effectively with engineering teams.

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

* Working with a team that respects and embraces your ideas and expertise.
* Building mission-critical and socially responsible software to enable first responders to better serve their communities.
* Contributing to the advancement of public safety software across Local, State, Federal, and DoD agencies.
* Opportunities for career growth in an environment where your achievements will be celebrated.
* An organization investing in its people to support our continued growth, with excellent benefits and a strong long-term strategy.
* Working towards a worthwhile mission with a team of friendly and intelligent coworkers.
* Constant collaboration within the Platform Division and with other teams, including Product, Engineering, Security, and Technical Services.

title: Cloud/DevOps Engineer
description:
Do you want to support the technology emergency dispatchers rely on when every second counts? Join a team building solutions that make a real difference for public safety professionals around the world!
  
  
This role is eligible for our full host of benefits such as health, dental, vision, pet, and legal insurance, PTO, company contributions to a 401K and more while working in an award winning workplace culture. Come see why our teams love working here! This role is based in Salt Lake City, UT and has a hybrid work model.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Cloud/DevOps Engineer helps design, build, and support the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines behind our public safety software products, including ProQA, QA products, and other platforms. This role focuses on Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and CI/CD automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions. This role partners closely with development, QA, and security teams to ensure our mission-critical applications—including ProQA 24/7/365 service supporting emergency call centers—are deployed safely, monitored effectively, and supported through a sustainable on-call rotation. This position reports to the Information Systems Manager and plays a key role in scaling our DevOps practices as our product portfolio grows. This role works on a hybrid schedule based in Salt Lake City, Utah.
  
  
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Terraform, Azure cloud security best practices, and building reliable, secure, and repeatable deployment pipelines.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure to support ProQA, AQUA, and other products.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to provision, version, and manage cloud resources consistently across environments.
* Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions to automate testing, builds, and deployments.
* Implement and enforce Azure cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), network security, and secrets management.
* Monitor production systems and participate in an on-call rotation to support ProQA 24/7/365 always-on service for emergency call center customers.
* Automate deployment, scaling, and recovery processes to reduce manual intervention and improve system reliability.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to integrate security and reliability practices into the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Support containerization and orchestration efforts, including Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), as needed.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues across cloud environments.
* Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and on-call runbooks to support knowledge sharing.
* Stay current with evolving Azure services, DevOps tooling, and cloud security practices, recommending improvements where appropriate.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–5 years of experience in a Cloud/DevOps engineering role or related technical position.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including core compute, networking, and storage services.
* Experience writing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Working knowledge of Azure cloud security practices, including IAM, role-based access control (RBAC), network security, and secrets management.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Scripting experience (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, or Python) for automation and tooling.
* Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker; experience with Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is a plus.
* Experience supporting production systems, including participation in an on-call rotation.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, QA, and security teams.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate) preferred.

**Essential Job Functions/Physical Requirements**

* Designing, building, and maintaining cloud infrastructure while implementing security best practices
* Monitors production systems, automates deployment, and provides after hours support as needed
* Maintaining clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and on-call runbooks
* Ability to multi-task technical problems efficiently
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to both users and programmers effectively.
* Problem-solving
* Frequent computer and telephone use
* Sitting for long periods of time
* Concentrating for long periods of time.
* Occasional travel of less than 5% (training) may be required.

**Our Company:**
Priority Dispatch Corp. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are a small, fast-growing provider of consulting, training, and software products for the public safety market. Priority Dispatch is based in the U.S. in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and matching 401(k) programs, etc. Priority Dispatch Corp. (PDC) provides comprehensive, integrated solutions for Police, Fire, and Medical emergency dispatching. We incorporate the Priority Dispatch System® approved by the International Academies of Emergency Dispatch in all our products. PDC offers multi-agency emergency dispatching ProQA® software, as well as a card-set version, AQUA® quality improvement software, training, consulting, and Academy accreditation support. www.prioritydispatch.net

* Lead or participate in cloud migrations: lifting and shifting on-premises workloads, re-architecting to cloud-native services.

* Implement backup, disaster recovery and high availability strategies; manage data redundancies, snapshots, multi-AZ / multi-region architectures.
* Optimize cost & performance: right-sizing resources, identifying waste, designing for efficiency.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues in cloud infrastructure and services; conduct root cause analyses.

* Communicate proactively and effectively with clients to understand technical needs, provide progress updates, and articulate complex solutions clearly.
* Apply critical thinking and strategic problem-solving to evaluate trade-offs, identify root causes, and design robust cloud architectures.
* Stay up to date on the latest AWS services, features, industry best practices; evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements.
* Perform deep OS-level troubleshooting and system administration across both Linux and Windows environments operating in the cloud.

**Summary Of Requirements & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or relevant field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3-5+ years of hands-on experience working with AWS in an engineering or infrastructure role (seniority adjustable).
* Strong knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, S3, VPC, RDS / Aurora, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker, Kubernetes / Amazon EKS, ECS, and Fargate.
* Proven ability to debug and troubleshoot complex container workload issues in Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and AWS ECS environments.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions.
* Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, NodeJS, PowerShell, or similar) for automating tasks.
* Working familiarity with monitoring, logging, tracing tools (e.g. CloudWatch, X-Ray, ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, and compliance (VPCs, subnets, security groups, network ACLs, encryption, identity management).
* Experience in project delivery: working in agile or scrum environments, estimating work, delivering against milestones.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Good communication skills—able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Deep technical knowledge and hands-on experience with OS-level administration, configuration, and advanced troubleshooting for both Linux and Windows Server platforms.
* Strong client-facing communication skills with a proven track record of building trust and managing technical discussions with stakeholders.
* Exceptional critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and decisive problem-solving capabilities under complex or ambiguous scenario conditions.

**Why work for us?**
Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.
