UPMC Health Plan is hiring a full-time Senior Analytics Data Integration Developer to join the Medicare/SNP Stars Team. This is a remote position working Monday through Friday. Candidates must be available during core business hours, with required availability from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. EST.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, including advanced SQL skills and experience working with Snowflake, or Databricks. Success in this role requires the ability to compile, integrate, and analyze large, complex datasets from multiple sources while ensuring data accuracy, quality, and integrity.
  
  
The Analytics Data Integration Developer Senior creates highly complex programming, data set infrastructure, and other advanced technical processes to integrate healthcare data elements from disparate sources throughout the UPMC enterprise. This integration results in a layer of information that fuels health economics activities including strategic analysis, predictive modeling, and clinical program evaluation.
  
  
*Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, without requiring, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. UPMC does not participate in STEM OPT.*
**Responsibilities:**

* Investigate data errors/variances and derive solutions with appropriate follow-up monitoring.
* Make recommendations for optimal data extraction, manipulation, and integration methodologies based upon research and analysis.
* Maintain up-to-date information on status and effort related to each project.
* Maintain policies and procedures of the team/department. Assist team leadership with distribution and monitoring of work assignments.
* Develop high-complexity integrated data sets to support analysis, data science, clinical operations, and decision support activities.
* Coordinate ongoing communication with other departments in order to manage information integrity and maintain cross-department processes.
* Perform validation and ensure quality standards for high-complexity data sets created by fellow team members.
* Assist with orientation and process-specific training of new staff members.
* Provide technical consultation and act as reference point to peers, other business areas, senior leadership and external customers.
* Adopt and promote best practices, tools, and methods set by team/department leadership.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with internal UPMC health Plan departments, and external contacts as appropriate.
* Meet deadlines and turnaround times set by supervisor. (These deadlines will, at times, require the employee to work until the project is completed, meaning extended daily work hours, extended work weeks, or both.)

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, data management, healthcare management, business, or related field.

+ Master's or other advanced degree is a bonus.

* Minimum of five years of work experience in information technology, healthcare, business, or research is required.
* Demonstrated experience compiling, transforming, and managing large datasets from multiple sources strongly preferred.
* Experience and high technical proficiency in SQL strongly preferred.
* Experience and high technical proficiency in Snowflake or Databricks strongly preferred.
* Experience in data engineering strongly preferred.
* Experience building efficient data structures strongly preferred.
* Experience in health insurance or healthcare industry is preferred, but those with relevant experience in other industries may be considered.
* Extensive experience managing/preparing data sets for use in analysis, modeling, or business operations is required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office products (particularly Excel) is required.
* Advanced problem-solving skills are required.
* The ability to effectively communicate issues and results, verbally and in writing, is required.
* The ability to use effective time management skills, including prioritization multiple tasks, is necessary for success.
* Attention to detail is critically important in this role.
* Ability to succeed in a fast-paced, ambiguous/fluid environment.
* A strong customer/stakeholder focus is expected at all times.
* Ability to work extra hours if required.

**Licensure, Certifications, and Clearances:**
**UPMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veteran**

title: AWS Redshift ETL Developer
description:
The Infosys Communications, Media, and Technology (CMT) unit is a dynamic and innovative division dedicated to driving digital transformation and growth for clients in the telecommunications, media, and technology sectors. Our vision is to become the strategic and trusted partner for our clients by enabling their digital transformation and growth. We achieve this by leading technological changes. Join us to be part of a team that leverages deep industry insights and strategic leadership to deliver innovation-led transformation through digital, cloud, and AI-first solutions. We are committed to building and nurturing a high-impact partner ecosystem and driving long-term, strategic client relationships.

**Job Description:**

**In the assigned Job Role of Technology Consultant 2, your Area Of Responsibility will be as below:**

⦁ Contribute to the requirements elicitation process by documenting assigned parts of business requirements, in line with guidance provided

⦁ Facilitate software application design discussions, and document design decisions to guide the technical team towards building software solutions

⦁ Participate in coding and integrate new features or updates into existing applications, with a focus on maintaining system stability

⦁ Conduct code reviews, do changes to the codebase and maintain code repositories

⦁ Implement test strategies, analyse results, and coordinate bug fixes to uphold the software quality standards

⦁ Develop user training programs, documentation, and support frameworks to ensure a smooth transition to new software applications

⦁ Actively participate in resolving production issues and recommend preventive strategies to enhance system reliability

⦁ Maintain detailed records of code, testing techniques, and support activities to enrich the knowledge base and assist other similar projects

**Your contribution to the team:**

⦁ A collaborative spirit and excellent communication skills.

⦁ The ability to handle end to end SDLC phases from requirement gathering to implementation.

⦁ A knack for translating complex requirements into actionable development tasks.

⦁ A passion for design and hands-on coding experience

⦁ A proactive approach to testing, troubleshooting, and refining our applications.

⦁ The ability to work with cross-functional teams and do software integration.

**Required Skills:**

• Pipeline Development: Designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from diverse sources like Amazon S3, RDS, or external APIs into Redshift.

• Data Transformation: Utilize Redshift Stored Procedure to Extract Load and transform data.

• Logic Encapsulation: Writing Redshift Stored Procedures (using PL/pgSQL) to group multiple SQL statements into a single unit, ensuring they succeed or fail as an atomic transaction.

• Orchestration: Automate workflows using AWS Step Functions or Amazon MWAA (Airflow).

• Performance Tuning: Optimize Redshift query performance through appropriate distribution styles, sort keys, and compression.

• Maintenance & Documentation: Support, troubleshoot, and document ETL workflows, including data mapping, transformation rules, and technical designs.

**Preferred Skills:**

• Scripting: Strong scripting abilities in Python or UNIX shell for file processing and automation.

**Additional Required Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.

• This position may require relocation and/or travel to work/project location.

• Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role now or in the future.

**Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Infosys employee you are also eligible for the following benefits:

* Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
* Long-term/Short-term Disability
* Health and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts
* Insurance (Accident, Critical Illness , Hospital Indemnity, Legal)
* 401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary level
* Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

**About Us**

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

**EEO**

Infosys provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Aaratech Inc.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

**Experience:**
2-3 years

**Compensation:**
$70,000 – $80,000 per year

**Work Mode:**
On-Site / Hybrid

**Work Authorization**

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

**Job Summary**

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Engineer to help build and maintain data pipelines on cloud platforms. You will develop ETL/ELT workflows, bring data together from multiple systems, and help keep the data that powers reporting and analytics accurate and reliable.

**What You Will Do**

• Build and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines using tools such as Azure Data Factory, SSIS, or AWS Glue.

• Pull data together from multiple sources — databases, files, APIs — into clean, usable datasets.

• Write SQL to transform, join, and validate data.

• Use Python scripts to automate routine data tasks.

• Monitor pipelines and help troubleshoot issues when data does not land as expected.

• Work with analysts and business teams to understand what data they need and deliver it.

• Document your pipelines so others can understand and maintain them.

**What We Are Looking For**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

• 2+ years working with data — ETL development, data integration, SQL development, or database work all count.

• Good SQL skills: comfortable with joins, aggregations, and writing queries against real-world data.

• Experience with at least one ETL tool (Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, or similar).

• Basic familiarity with data warehouse concepts (tables, schemas, fact/dimension basics).

• Some Python scripting exposure, or a strong desire to learn it.

• Clear communicator and reliable problem-solver.

**Tools You Will Work With**

• Cloud: Azure (Data Factory, Synapse) or AWS (Glue, Redshift) — experience with either is fine.

• Databases & warehouses: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Databricks.

• Languages: SQL and Python.

• Version control: Git.

• Reporting tools your data will feed: Power BI or Tableau.

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

• Any exposure to dbt, Airflow, or Databricks notebooks.

• Awareness of CI/CD or basic DevOps concepts.

• Experience with Power BI or Tableau.

• Certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), AWS Data Engineer Associate, or SnowPro Core — helpful but not required.

**About Aaratech Inc.**

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across data & analytics, cybersecurity, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations build scalable cloud data platforms, optimize data workflows, and enable data-driven decision-making through modern engineering practices.

title: Data Engineer (Edify)
description:

We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.
  
  
At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .
  
  
For more information, visit our Careers page.
  
  
**The Role In Brief**
**Data Engineer (Edify)**
Their primary responsibility is to develop and deploy data services, inclusive of BI tools, integrations, reports, amongst other data configuration procedures between client IT systems and EAB technology. In addition, they work collectively with other EAB project and product development staff to implement data pipelines, manage projects and relationships with partners, set and execute against project milestones, and perform at the highest standards of quality, client satisfaction, and engagement throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  
  
This role may be based in Richmond, VA or Washington, D.C.
  
  
This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Conceptualize, develop and deploy data extraction procedures working collaboratively with partners
* Develop recommendations for internal leadership around preferred data integration methodologies
* Ensure barriers to timely completion of Data Integration Services projects are anticipated and overcome
* Work effectively with internal and external project managers to ensure timely delivery of implementation
* Encapsulate findings through new product integration exercises for the overall benefit of EAB data integration effort
* Build and foster strong relationships with all levels of technical and non-technical staff at client institutions
* Proactively identify, recognize, and act on opportunities for improvement in order to advance business goals.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration.

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome diversity of background and experience. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.
  
  
**Compensation**
The anticipated starting salary range for this role is $75,000 - $85,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.
  
  
**Benefits**
Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:

At EAB, we believe that to fulfill our mission to “make education smarter and our communities stronger” we need team members who bring a diversity of perspectives to the table and are committed to fostering a workplace where each team member is valued, respected and heard.

title: Data Engineer I/II - Data Analytics & Solutions
description:
**Data Engineer I/II - Data Analytics & Solutions (DAS) — LIS ART, Retail Solutions**

We are seeking a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Engineer II to join Mutual of Omaha's Data Analytics & Solutions (DAS) team, part of the LIS Agile Release Train within the Retail Solutions segment. This role is a strong fit for a data engineering professional who wants hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and room to grow into a more senior engineering track.

The DAS team owns the data behind the scenes for our retail applications and reporting teams. You'll support production data systems, build and maintain ETL pipelines, and help lead the team's ongoing migration of our data warehouse from Teradata to Snowflake, with AWS Glue and continued mainframe decommissioning on the roadmap for the next 6-12 months.

This role will partner closely with other engineering, BA, and reporting teams that consume DAS owned data, including application teams like the Data Integration Hub, to keep data flowing reliably across the business.

We're looking for someone who already has hands-on data engineering experience and is comfortable working with real autonomy. This team moves quickly and gives engineers real ownership.

If you're energized by hands-on data engineering, cross-functional collaboration, and helping modernize a growing data platform, we encourage you to apply.

**WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Estimated Salary:
  + Data Engineer I: $110,000 - $116,000
  + Data Engineer II: $130,000 - $135,000
* 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
* Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
* Primarily remote, with periodic onsite collaboration for team-building sessions and PI planning (up to four times a year).
* A local candidate is preferred but not required. This role can be fully remote for the right candidate.
* **Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.**

***This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as PI planning, team-building sessions, or other business-critical meetings.***

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Build, debug, and maintain ETL pipelines that move and transform data across the team's supported systems.
* Investigate customer and business-partner data requests, validate data, and troubleshoot where information is missing or incorrect.
* Support the active migration from Teradata to Snowflake — tracing source tables in Teradata, building equivalent Snowflake tables, and ensuring downstream consumers see a seamless transition.
* Write and maintain advanced SQL and stored procedures across Teradata, Snowflake, Oracle, and DB2.
* Partner with other engineering, BA, and reporting teams that consume DAS-owned data, including application teams (e.g., the Data Integration Hub) that call on DAS data behind the scenes.
* Participate in a daily 30-minute developer collaboration session to raise blockers and work through problems with the team.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning (roughly every 3 weeks) and PI planning.
* Maintain data quality through systematic approaches within supported data systems.
* Help lead and mentor other developers through technical challenges.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 6+ years of professional experience in data engineering / data systems development, or equivalent.
* Advanced SQL knowledge, including writing and maintaining stored procedures.
* Hands-on experience across multiple relational/data-warehouse platforms: Teradata, Snowflake, Oracle, and DB2.
* Strong ETL experience, proficient with ETL tooling such as Informatica / IDMC.
* Working knowledge of Unix scripting, sufficient to understand and support existing scripts.
* Understanding of data warehouse concepts and cloud data environments.
* Familiarity with GitHub for source control.
* Strong debugging skills to support production issues.
* Experience working on an Agile team.
* Willingness to learn AWS and AWS Glue, and to pick up new ETL technologies as the team modernizes.
* Able to work independently with minimal oversight — this team runs with a high degree of autonomy, so self-driven, decisive contributors do best here.
* Able to work remotely, with the ability to travel onsite for team events up to four times a year.
* Participation in an on-call rotation shared with the team, roughly every 5-6 weeks (one week as primary, following week as backup); after-hours pages are infrequent.

**PREFERRED:**

* SAFe Agile experience.
* Exposure to Control-M or similar job-scheduling tools.
* Windows scripting, in addition to Unix.
* Familiarity with mainframe environments.
* API integration experience.
* Located near the Mutual of Omaha office.

**We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!**

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at careers@mutualofomaha.com. Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

**Stay Safe from Job Scams**
Mutual of Omaha only accepts applications from mutualofomaha.com/careers. Legitimate communications will come from '@mutualofomaha.com.' We never request sensitive information or extend job offers without conducting interviews. For more details, check our Hiring FAQs. Stay alert for scams and apply securely!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer - Boston, United States
  
  

We are partnering with our client, a leading institutional asset manager based in Boston's financial district, to appoint a Senior Data Engineer to join our client's team. In this permanent role, you will be instrumental in building a modern, cloud-native data and analytics platform, collaborating closely with operations, data analysts, and business stakeholders. You will help design and implement scalable data solutions that power investment, operations, analytics, and client reporting, working within a hybrid model (in-office Tuesday-Thursday, remote Monday and Friday).

Key Skills and Expertise
  
  

* Python for Data Engineering - Developing robust data pipelines and automation to ingest, process, and transform enterprise data.
* ELT with DBT, Snowflake, Snaplogic - Designing and implementing efficient ELT workflows to support modern cloud data warehousing.
* Data Modeling & Warehousing - Building operational data stores and data warehouses that provide reliable, well-structured datasets for analytics.
* Advanced SQL - Creating stored procedures, functions, and complex queries to optimize data access and performance.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

About Beacon Behavioral Health

Beacon Behavioral Health is a fast-growing behavioral healthcare organization with a mission to expand access to high-quality mental health services and improve outcomes for the patients and communities we serve. As Beacon continues to grow organically and through acquisitions, building a trusted and scalable data foundation is critical to improving clinical care, operations, decision-making, and innovation.

Position Overview

Beacon is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to help build and scale our enterprise data platform. This role will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data warehouse, data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that power analytics, reporting, automation, and AI initiatives across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineer with strong experience building modern cloud data platforms and integrating data from complex source systems. Healthcare data experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience working with EHR, clinical, revenue cycle, payer, or patient data.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain Beacon's enterprise data warehouse and supporting data architecture.
* Develop reliable and scalable data pipelines integrating data from EHRs, practice management systems, revenue cycle platforms, APIs, databases, and other enterprise applications.
* Build and maintain cloud-based data infrastructure primarily within AWS.
* Create standardized and trusted data models for clinical, operational, financial, and executive reporting.
* Build data integration capabilities to support Beacon's growing portfolio of practices and acquired organizations.
* Partner with business and technology teams to translate reporting and analytics requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Establish data quality, validation, monitoring, lineage, and documentation practices.
* Optimize data pipelines and warehouse performance, reliability, and cost.
* Develop APIs, data services, and reusable datasets to support applications, automation, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Help establish enterprise data engineering standards, architecture, and development best practices.
* Ensure healthcare data is handled securely and in accordance with HIPAA and organizational security requirements.

Qualifications

* 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles.
* Strong experience designing and building cloud-based data warehouses and modern data platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and AWS data services.
* Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python.
* Strong experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating data from APIs, databases, files, and third-party platforms.
* Experience with data modeling, dimensional modeling, data quality, and pipeline orchestration.
* Experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines and cloud data infrastructure.
* Understanding of data governance, security, access controls, and sensitive data management.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-growing environment.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Healthcare data engineering experience strongly preferred.
* Experience working with EHR/EMR, clinical, claims, billing, eligibility, or revenue cycle data.
* Understanding of healthcare data standards such as HL7, FHIR, X12, ICD-10, CPT, and related healthcare data models.
* Experience extracting data from healthcare systems using APIs, database access, HL7 feeds, or other integration methods.
* Experience with Tableau is a plus.
* Experience integrating data following healthcare acquisitions or across multiple EHR and practice management systems.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys building the data foundation, not simply maintaining an existing environment. This individual will help Beacon turn data distributed across clinical and business systems into a trusted enterprise asset that enables better reporting, operational insights, automation, and AI as the organization continues to scale.

title: Data Engineer II, AWS Analytics Engineering
description:
**Description**
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS — we build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 150 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains. We operate at massive scale — processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.
  
  
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our team. This individual will be a significant and autonomous contributor, owning a major portion of the team's data architecture — solving difficult problems, building logical data models, and delivering data pipelines that are stable, performant, and consistently high quality. You will work with engineers and stakeholders across AWS to design data contracts, build ingestion flows, and deliver analytical models that increase self-service access to datasets and business effectiveness.
  
  
The ideal candidate applies appropriate technologies and best practices, writes pragmatic and maintainable code, and takes ownership of ongoing data quality. You are proficient with SQL, ETL, and data processing, with experience using cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lake Formation. The candidate should have exposure to AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, and a foundational understanding of Agentic Frameworks — including autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, and tool integration. You are trusted with autonomy in ambiguous environments where data design is not well defined, able to balance customer requirements with team priorities, and passionate about building data platforms using AI to accelerate the next generation of analytics at AWS scale.
  
  
**About AWS**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Identify and resolve data quality issues in processing tools, contribute to improvements and innovation, and ensure best practices in pipelines you design and maintain. For example: optimizing ingestion flows for new data sources, or building efficient transformation patterns within the team's domain.
  
  
Build and optimize logical data models and data pipelines for difficult datasets — ensuring solutions are testable, maintainable, and efficient while addressing security, scalability, and cost considerations.
  
  
Make appropriate technical trade-offs at the dataset level, balancing pragmatic short-term decisions with sustainable long-term approaches.
  
  
Produce high-quality code — solutions that are pragmatic, secure, maintainable, and flexible without over-engineering. Write code that engineers unfamiliar with the system can understand. Limit the use of short-term workarounds and minimize incidental complexity.
  
  
Contribute to infrastructure decisions within the team's data architecture. Efficiently manage resources (system hardware, data storage, query optimization, AWS infrastructure) and build solutions that are stable and performant.
  
  
Solve difficult problems — for example, designing data models that integrate multiple sources within the team's domain, or combining datasets to unlock new analytical capabilities. Identify issues that may lead to data inconsistency or gaps in data quality, and proactively resolve them.
  
  
Break down project work into manageable tasks, deliver independently, and collaborate effectively with peers on shared dependencies. Resolve discordant views and build consensus among team members.
  
  
Mentor peers, participate in hiring, and contribute to team knowledge-sharing
  
  
Drive data engineering best practices within the team — code quality, data certification, dependency management, and operational excellence. Establish SLAs, automate manual processes, and improve self-service access to data.
  
  
Drive improvements through code reviews, design discussions, team planning, and operational reviews.
  
  
Participate in on-call rotation and take ownership of operational health for data systems you own — contribute to monitoring, alarming, runbooks, and incident resolution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
* 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using SQL experience
* 5+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using OLAP technologies experience
* Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* 4+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
* Experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets, or experience with software development lifecycle

You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
  
  
Data Engineer, Product Analytics Responsibilities:
  
  

* Manage and execute data warehouse plans for a product or a group of products to solve well-scoped problems

* 2+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala or others.)

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM field
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
**The Role**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our solutions help thousands of organizations worldwide see and govern who has access to what, so every identity has exactly the access it needs.

SailPoint is seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our IT Data Engineering team. In this role, you will build and maintain the data models and pipelines that serve as the trusted foundation for reporting and analytics across SailPoint, with a particular focus on supporting our HR and People Analytics partners. You'll own data from ingestion through the reporting layer, writing the SQL, tests, documentation, and access controls that keep it accurate, secure, and easy for others to build on.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain modular dbt models in BigQuery that transform raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets.
* Write performant, well-structured SQL, and optimize BigQuery queries and models for speed and cost.
* Build and support data ingestion pipelines that bring data from source systems and SaaS applications, including Workday, into the warehouse.
* Develop and maintain orchestration and scheduling for data workflows, and monitor pipelines to make sure data arrives on time and complete.
* Define and standardize business metrics, such as headcount, attrition, and recruiting funnel measures, so the same number shows up consistently in every report and dashboard.
* Implement dbt tests, documentation, and code review practices to ensure data quality and make models easy for others to understand and extend.
* Enforce data privacy and access controls for sensitive and PII data across models, data sources, and dashboards, including Row-Level Security.
* Build and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards on top of your models, including operational and executive-level views used by HR and leadership.
* Support Tableau administration for the content you own, including user permissions, publishing workflows, and refresh schedules.
* Build datasets that support workforce analytics and forecasting use cases, such as attrition and recruiting capacity planning.
* Explore and help implement AI-assisted analytics, such as self-service query tools built on BigQuery and Google Gemini, for HR and other business partners.
* Troubleshoot data issues end to end, from source system through transformation to reporting, and drive root-cause fixes.
* Contribute to CI/CD, version control, and deployment practices for the team's data projects.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define KPIs, and scope new data products and visualizations.
* Contribute to data modeling standards, naming conventions, and reusable patterns for the broader data team.

**Requirements:**

* 5 - 8 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role.
* Advanced SQL skills, including window functions, CTEs, and query performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining data models in dbt, including tests, macros, and documentation.
* Experience working in a cloud data warehouse, preferably BigQuery.
* Experience building or supporting data pipelines and working with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud, including published data sources, calculated fields, parameters, and Row-Level Security.
* Experience working with sensitive or PII data and applying data privacy and access controls.
* Proficiency with version control using Git and familiarity with CI/CD workflows.
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts such as dimensional modeling, star schemas, granularity, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience gathering requirements from business users and translating them into data solutions.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical and executive audiences.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM, business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with HR or workforce data, such as headcount, attrition, and recruiting funnel reporting.
* Experience with Workday data, including custom reports or integrations that feed downstream analytics.
* Experience using AI tools for analytical querying or building AI-assisted self-service reporting.
* Experience with Python for data pipelines, automation, or analysis.
* Experience with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar.
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services beyond BigQuery.
* Experience in a SaaS or cybersecurity environment.

**Plan for Success:**

**Days 1–30: Integration & Core Tech Onboarding**
Focus on gaining environment access, mapping pipeline architectures, and aligning with key stakeholders.

* Tech Stack Setup: Set up your developer environment and establish full access to Google BigQuery, dbt, Git, and Tableau.
* Architecture Mapping: Conduct a deep dive into active dbt models and data pipelines, specifically analyzing how data flows from systems like Workday into BigQuery.
* Compliance & Security: Review security protocols for PII data, focusing on Row-Level Security implementations in Tableau.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Set up regular syncs with your manager, team peers, and key HR/People Analytics stakeholders.

**Days 31–60: Active Development & Core Deliverables**
Transition from learning to active execution, contributing to production code and standardizing business metrics.

* Deploy First dbt Model: Build, test, and deploy your first modular dbt model transforming raw workforce data in BigQuery.
* Standardize Metrics: Collaborate with HR partners to define and codify a core business metric (e.g., attrition or recruiting funnel metrics) within dbt.
* Tableau Visualization: Develop, secure, and publish a targeted Tableau dashboard answering a specific HR operational query.
* Workflow Support: Actively participate in the team’s Git pull request reviews and support basic data pipeline monitoring.

**Days 61–90: Autonomous Ownership & Strategic Optimization**
Operate with full autonomy, owning end-to-end projects, improving system performance, and driving innovative pilots.

* End-to-End Delivery: Own an analytics project from initial stakeholder requirements gathering to the final certified Tableau dashboard.
* Query Optimization: Identify and optimize a complex BigQuery query or dbt model to improve processing speed and lower warehouse costs.
* AI Analytics Pilot: Coordinate a small prototype testing AI-assisted querying (such as using Google Gemini on BigQuery) for business users.
* Cross-Functional Scope: Extend analytical support to other business verticals beyond HR as team priorities shift.

Benefits and Compensation listed vary based on the location of your employment and the nature of your employment with SailPoint.

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the SailPoint Corporate Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission, along with potential eligibility for equity participation. SailPoint maintains broad salary ranges for its roles to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect SailPoint’s differing products, industries, and lines of business. Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity. We estimate the base salary, for US-based employees, will be in this range from (min-max, USD):

$108,600 - $183,018.00

Base salaries for employees based in other locations are competitive for the employee’s home location.

Benefits Overview

1. Health and wellness coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance

2. Disability coverage: Short-term and long-term disability

3. Life protection: Life insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D)

description:

At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship, including H-1B/L-1/F-1 sponsorship, for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

**About the Company**

Vari, originally known as VariDesk®, started the standing desk revolution. Now in its 13th year, Vari’s mission is to create workspaces that elevate people. With millions of fans and a complete line of over 400 office furniture products in the market today, Vari is continuing to simplify and disrupt the office furniture industry by pioneering a direct B2C and B2B business model, reimagining how workspaces are defined, designed, and delivered.

**About the Role**

This is a high-visibility, high-impact individual contributor role on a lean data team that is actively investing in its analytics and AI capabilities. Most of your time (~75%) will be spent doing what you do best: digging into data, surfacing trends through statistical analysis, and delivering Power BI reports and dashboards that stakeholders use and trust. The remaining focus (~25%) supports the data engineering side, contributing to star schema design, T-SQL stored procedures, and ETL pipelines that feed clean, reliable data into the warehouse.

This role demands equal parts technical depth and business fluency. You will work directly with leaders and teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, earning their trust by understanding their goals, asking the right questions, and delivering analysis that drives real decisions. If you’re energized by working at the intersection of rigorous analysis and modern data tooling, and excited by the opportunity to embed AI-powered analytics into the way a growing company understands itself, this role is built for you.

**Responsibilities**

**Business Intelligence & Analytics**

* Lead the design and delivery of dashboards, reports, and analytical products using Power BI and other modern BI tools
* Apply statistical analysis techniques, including regression, forecasting, segmentation, cohort analysis, and hypothesis testing, to surface meaningful patterns and trends
* Build and maintain advanced data models incorporating DAX, calculated measures, and KPI frameworks aligned to business strategy
* Serve as a trusted analytics partner to business stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, proactively identifying opportunities where data can drive better decisions
* Lead requirements-gathering conversations with business teams; translate ambiguous or complex business questions into well-scoped analytical problems and clear deliverables
* Present analytical findings and recommendations confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Leverage AI and machine learning capabilities within the BI stack (e.g. Power BI Copilot, Azure AI, Python- or R-based ML models) to augment analysis and automate insight delivery
* Use Python or R (e.g. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, tidyverse, caret) for exploratory data analysis, statistical modelling, and scripted reporting workflows
* Champion self-service analytics by publishing governed well-documented semantic models and training end users across the business
* Monitor report adoption, data quality, and metric consistency; proactively identify and resolve discrepancies
* Document metric definitions, analytical methodologies, and report lineage to promote a data-literate culture

**Data Engineering**

* Contribute to the design and build of star schema structures in SQL Server, including dimension tables, fact tables, and aggregate layers
* Write and maintain T-SQL stored procedures and ETL logic supporting staging-to-DWH data flows
* Integrate data from key source systems including Salesforce CRM and other operational platforms
* Support source-to-target mapping documentation and data lineage tracking for new data domains
* Collaborate with the broader data team on pipeline reliability, performance tuning, and warehouse architecture

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI, or data analyst role with demonstrable statistical depth
* Strong proficiency in SQL Server and T-SQL for data querying, transformation, and analysis
* Advanced Power BI skills, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling, and row-level security
* Working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis and statistical modelling (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, tidyverse, ggplot2, or similar)
* Hands-on experience with statistical analysis techniques such as forecasting, regression, segmentation, or A/B testing
* Demonstrated business acumen, the ability to connect data findings to business outcomes and communicate their strategic relevance
* Proven track record of managing stakeholder relationships: gathering requirements, setting expectations, and delivering analytical work that earns trust
* Experience working with Salesforce data as a reporting or analytical source
* Familiarity with dimensional modelling concepts and star schema design
* Exceptional communication skills, able to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations for non-technical audiences

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with modern BI and analytics tools beyond Power BI, such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or Sigma
* Exposure to AI/ML-augmented analytics (e.g. Power BI Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Databricks AI, or LLM-based insight tools)
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks
* Experience with dbt for data transformation and semantic layer development
* Knowledge of notebook-based analytics environments (Jupyter, RStudio, Azure Notebooks, or Databricks Notebooks)
* Version control experience with Git for SQL, Python, R, and BI asset management
* Exposure to data observability tools (e.g. Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, dbt tests)
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum delivery frameworks

**Why Vari:**

* Short-term and long-term incentive plan
* 401k and profit-sharing plan
* On-site gym, spa-like locker room
* Enhanced paternity, maternity, and adoption programs
* Personal and volunteer time off
* Team building events on and off-site
* Mentoring and career development
* Education reimbursement
* Wellness program and insurance premium discounts
* At-home work set-up

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Analytics Engineer Hybrid (USA Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The purpose of this role is to bridge the gap between complex data infrastructure and actionable business strategy. You will provide day-to-day support to Revenue Operations (RevOps), including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience leaders.
  
  
We are currently in an exciting transition, migrating our data workflows from Alteryx to dbt. As a BI Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of data engineering and business analysis. You aren't just a "dashboard builder"; you are an Analytics Engineer who builds robust data models in Redshift, orchestrates workflows via Dagster/Airflow, and works directly with stakeholders to translate technical outputs into business impact.
  
  
Crucially, you will help us move beyond standard reporting. We are looking for someone genuinely excited about the frontier of AI and LLM capabilities, helping us integrate predictive analytics and machine learning (via Amazon SageMaker) into the RevOps ecosystem.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities and Outputs**

* Data Modeling & Migration: Lead the migration of legacy workflows from Alteryx to dbt, ensuring high-quality, documented, and tested data models that serve as a single source of truth.
* Orchestration & Pipelines: Manage and monitor data pipelines using Dagster or Airflow to ensure reliability and performance within our Redshift warehouse.
* Stakeholder Collaboration & Translation: Act as the primary liaison between technical data structures and non-technical leaders. You will translate complex "data speak" into clear insights that highlight ROI and business impact.
* AI & Advanced Analytics: Actively explore and implement AI/LLM capabilities to enhance data discovery and predictive modeling. Collaborate with Product/Engineering to apply Machine Learning (SageMaker) to areas like churn prediction and lead scoring.
* RevOps Strategy: Support high-impact initiatives such as Account Based Marketing (ABM) and Customer Health scoring by providing visibility into globally symbols KPIs via Tableau.

**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* The "Technical Translator": You can explain a join or a latent variable to a Sales Director in a way that makes sense for their quota.
* Impact-Focused: You don't just deliver data; you deliver the "so what?"
* AI Enthusiast: You stay up to date with the latest in LLMs and are constantly thinking about how to apply generative AI to analytics workflows.
* Curiosity & Ownership: You lead with questions and take pride in the "cleanliness" and architecture of your code.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Essential**

* Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related data role.
* dbt Expertise: Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade data models using dbt.
* Orchestration Tools: Hands-on experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* SQL & Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL skills and experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake/BigQuery).
* BI Visualization: Experience building stakeholder-facing dashboards in Tableau.
* CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce data structures.

**Preferred**

* Alteryx: Experience with Alteryx (highly beneficial for supporting our migration to dbt).
* AI/ML: Experience with Python and a strong interest (or portfolio) in LLM applications and Machine Learning (Amazon SageMaker).
* Advanced Tableau: Building advanced dashboards and experience with Tableau Online/Server.
* Data Modeling: Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.
* Big Data: Experience dealing with large (+1M rows) customer engagement datasets.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
The
**expected annual base salary range**
for this position is:
**$84,225/year**
to
**$140,375/year**
. This position is bonus eligible / commission-based.

title: FinOps Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the dbt model or Python pipeline that ships the fix, building the cost-vs-revenue mart that answers a margin question once instead of every time, and chasing a number until it reconciles. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case or a data model's implications to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week.

What You'll Be Responsible For

In this role, you'll:

 - Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP: Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation.

 - Build and maintain the FinOps data pipeline: Design and run the BigQuery/dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data (CUR, Storage Lens) into reconciled, trustworthy mart tables, the foundation everything else in FinOps is built on.

 - Build cost-vs-revenue and customer segmentation models: Model unit economics and margin by product line and customer segment, and extend coverage as new products and segments come online.

 - Apply data science to cost and usage data: Build forecasting models, detect anomalies statistically rather than by threshold alone, and quantify savings opportunities (e.g. storage lifecycle, request-cost patterns) with rigor a spreadsheet can't match.

 - Build and maintain cost attribution: Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on.

 - Automate cost governance: Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review.

 - Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit.

 - Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting: Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards and self-serve analytics engineering and finance can both read.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

 - Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics.

 - Have data engineering depth: dbt, BigQuery (or an equivalent modern warehouse), SQL at scale, and data modeling for analytics (dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing).

 - Have data science fundamentals: statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and experimentation, and know when a rigorous model beats a rule of thumb.

 - Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash.

 - Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex).

 - Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work.

 - Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required.

 - Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Have prior experience spanning data analytics, data engineering, or data science in a FinOps, cloud cost management, or cloud governance context.

 - Are energized by doing the unglamorous, high-leverage work (the schlep) that unblocks other teams, and by working cross-functionally without positional authority.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Healthcare Integrations
description:
**Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Healthcare Integrations**

**Location:** Dallas–Fort Worth, TX

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:** In-Office

**Compensation:** 125,000–150,000 per year, depending on experience

**About the Role**

We are a growing multi-site healthcare organization building a centralized data and analytics platform to support better operational decision-making, reporting, automation, and future AI initiatives.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to lead the development of this data foundation.

This is not primarily a reporting or dashboard development role. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that moves data from our core operational systems—including our electronic health record (eClinicalWorks) and CRM (HubSpot)—into Microsoft Fabric.

You will have significant ownership over how our data platform is designed from the beginning and will work directly with operational and technical stakeholders to turn fragmented healthcare and business data into reliable, reusable data products.

**What You Will Build**

Your initial focus will be establishing our Microsoft Fabric environment and creating a scalable data architecture that can support the organization long term.

You will:

* Design and implement our Microsoft Fabric data architecture using OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, notebooks, and related Fabric services.
* Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines from eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, APIs, databases, files, and future enterprise systems.
* Work with REST APIs, FHIR APIs, webhooks, batch exports, and other integration methods to reliably extract source-system data.
* Establish raw, validated, and analytics-ready data layers using a medallion-style architecture.
* Clean, standardize, deduplicate, and reconcile data across systems.
* Develop data models for patients, referrals, appointments, providers, procedures, cases, outcomes, and other operational entities.
* Develop methods for matching records across systems when identifiers are inconsistent or unavailable.
* Create reusable curated datasets that support Power BI reporting, operational analytics, automation, and future AI applications.
* Implement incremental loading, change detection, schema management, error handling, logging, alerting, and pipeline monitoring.
* Establish data quality checks and processes for identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected source data.
* Implement appropriate security, access controls, and governance practices for healthcare data.
* Use Git and CI/CD practices so data pipelines and transformations are version-controlled, documented, and maintainable.
* Monitor Fabric usage, performance, capacity, and cost as the platform grows.
* Document architecture, data definitions, pipelines, dependencies, and operating procedures.
* Maintain and improve the platform after the initial implementation rather than treating the project as a one-time migration.

**First 6–12 Month Priorities**

A successful candidate should be able to take ownership of the platform from architecture through production.

Early priorities will include:

* Assess our existing systems, data sources, reporting requirements, and Microsoft environment.
* Design and configure the initial Microsoft Fabric architecture.
* Establish secure and reliable ingestion from HubSpot and eClinicalWorks.
* Create a raw historical data layer that preserves source-system data.
* Build cleaned and standardized datasets that reconcile information across systems.
* Create an initial analytics-ready data model for high-priority operational reporting.
* Implement automated pipeline monitoring, data-quality validation, documentation, and recovery processes.
* Establish engineering standards that allow additional data sources and use cases to be added without rebuilding the platform.

**Required Experience**

We are looking for someone who has actually built and operated modern data platforms, not someone whose experience is primarily reporting or visualization.

Strong candidates should have:

* 4+ years of professional data engineering, data platform, or data integration experience.
* Hands-on experience building production solutions with Microsoft Fabric or a closely related Azure data stack.
* Strong SQL skills.
* Strong Python and/or PySpark skills.
* Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Factory/Pipelines, notebooks, Delta tables, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience integrating third-party systems through REST APIs.
* Experience implementing incremental data loads rather than relying only on full data refreshes.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, relational modeling, lakehouse architecture, and analytics-oriented data modeling.
* Experience troubleshooting API authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes, malformed records, pipeline failures, and other real-world integration issues.
* Experience with Git, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, data-quality validation, and alerting for production pipelines.
* Ability to work independently and make practical architectural decisions in an environment where the data platform is still being built.

**Healthcare / Integration Experience**

Healthcare experience is strongly preferred.

Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Healthcare EHR/EMR data
* eClinicalWorks
* FHIR / HL7
* Healthcare operational or clinical data models
* HIPAA-regulated data environments
* Patient identity matching or Master Patient Index concepts
* HubSpot APIs and CRM data
* Microsoft Entra ID and Azure security
* Microsoft Purview or other data governance tools
* Power BI semantic models

Direct eClinicalWorks experience is a major plus but is not required if you have strong healthcare API/FHIR integration experience and can quickly learn unfamiliar source systems.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a Power BI developer position with occasional data engineering responsibilities.

Power BI knowledge is useful, but the primary responsibility is building the reliable data infrastructure underneath reporting, analytics, automation, and AI applications.

We need someone comfortable working at the level of APIs, pipelines, Python, SQL, data models, cloud architecture, security, and production operations.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first year, we want to have a maintainable Microsoft Fabric environment where data from our major systems is automatically collected, validated, standardized, and made available through trusted datasets.

Instead of analysts repeatedly extracting and cleaning data manually, the organization should be able to rely on centralized datasets with clearly defined metrics and lineage.

The platform should also be designed so additional sources, analytics use cases, automation, and AI capabilities can be added over time without rebuilding the underlying infrastructure.

**Why This Role Is Different**

You will be joining at the beginning of our data platform build rather than maintaining an architecture that has already been established.

You will have significant influence over the architecture, engineering standards, data models, and technologies that become the foundation for how the organization uses data going forward.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building systems, solving difficult integration problems, and owning a data platform end-to-end.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Data Engineer
description:
**OUR STATEMENT**  
The San José State University Research Foundation (SJSURF) is committed to building a work environment where everyone can show up as their own self and have an opportunity to contribute, develop, and advance in their career. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are core values of the organization. We strive to attract, retain, and develop employees who reflect the community and society where we work and live. The Research Foundation aims to develop a culture where everyone feels welcome, shares their views, and where differences in backgrounds and perspectives are seen as adding value.

The Data Engineer supports SJSU's Campus Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence initiatives through the development, integration, and maintenance of enterprise data solutions. The position contributes to the development and maintenance of data pipelines and data models that integrate information from multiple university systems into trusted, governed data platforms used for institutional reporting, analytics, and data-driven decision-making.  
  

**GENERAL NATURE OF POSITION**

Working under the guidance of senior technical staff, the Data Engineer applies knowledge of computer science, information systems, database technologies, programming, data architecture, and cloud-based data platforms to develop and support enterprise data solutions. The position works with technical teams and university stakeholders to analyze requirements, troubleshoot data and system issues, design technical solutions, document business and technical requirements, and support vendor and locally developed systems.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Develop, test, implement, and maintain data pipelines and integration processes that extract, transform, and load data from multiple enterprise source systems into SJSU's data warehouse and analytics platforms.

2. Develop and maintain SQL queries, database objects, data transformations, and data models in support of reporting and analytics requirements.

3. Apply programming and scripting languages such as Python, Java, SQL, or similar technologies to develop, maintain, and support data solutions.

4. Analyze source-system data structures, relationships, and business rules to support integration into enterprise data platforms.

5. Troubleshoot data pipeline, integration, database, and production data issues by reviewing SQL queries, source data, system logs, application logic, and code; collaborate with senior developers and other technical teams to resolve more complex issues.

6. Develop and maintain processes to validate data quality, integrity, consistency, and completeness.

7. Develop and deploy scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions in cloud environments to support analytics and business operations.

8. Support data solutions using relational databases, cloud computing environments, data lakehouse technologies, and platforms such as Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.

9. Apply established data architecture, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, metadata management, and database design principles when developing and maintaining data solutions.

10. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, application developers, system administrators, and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical data requirements and solutions.

11. Support analytical methodologies including segmentation, statistical analysis, regression, forecasting, data mining, and predictive modeling as appropriate.

12. Provide production support for applications and data solutions, ensuring SLA compliance through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

13. Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and information useful for university decision-making.

14. Support the team in building trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders through reliable, accurate data work.

15. Follow IT policies and standards for maintaining consistency across SJSU campus.

16. Stay current on technology trends and proactively share learnings with the team..

**INTERPERSONAL CONTACTS**

Reports to the Project Director. Interacts with SJSU Information Technology regularly.

  

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

None; however, the position may provide technical direction, advice, or mentoring.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Experience**

Required

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical or quantitative field that includes coursework in programming, databases, data structures, systems analysis, statistics, or comparable computing disciplines.
* 1 + year of professional experience in data engineering, database development, software development, data integration, data analytics development, business applications, or a closely related technical field.
* Experience through professional employment or internships applying programming, database, data integration, and/or data analytics principles to information systems.
* Experience using SQL and programming or scripting languages such as Python or Java.
* Experience with relational databases or data platforms such as Oracle, Snowflake, or Databricks.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform.  

Preferred

* Master’s in Computer Science (Software Engineering), Business Administration, or closely related technical or quantitative field.

* Experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes and micro-batch data pipelines.

* Experience with visualization and analytics platforms such as Tableau, Looker, AWS QUICK, or comparable technologies.

Exposure to agentic AI, speech-to-text, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technologies.  



**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Required**

* Professional knowledge of programming, database systems, data structures, data integration, and data engineering concepts.
* Working knowledge of relational database concepts and SQL, including the ability to develop and troubleshoot database queries.
* Knowledge of programming or scripting such as Python, Java, JavaScript, bash script, cron syntax, or similar technologies.
* Working knowledge of data pipeline development, data transformation, ETL/ELT, metadata, and data warehousing concepts.
* Knowledge of cloud computing and modern data platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache AIrflow, or comparable technologies.
* Ability to analyze SQL, source data, application logic, system logs, and code to identify and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Ability to work with data from multiple source systems and apply technical requirements and business rules to data solutions.
* Knowledge of software and systems development lifecycle methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
* Working knowledge of application development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production-support practices.
* Knowledge of analytical concepts including statistical analysis, data mining, forecasting, regression, and predictive modeling.
* Ability to analyze structured and unstructured datasets using appropriate technical and analytical methods.
* Ability to prepare and maintain technical documentation, including data mappings, requirements, integration logic, and operational procedures.
* Ability to communicate technical information and collaborate effectively with technical staff and university stakeholders.
* Ability to analyze technical problems, identify potential solutions, and escalate or collaborate on complex issues as appropriate.
* Ability to learn and apply emerging technologies related to data engineering, analytics, databases, and cloud computing.
* Some experience or coursework in data mining, forecasting, deep learning, machine learning, or predictive modeling is a plus
