title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Posted Monday, September 28, 2026 at 12:00 AM

**TRISURA GUARANTEE INSURANCE COMPANY**

At **Trisura**, we expect more because we believe it can be done better.

We are a young, growth-oriented team with a commitment to exceptional talent and have been one of the fastest-growing North American specialty insurance firms since 2006. Our growth and our entrepreneurial style, niche market position and development opportunities ensure that our people see the results of their commitment reflected in the company’s success.

We are currently seeking a driven and collaborative Senior Data Engineer to join our forward-thinking Data and Analytics team.

**SENIOR DATA ENGINEER**

**Position is onsite in Oklahoma City – Remote is not available**

  

**Position Overview:**

As a Senior Data Engineer on our Data & Analytics Team, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions. The role will help modernize Trisura’ s data platform, enable trusted analytics and reporting, and establish engineering standards across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, data quality, and documentation.

Working closely with Data & Analytics, application teams, architects, analysts, governance, and business stakeholders, the Senior Data Engineer will translate business requirements into reusable data products and production-grade solutions across Microsoft Fabric, Azure, SQL Server, Power BI, and related technologies.

  

**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support scalable batch and near-real-time data pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, SQL Server, Azure SQL, cloud storage, and other enterprise data sources.
* Develop modern data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric capabilities such as Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Copy Jobs, Notebooks, Dataflow Gen2, and related services, applying layered bronze/silver/gold architecture patterns where appropriate.
* Develop robust, reusable ETL/ELT and data transformation solutions using T-SQL, Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL, including incremental loading, Change Data Capture (CDC), schema evolution, reconciliation, restart/recovery, idempotency, and error-handling patterns.
* Design dimensional, relational, and Lakehouse data models that support analytics, operational and regulatory reporting, self-service analytics, and downstream system integrations.
* Ensure production reliability by implementing monitoring, alerting, logging, data quality controls, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, auditability, and operational support procedures.
* Optimize SQL, Spark, pipeline, and storage workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency while applying security and privacy best practices, including least-privilege access, managed identities, service principals, secrets management, secure connectivity, and environment separation.
* Implement source control, automated deployment, and CI/CD practices using Git, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft Fabric deployment capabilities, and participate in code reviews, testing, release planning, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and post-implementation reviews.
* Develop reusable engineering standards, frameworks, templates, patterns, and technical documentation to improve consistency, maintainability, and operational support across the data platform.
* Partner with Power BI developers, analysts, business stakeholders, Data Governance, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into trusted, well-structured data solutions and clearly communicate dependencies, risks, and technical trade-offs.
* Support the modernization and migration of legacy SSIS, SSRS, Azure Data Factory, SQL-based, and other data integration workloads to strategic cloud and Microsoft Fabric platforms.
  

**What You Bring:**

  

**Core Skills:**

* Strong ownership, accountability, and a focus on delivering reliable, maintainable data solutions.
* Ability to lead technical design discussions, mentor other engineers, and promote engineering best practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and independently drive work from requirements through production support.
* A collaborative and customer-focused mindset when working with business stakeholders, analysts, developers, architects, vendors, and operational teams.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root-cause analysis, automation, and continuous improvement.
  

**Technical Expertise:**

* Advanced SQL and T-SQL skills, including complex querying, stored procedures, views, indexing, execution-plan analysis, performance tuning, and query optimization.
* Strong Python skills for data engineering, automation, testing, API integration, and file processing, with hands-on experience in PySpark and Spark SQL preferred.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Delta tables, pipelines, notebooks, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database/Managed Instance, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Key Vault.
* Strong understanding of modern data architecture and engineering patterns, including data warehousing, Lakehouse architecture, dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, ETL/ELT, incremental processing, and enterprise data integration.
* Experience with Git-based source control, branching and pull-request practices, automated testing, CI/CD, and environment-specific configuration and deployment.
* Experience designing secure data solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, role-based access control, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.
* Knowledge of data observability and governance practices, including logging, monitoring, alerting, pipeline metrics, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, data quality, retention, reference/master data, and audit requirements.
* Working knowledge of Power BI and semantic model consumption patterns; experience with DAX is considered an asset.
* Experience integrating enterprise databases, REST APIs, JSON, CSV, Parquet, Delta, SFTP, and other file-based or application data sources.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and legacy Microsoft technologies such as SSIS and SSRS is an asset, particularly in modernization and migration initiatives.
* Ability to develop clean, modular, testable, maintainable, and well-documented production-quality code.
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in data engineering, data integration, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or related roles, including ownership of production data solutions.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering end-to-end data solutions rather than only developing individual ETL components or reports.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex production data issues and improving platform reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, code review, solution design, or engineering standards is strongly preferred.
* Experience in Insurance or another regulated financial-services environment is strongly preferred.
* Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Engineer, Azure, Power BI, or related Microsoft certifications are considered an asset.

description:
Job Ref:

10026440

Location:

Adelphi, MD

Category:

Data Analytics

Type:

Full time

**Senior Analytics Engineer**

**Analytics**

**Exempt Regular 3.4**

**Location: Adelphi, MD**

  
  

The Senior Analytics Engineer owns the analytics-ready layers of the University's Databricks Lakehouse, transforming curated data into business-ready models and establishing the semantic layer that defines authoritative institutional metrics. This role sets the modeling standards the analytics team builds against, partners directly with business stakeholders to define and govern metrics, and leads the data work behind traditional reporting, AI-powered analytics, and natural language query capabilities. Advanced SQL and Python proficiency are required.

  
  

Duties and Responsibilities

  
  

* Architect, build, and maintain Gold and Platinum layer data models in Databricks, establishing the design patterns, grain, and business logic the team builds against, and optimizing transformations for performance and cost.
* Own and govern the semantic layer using Databricks metric views, establishing authoritative institutional metric definitions in partnership with business stakeholders and managing version control and downstream impact as those definitions change.
* Lead the curation of datasets, metric views, metadata, instructions, and certified SQL examples that support Databricks AI Genie Agents and AI/BI dashboards; evaluate agent accuracy and drive improvements through model and semantic changes.
* Establish and administer data quality, validation, and reconciliation practices against systems of record; resolve discrepancies to root cause; and define governance, lineage, and access standards through Unity Catalog.
* Maintain and optimize Amazon Redshift reporting assets, determine the appropriate platform for new development, and lead migration of legacy assets to Databricks.
* Provide technical leadership through code review, modeling standards, and mentoring of analytics staff, while supporting analytical and reporting requirements through ad hoc SQL development, data validation, and Tableau development as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.
  

  

Competencies:

  
  

* Analytical Thinking
* Technical Leadership & Mentoring
* Data Governance & Stewardship
* Business Partnership
* Problem Solving
* Continuous Improvement
* Communication & Influence
* Quality & Accuracy
  

  

Skills:

  
  

* Advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), incremental processing, and performance tuning.
* Python programming for data transformation, automation, and testing using PySpark and/or pandas.
* Databricks expertise including Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, notebooks, Workflows, declarative pipelines, Unity Catalog, and Medallion Architecture.
* Semantic and metric layer design, governance, and change management.
* Dimensional data modeling, star schema design, slowly changing dimensions, and metric development.
* Amazon Redshift administration and optimization.
* Tableau development and dashboard design.
* Git-based version control and development practices.
* Natural language analytics and AI-enabled data platforms.
* Establishing modeling standards, naming conventions, and code review practices for a team.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical and executive audiences.
  

  

Education & Experience Requirements:

  
  

Education:

  
  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  
  

Experience:

* Seven (7) to ten (10) years of experience in data, business intelligence, or analytics disciplines, including five (5) or more years building and maintaining production data models and datasets consumed by business intelligence tools and business users in a cloud data warehouse or Lakehouse environment.
* Experience developing, governing, and maintaining semantic or metric layers supporting enterprise reporting and analytics.
* Experience with Databricks, SQL, Python, dimensional data modeling, and data governance practices.
* Experience establishing modeling standards, conducting code review, and mentoring data professionals.
  

  

Certifications:

* N/A
  

  

Preferred Experience Requirements:

  
  

Education:

Master's Degree

  
  

Experience:

* Experience with Databricks metric views and supporting Databricks AI Genie Agents or similar natural language analytics platforms.
* Experience migrating legacy data warehouse environments, including Amazon Redshift, to modern Lakehouse architectures.
* Higher education experience supporting enrollment, retention, student lifecycle, academic operations, or related functions.
* Experience with PeopleSoft, D2L, Salesforce, and FERPA-regulated data.
* Experience with dbt or comparable transformation frameworks.
* Advanced Tableau dashboard and visualization development.
  

  

Certifications:

* Databricks, Tableau, AWS, or other relevant analytics and cloud platform certifications.

All submissions should include a cover letter and resume.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Description -**
Job Description
  
  
The mission of our Big Data Platform is strategically aligned and critical to enabling the new HP data strategy to unlock the power of data across the company.
  
  
We are leading the evolution of the common big data platform for Print and 3D which is an essential component of the Print Digital Ecosystem. Our organization partners across HP to build and operate a number of big data pipelines and data product solutions to drive business insights.
  
  
In this role, you will be working with Data Architects, Product/Program Managers, and other Experts to strategically accelerate the Big Data Platform for delivering enterprise data across the HP ecosystem.

This role is responsible for deployment through all software development lifecycle stages across distributed systems with a goal of using industry standards and continuous improvements in release processes to ensure scalability and consistency. The role ensures that software applications meet high-quality standards, and implements testing and quality control processes to prevent defects and ensure a positive user experience. * Troubleshoot issues during testing and production, catching and solving before launch

* Experience with K8s
* Experience with CI/CD
* Experience with Python

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or equivalent

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**OUR COMPANY:**
EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.
  
  
We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.
  
  
**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic and innovative team. In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain the infrastructure, automation, and systems that support the development, deployment, and reliability of our software applications.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Infrastructure Automation: Design, build, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or CloudFormation to streamline provisioning and configuration of cloud and on‑prem resources.
* CI/CD Engineering: Create, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and deployment tools such as Argo CD to automate build, test, security scanning, and release workflows.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Deploy, scale, and operate workloads on Kubernetes (Cloud and On‑prem). Experience with OpenShift is a strong plus.
* Observability & Monitoring: Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems using Splunk, AppDynamics, and related tools to proactively identify, diagnose, and resolve issues.
* Security & Compliance: Apply DevSecOps best practices, ensure adherence to security standards, and implement automated security controls and compliance guardrails.
* Collaboration & Enablement: Work closely with Engineering, Operations, QA, and Security teams to streamline development workflows and promote DevOps best practices.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to junior DevOps engineers to foster team growth.

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**

* 6+ years of proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, including senior-level responsibilities.
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub for version control, branching strategies, workflows, and repository management.
* Strong proficiency in Terraform for IaC.
* Expertise with GitHub Actions and Argo CD for CI/CD.
* Proficiency in scripting languages including Bash, Python, and JavaScript.
* Deep experience working with Kubernetes (Cloud and On‑premises); OpenShift experience is a plus.
* Experience with Ansible for configuration management.
* Strong understanding of monitoring and logging platforms such as Splunk and AppDynamics.
* Familiarity with security best practices, DevSecOps principles, and compliance frameworks.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
* Generative AI experience is preferred (integrating AI workflows, automation, or AI-driven tooling).

*The EOS pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, market data, or other laws.*
*EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non-merit factor.*
Pay Range
  
  
$130,000—$140,000 USD

title: DevOps Engineer, Mid
description:
**Job Number: R0251641**
DevOps Engineer, Mid
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
As a DevOps engineer, you know how to set up cloud environments and provision computer networking, storage, and virtual networks, ultimately how to “harness the cloud”. We’re looking for a DevOps infrastructure engineer like you to support our clients as they modernize their IT infrastructures and meet their most challenging missions.
  
  
As a DevOps infrastructure engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll work closely with cloud architects and engineers to manage server configuration for modern cloud solutions. You’ll sharpen your skills within a DevOps framework to establish or provision virtual machines or networks and use cloud service providers to further your clients’ meaningful missions.
  
  
With access to our internal innovative labs, there’s no better place to expand your skills and explore different ways of solving our clients’ challenges. Whether helping to develop, deploy, or manage IT infrastructures for crucial server and network components, here you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips.
  
  
Join us. The world can’t wait.
  
  
**You Have:**

* 3+ years of experience with software development
* 2+ years of experience building and administering compute instances and services in the cloud and on-premises for development, test, and production environments
* Experience with container orchestration and application containerization using Kubernetes and Docker
* Experience scripting, testing, and deploying new versions of cloud services and infrastructure, including design and management of automation playbooks such as Ansible
* Experience developing tools, services, processes, and workflows to ensure DevOps pipelines are available
* Knowledge of Linux administration and networking
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools used to build, evaluate, test, and deploy services, including Kubernetes-based distributions
* Ability to ensure solutions are security compliant

* Bachelor’s degree

* Experience using AWS services such as EC2, S3, and EKS

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Drive DevOps Excellence Globally**
You will be part of a team of a global and cross-functional team of Product Owners, Solution Architects, Software Engineers and DevOps Engineers. In this highly challenging and motivating environment, you will drive the implementation of and the operations of core technical components and CI/CD pipeline of Hilti Cloud. This includes continuously supporting and improving the CI/CD pipeline, Infrastructure-as-Code modules, platform observability and operations for the core components and exploring new technologies to drive technical changes. You will be part of Agile team with the mission to professionalize Hilti Cloud as the platform for accelerating Hilti's software delivery and innovation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive technical implementation and operations of core technical components, platform interfaces and security interfaces and CICD pipeline such as API Management platform, web reverse proxy, web application, web services, content delivery network and web application firewall.
* With Product Owner, Solution Architect and other Developers, define and deliver feature and operational improvements following Hilti’s Enterprise Architecture and Security principals.
* Provide support to Product development teams by setting up CI/CD pipeline, infrastructure, monitoring, operations, coordinating and performing releases, and provide 2nd/3rd level support for the solutions.
* Coordinating and performing evergreen activities with Product development teams.
* Continuously explore new technologies and solutions and drive technical change on Hilti Cloud.
* Continuously explore and drive improvements in terms of new technologies and solutions on Hilti Cloud platform.
* Stay up to date on trends in technology in general focusing on Observability, Software Architecture & Security, and Cloud Computing topics.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Management or in similar fields Master/PhD is a bonus (CGPA > 3.0 or similar grading is a must)
* 5+ years professional experience as a DevOps Engineer, SysOps Engineer, Software Engineer, API Engineer, or similar role with proven experience in software development and operation roles
* Proven experience in following technologies is a must: microservices architecture, AWS and public cloud, REST APIs design, Pub/sub and event-drive architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code
* Proven hands-on experience with one or more programming languages (Java preferred), scripting language and CI/CD & DevOps tooling (GitLab, Terraform, ECS) using modern technologies
* Experience in working within agile teams, and comfortable with continuous delivery environment
* Excellent analytical capabilities, ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders, highly committed, self-driven, and customer oriented
* Team player with hands on mentality and able to set priorities to craft a direction, while able to work independently
* Passionate and constantly learning about new software technology and architecture

**What’s In It for You**
In addition to a competitive base salary and bonus potential, we offer a robust benefits package including a generous paid time off policy that includes vacation, personal days, health & wellness, and 2 days per year to give back in your local community, paid family leave, educational reimbursement, 401(k) matching, medical/dental/vision coverage, and a variety of other benefits to fit the needs of our employees.
  
  
**Why Hilti**
Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
  
  
**Commitment to Inclusion**
At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

invites you to bring your pioneering spirit to our collaborative teams. As a
*DevOps Engineer*

located in either

A DevOps engineer in Northrop Grumman’s Space Systems division enables rapid, reliable delivery of mission‑critical software that powers satellites, ground stations, and launch‑vehicle controls. They design and operate secure, automated CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure‑as‑code on hardened cloud and on‑premise environments, ensuring compliance with aerospace standards, stringent safety requirements, and real‑time telemetry monitoring. description:
Location: Dallas, San Antonio
  
  
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer with 4 to 8 years of hands-on experience in CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code, cloud platform provisioning, Kubernetes-based deployment automation, release governance, observability integration, and secure delivery practices. The successful candidate will support enterprise platform build and operations programs, including API management platforms such as Apigee, by implementing reliable automation and repeatable deployment pipelines.
  
  
The engineer will work with platform architects, Apigee platform engineers, cloud infrastructure teams, security teams, application developers, testing teams, and operations teams to build standardized pipelines, automate infrastructure provisioning, enable APIOps workflows, and support production-grade release and support processes.
  
  
****Your Key Responsibilities****
**CI/CD Pipeline Design & Delivery**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application, platform, infrastructure, and API management deployments using enterprise-approved DevOps tools.
* Implement pipeline stages for build, validation, quality checks, security scans, artifact packaging, environment promotion, deployment approvals, and rollback.
* Support Apigee proxy, shared flow, product, environment configuration, and platform configuration deployments through reusable APIOps automation patterns.
* Maintain release templates, deployment runbooks, pipeline documentation, and environment-specific configuration standards.

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**

* Develop and maintain Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, shell, Python, or equivalent automation for cloud, Kubernetes, network, security, and platform components.
* Implement reusable IaC modules with secure remote state, variable management, tagging, policy checks, approvals, and environment parameterization.
* Automate provisioning and configuration of Kubernetes namespaces, service accounts, secrets, ingress objects, monitoring agents, and platform dependencies.
* Apply Git-based workflows for code review, branching, release tagging, change traceability, drift detection, and configuration lifecycle management.

**Cloud & Kubernetes Platform Support**

* Support deployment automation across GCP, AWS, Azure, hybrid, or on-prem cloud platforms as per platform architecture and client standards.
* Assist with Kubernetes platform operations including deployment validation, pod health checks, ingress routing, resource controls, autoscaling readiness, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with cloud and network teams for DNS, load balancer, firewall, private connectivity, certificate, and backend endpoint dependencies required for releases.
* Support environment readiness for Dev, Test, UAT, Performance, Production, DR, and migration wave deployments.

**DevSecOps, Compliance & Release Governance**

* Integrate code quality, secret detection, IaC scanning, container image scanning, dependency scanning, and policy-as-code controls into delivery pipelines.
* Ensure pipeline controls support required approvals, segregation of duties, audit evidence, deployment logs, and traceability for regulated enterprise environments.
* Implement secure handling of credentials, service connections, tokens, certificates, secrets, and deployment identities using approved vault or secret management tools.
* Support vulnerability remediation tracking, security exception documentation, and compliance evidence collection for platform-owned components.

**Observability, Reliability & Operations Enablement**

* Automate deployment and configuration of monitoring, logging, alerting, metrics, and dashboard components using approved observability stacks.
* Support integration with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, cloud-native logging, APM, and SIEM platforms based on project standards.
* Create operational scripts and runbooks for health checks, deployment validation, rollback, certificate checks, smoke testing, and release support.
* Participate in incident troubleshooting, RCA support, pipeline failure analysis, release issue resolution, and production readiness validation.

**Migration, Cutover & Hypercare Support**

* Support platform migration waves by preparing deployment pipelines, environment configuration, routing changes, validation automation, and rollback scripts.
* Coordinate with API, platform, testing, security, and operations teams during release windows, cutover activities, coexistence runs, and hypercare support.
* Maintain deployment evidence, release notes, known issue logs, operational handover documents, and KT material for support teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in a related discipline
* CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, or equivalent enterprise deployment platforms.
* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or equivalent tooling, including modules, variables, remote state, workspaces, and environment promotion.
* Kubernetes deployment automation and operations basics including YAML, Helm, Kustomize, namespaces, services, ingress, secrets, config maps, RBAC, and logs.
* Cloud platform exposure in GCP, AWS, Azure, or hybrid/on-prem environments with understanding of IAM, networking, DNS, load balancers, and security controls.
* Scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar languages for build, release, validation, and operational tasks.
* DevSecOps controls including code quality, IaC scanning, container image scanning, secret scanning, artifact management, and approval gates.
* Git-based development practices including branching, pull requests, tags, merge strategies, code review, and release traceability.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and support experience in enterprise production environments.

Our client is an established, growing healthcare SaaS company providing mission-critical software that healthcare professionals rely on every day. Its platform supports core functions including electronic health records, practice management, billing, scheduling, and payments.

With new leadership, fresh growth capital, and ambitious plans for the next stage of growth, the company is at an inflection point. This is not an early-stage startup—it is an established market leader focused on long-term value creation and scaling the team, product, and infrastructure needed to support continued growth. The company is assembling a team that matches the opportunity. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd like to hear from you.

**About the Role**

The
**DevOps Engineer**
will own and evolve the company’s cloud infrastructure—the backbone that keeps its customers online and operational every day.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role sitting at the intersection of infrastructure reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence. You’ll work closely with the engineering team while independently driving the maturity of the AWS environment, CI/CD pipelines, containerization strategy, and observability platform.

This isn’t a maintenance role. There is a solid foundation in place, and the company needs someone who can scale it. You’ll bring engineering rigor, automation, and modern DevOps practices to a platform that’s growing fast.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain AWS infrastructure with a focus on reliability, security, and cost efficiency
* Own and modernize CI/CD pipelines to accelerate safe, frequent software delivery across all product lines
* Lead containerization efforts and drive Kubernetes or ECS adoption to improve deployment consistency and scalability
* Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform across all environments
* Build comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and observability systems; own incident response for infrastructure events
* Establish cloud cost management practices—baseline spend, identify optimization opportunities, and implement savings
* Maintain a HIPAA-aware security posture including access controls, encryption standards, audit logging, and vulnerability management
* Manage virtual desktop infrastructure (AWS WorkSpaces, AppStream, or equivalent) for internal teams and contractors, including provisioning, imaging, and access control
* Support hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure, including hands-on Azure work alongside the primary AWS environment
* Partner closely with software engineers to embed DevOps practices into the development lifecycle
* Document infrastructure architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures to support team resilience

**What We’re Looking For**

This role is a strong fit for someone who:

* Takes accountability for infrastructure uptime, performance, and security
* Has a builder mentality and can assess the current state, design a better target state, and execute the transition without waiting to be directed
* Is comfortable operating as the primary infrastructure owner while collaborating closely with a software engineering team
* Has proven experience designing and managing AWS infrastructure at scale, with hands-on Terraform IaC proficiency
* Has 4+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience with direct ownership of production environments
* Has a track record of building or modernizing CI/CD pipelines that measurably improved deployment frequency, reliability, or developer experience
* Has experience containerizing applications and managing workloads in Kubernetes or ECS
* Has strong scripting ability in Bash and/or Python to automate operational workflows
* Has experience implementing monitoring and observability platforms with on-call incident response processes to match

**Qualifications & Experience**

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
Job Location
  
  
This is an onsite role based in Nashville, TN.
  
  
**About The Job You're Considering**
The Associate Data Engineer supports the design, development, testing, and maintenance of data integration solutions that enable reliable, scalable, and secure movement of data across enterprise platforms. Working under guidance from senior team members, the Associate Data Engineer develops ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and workflows while ensuring adherence to data quality, security, and governance standards. This role provides an excellent foundation for building expertise in cloud data platforms, analytics, and modern data engineering practices.
  
  
Your role
  
  

* Develop and maintain ETL/ELT jobs, workflows, and data pipelines.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading from multiple source systems.
* Create and execute unit tests, integration tests, and data validation scripts.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and assist in issue resolution.
* Monitor data pipelines and troubleshoot data processing issues.
* Perform data cleansing, profiling, and validation activities.
* Develop SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts to support reporting and analytics.
* Assist in implementing data quality controls and governance standards.
* Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Collaborate with solution architects, business analysts, and senior data engineers in Agile delivery teams.

**Skills And Experience**

* 2 years of experience in data engineering, software development, analytics, or related technical roles.
* SQL development and query optimization.
* Basic Python programming and scripting.
* Understanding of relational databases.
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts.
* Basic understanding of data warehousing concepts.
* Knowledge of data quality and validation techniques.
* Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

**Preferred**

* Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar platforms.
* Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Airflow, Data Factory, Informatica, Talend, SSIS, or equivalent data integration tools.
* Exposure to Spark, Hadoop, or Kafka.
* Knowledge of DevOps and DataOps practices.

title: Big Data Engineer
description:
**About Agero:**

Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way. Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

**Note:**
**For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.**

**Role Description and Mission
:**

Agero is seeking a Data Engineer who is passionate about data and eager to make a meaningful impact. You will design, build, and maintain the core data infrastructure that powers our analytics. In this role, you will collaborate directly with product, engineering, and business professionals to deeply understand our operational business model and translate it into effective data solutions. A major focus of this role will be supporting our finance data modeling, specifically managing data integrations for our current ERP system (EBS) and driving the upcoming migration to Workday. We are looking for an engineer who prioritizes code reusability, scalable architecture, data governance, and CI/CD best practices to deliver reliable, high-quality, and secure data.

**Key Outcomes**
: 

* Develop and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines focused on our core stack of Snowflake and AWS.
* Build modular, scalable data models using dbt Core, designing a Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) that transforms raw ingestion feeds into curated, business-ready data marts.
* Work cross-functionally with business stakeholders to understand source systems and downstream consumption needs, translating complex financial workflows into reliable data solutions.
* Write reusable, efficient, and scalable code in Python and SQL.
* Enforce strict data governance and security best practices, including implementing RBAC across pipelines to protect critical financials and ensure compliance.
* Implement data quality control by establishing automated testing frameworks, data observability, and comprehensive documentation to ensure safe data democratization.
* Monitor cloud costs by analyzing resource usage and performing query optimization in Snowflake.

**Skills, Education and Experience
:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field and 3-5 years of industry experience
* Extensive experience with Snowflake and proven expertise in designing scalable data solutions in AWS.
* Deep expertise in dbt Core, Medallion architecture principles, dimensional modeling techniques, and complex data transformations.
* Proven experience with finance data modeling and a strong understanding of enterprise ERP systems (experience with Oracle EBS and/or Workday is highly preferred).
* Strong understanding of data governance, security protocols, and RBAC to securely handle and protect sensitive enterprise financial data.
* Advanced SQL skills for querying databases and proficiency in Python for data processing.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and implementing CI/CD pipelines for safe, automated deployments.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Hiring In:**

* United States: Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, New Hampshire, New York State, New Mexico, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia

The anticipated closing date to submit applications for this role is November 1, 2026. Join our Greenhouse Candidate Portal to track your application status and receive instant alerts for future openings.

The base salary range presented represents the anticipated low and high end salary range for new hires in this position. Your final base salary will be determined based on factors such as work location, experience, job related skills, and relevant training and education. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package provided by Agero to employees.

National Pay Range: $120,000 USD - $150,000 USD

**Life at Agero:**

At Agero, you'll find a workplace where your unique perspective is not just welcomed, it's celebrated. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we're committed to creating an environment where every employee feels a sense of belonging. If you're looking for a company that values your individuality, provides opportunities for growth, and champions open communication, Agero is the place for you. Join our team and help us drive the future of driver assistance, while experiencing a workplace where you can truly thrive.

**Benefits Built for Well-being:**

Agero’s innovation is driven by a workforce where all associates feel like they can truly thrive. Agero offers a wide range of benefits to promote well-being, encourage personal development, and ensure financial stability. Our benefits include:

* Health and Wellness: Healthcare, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and mental health benefits for associates and their families.
* Financial Security: 401(k) plan with company match and tuition assistance to support your future goals.
* Work-Life Balance: Flexible time off, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually.
  + For Contact Center Roles: Accrual of up to 3 weeks Paid Time Off per year, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually.
* Family Support: Parental planning benefits to assist associates through life’s milestones.
* Bonus/Incentive Programs

Join Agero and experience a workplace that invests in your success both personally and professionally.

***\*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full‑time basis. This position is not eligible for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.***

***\*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to required or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.***

title: SQL Data Engineer
description:
**Job Number: R0251527**
SQL Data Engineer
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
As organizations collect increasing volumes of data from various sources, effective data engineering is essential to producing reliable insights and supporting mission-critical decisions. As a SQL developer and data engineer, you will help design, develop, and optimize data solutions that support federal health programs, regulatory science, and other high-impact missions.
  
  
You will apply advanced SQL skills and hands-on Databricks experience to build scalable data pipelines, data models, and analytics-ready datasets. You will collaborate with data engineers, analysts, software developers, data scientists, and client stakeholders to integrate data, improve data quality, and deliver secure, high-performing solutions.
  
  
This role requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
Work with us to use data for good.
  
  
Join us. The world can’t wait.
  
  
**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting complex SQL solutions, including queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and data transformations, in Oracle SQL, PostgreSQL, and Databricks SQL
* 2+ years of experience with Databricks, including Databricks Workspace, notebooks, jobs, workflows, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and cluster configuration
* Experience with relational databases, data modeling, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and designing and implementing medallion architecture patterns
* Experience integrating data from databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, JSON, XML, and flat files
* Experience in developing data engineering solutions in Python and managing code through Git or comparable source-control tools
* Experience implementing automated testing, data validation, data reconciliation, and data-quality processes
* Ability to translate solutions across different SQL dialects and database environments
* Ability to work independently in an Agile, collaborative, and client-focused environment, troubleshoot complex issues, raise questions proactively, communicate potential risks, and recommended actions to management early
* Public Trust
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Biostatistics, or Mathematics

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with advanced Databricks capabilities, including Delta Live Tables, Workflows, and Unity Catalog
* Experience developing and optimizing data transformation workflows, including ETL and ELT processes supporting reporting, analytics, or operational systems
* Experience with Pentaho or equivalent data integration and ETL tools
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and software development practices for data solutions
* Experience applying AI-enabled tools or techniques to improve data engineering workflows, pipeline performance, or developer productivity
* Experience with data governance, metadata management, data lineage, privacy, security, and access controls
* Experience supporting federal health data systems, regulatory science, or other regulated data environments
* Databricks, AWS Cloud, or Data Engineering technical Certification

**Vetting:**
Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client; Public Trust determination is required.
  
  
**Compensation**
At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
  
  
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.
  
  
**Identity Statement**
As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
  
  
**Candidate AI Usage Policy**
AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on
**your**
own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited
**unless permission is explicitly provided**
.
  
  
**Work Model**
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
  
  

* Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
* Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
* Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

**Commitment to Non-Discrimination**
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

title: Data Engineer
description:
D.A. Davidson Companies is an independent, employee-owned company with a rich history spanning 90 years. We are dedicated to conducting our business in accordance with the highest standards of integrity and ethics, and delivering outstanding service to our clients and each other. We support a friendly, open and supportive culture, and encourage candid communication and productive engagement that make our companies and each of us better. Just as we work to improve our clients’ financial well-being, we also work to strengthen local communities—and giving back is one of our core values. You can learn more about our company culture and impact in our latest annual report.
  
  
**Summary:**
Data Engineer is responsible for expanding and optimizing our data and data pipeline architecture, as well as monitoring, troubleshooting and performance tuning data flows used in the collection, integration, and provisioning of data. This role requires experience building data pipelines and optimizing entire data systems as well as greenfield opportunities. This role works alongside other software development teams, database architects, data analysts and end users on complex data initiatives, and ensures our data delivery architecture is consistent with best practices.
  
  
**Company Overview:**
D.A. Davidson Companies is an independent, employee-owned company with a rich history spanning 90 years. We are dedicated to conducting our business in accordance with the highest standards of integrity and ethics, while delivering outstanding service to our clients and coworkers. We support a friendly, open and adaptive culture, and encourage candid communication and productive collaboration across throughout the firm. Just as we work to improve our clients and employees’ well-being, we also work to strengthen local communities—and giving back is one of our core values.
  
  
**Qualifications:**

* 5 or more years of Data Engineering experience in an oversight capacity
* Extensive domain-specific experience in the Financial Services industry
* Experience with Microsoft cloud-based technologies in a hybrid architecture
* Advanced working TSQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring, stored procedure development, end-to-end data pipeline development
* Experience performing operational analysis on internal and external data and processes to uncover failure points and identify opportunities for improvement
* Strong analytic skills related to working with complex, multi-layered data pipelines and dependent datasets
* Experience facilitating calls to capture end-user requirements with technical and non-technical users
* Holistic awareness of processes supporting data preparation, metadata, dependencies, lineages, compliance and workload management
* Understanding of data modeling concepts like:
* Conceptual data modeling
* Logical data modeling
* Relational data modeling
* Dimensional and multi-dimensional data modeling
* Understanding of meta-model and metadata management requirements
* Specific skills include:
* Extensive experience with SQL syntax
* Experience designing and implementing data structures and interfaces for applications and business processes
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric: pipelines, notebooks, Lakehouse/Warehouse concepts, and Medalion architecture
* Experience with relational database platforms: preferably MS SQL Server
* Experience with data pipeline tools such as: SSIS and Azure Integration Services
* Experience using orchestration tools such as: ActiveBatch
* Experience with web services and API integrations
* Experience with scripting languages such as: Python and Powershell
* Experience with Agile, DevOps and DataOps methods and technologies: Source Code Control, Versioning, Test Automation, Continuous Integration, Automated Deployment, Recoverability, Telemetry, etc
* Commitment to maintain client confidentiality and data security
* Communicate in a clear and service-oriented manner; use appropriate, professional language and grammar to effectively exchange ideas and information
* Ability to proactively work with both external and internal clients; relate with others in a professional manner to accomplish work responsibilities and objectives
* Ability to maintain regular, predictable attendance

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement and maintain a robust, efficient and compliant data pipeline architecture
* Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc
* Build and maintain a service-based architecture for the publication of consumable data and information objects
* Work with data architects and data analysts to enhance and evolve the data environment
* Work with Business and IT stakeholders to assist with data-related technical issues and support their data and information requirements
* Define and develop frameworks, guidelines, best practices and examples to ensure data structures and integration processes are accurate, compliant and secure
* Facilitate the development and implementation of data quality standards, data protection standards and adoption requirements across the enterprise
* Define indicators of performance and quality metrics and ensure compliance with data related policies, standards, roles and responsibilities, and adoption requirements
* Work in an on-call rotation to monitor, troubleshoot and resolve data integration alerts and failures

**What we offer:**
Competitive salary plus excellent benefits and perks including, but not limited to:
  
  
  

* Medical, Dental and Vision
* Company 401(k)and ESOP contribution
* Generous sick, vacation, and maternity/parental leave
* Paid holidays
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Reimbursement ($15,000 lifetime cap)
* Discounted personal insurance including home, auto and recreational vehicles
* Charitable gift-matching program
* Davidson Day of Giving – Our tradition of positively impacting communities in which we live and work

The potential base pay hiring range for this role is $73,500 – $117,900 annually. The compensation offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis considering a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the skills, relevant work experience, and geographic location of each specific candidate.
  
  
At D.A. Davidson, we are committed to fostering a diverse environment that supports the development and inclusivity of all employees.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Mesh**
At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!
  
  
**Overview**
Mesh moves money across hundreds of exchanges, wallets and chains. The data that flow generates is now a product in its own right: clients want to see their conversion, volume and settlement data, Finance needs reporting they can sign, and our own teams answer most questions by asking an AI agent instead of filing a ticket. You'll own how we define, instrument, validate and ship that data, working hands-on in SQL and Python and building the guardrails that let AI agents query our data safely.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own product and client analytics. Define core metrics (conversion rates, transaction success rates) and maintain the central Amplitude data with reusable, templated charts. Build internal and external dashboards for clients.
* Run experiment readouts. Baseline and read out A/B tests on the flow (UI variants, algorithms) and turn results into product decisions.
* Prove migrations with data. Build apples-to-apples comparisons between platforms so decisions move on evidence, not gut feel.
* Guard data integrity. Run and automate daily reconciliation triage and the verification engine.
* Shape instrumentation. Define backend event schemas and the tracking plan, and normalize fields so the data is clean enough for analytics.
* Build finance-grade reporting. Deliver settlement and billing reporting on Microsoft Fabric / Power BI with parity validation, alerting and self-serve access for Finance.
* Make data AI-native. Build skills and tools for our internal data agent, log and audit agent-generated SQL, and keep the self-serve data channels accurate.
* Turn data into client products. Help shape self-serve reporting, reconciliation and billing exports that clients pay for.

**Who You Are**

* Expert in SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server and Spark SQL a plus) and solid in Python
* Hands-on with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar), including event design and funnel/CVR modeling
* Comfortable with experiment design and statistics for A/B readouts
* Experienced building data quality checks, reconciliations or backfills on production data
* In the habit of validating numbers against source systems before anyone else sees them
* A clear writer who can explain a data issue to an engineer, a CRO and a client in the same day
* A daily user of AI coding and analysis tools
* ~3+ years in analytics or data engineering
* ~5+ years with end-to-end ownership of a data domain.

The compensation range provided may span multiple career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on factors including a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. For candidates outside of New York or San Francisco, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market and location-based pay band. The base salary range listed excludes commission (if applicable), equity, and benefits. The pay range represents the minimum and maximum target for new-hire compensation. Actual compensation may vary and may be higher or lower depending on individual circumstances.
  
  
Pay Range
  
  
$180,000 - $200,000 USD
  
  
**Why You’ll Love It Here**
At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.
  
  
**In-Office Expectations**
Employees based in our
**San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore**
hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.
  
  
**How We Care For Our Team**
We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.
  
  
We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.
  
  
Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Marketplace
description:
**About Faire**
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
  
  
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you passionate about using data and AI to shape the future of Faire's product features for small and medium businesses (SMBs)? If so, we want to talk to you! We're looking for a technical leader in our team to work closely with Data Scientists, Product Analysts and Software Engineers to support product launches and roadmaps by designing and building data capabilities that inform and drive insights. You will lead the path in using AI to boost productivity and transform how analytical engineering operates—leveraging AI to streamline data pipeline development and operations, improve data consumption workflows, and automate routine analytical tasks. In this role, you'll see a direct link between your work, company growth, and user satisfaction. You'll work with A tier players, work with one of the richest data sets in the world, use cutting-edge technology, and see your efforts affect products and SMBs regularly.
  
  
Join us and be part of a team that values data-driven innovation and excellence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The ideal candidate will possess a perfect blend of analytics and data engineering expertise, along with strong skills in developing and supporting large-scale, high-performance data storage and processing systems. They should have a proven track record of collaborating with key stakeholders to execute on company-wide data initiatives.
  
  

* Lead cross-team and/or multi-phase projects from design through implementation, fostering collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Lead the technical execution in building scalable data models and pipelines for a domain defining the architecture, feature requirements, roadmap.
* Build data pipelines with rigorous approaches to data quality, validation, testing, and observability.
* Redefine how we build, maintain, and scale data systems by embedding AI into our daily workflows.
* Optimize processes for operational excellence in project management and system reliability.
