title: Analytics Engineer, Data Platform
description:
Proper Hospitality builds and operates a growing collection of luxury lifestyle hotels, restaurants and residences defined by design, culture, wellness and a strong sense of place, across Proper Hotels, By Proper and The Collective.  
  
**Position Overview**  
We're seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our corporate team in Los Angeles. Our warehouse and core raw pipelines are built. Your job is to keep them healthy, make them easy to use, and strengthen the foundation for AI-native work like workflows and data agents.  
  
This is an end-to-end, full-stack role focused primarily on data pipelines and  
foundations, with a front-row lens into how the hospitality industry runs.  
  
***What You'll Do***

**Maintain & Improve Our Pipelines (Core of the Role)**

* Monitor, triage, and resolve data pipeline bugs and failures, and find root  
  causes rather than patching symptoms
* Manage the intake and prioritization of data issues and requests, and keep stakeholders informed
* Keep data models, tests, and documentation current so the warehouse stays trustworthy
* Spot recurring failure patterns and build monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks to prevent them

**Build Internal Tooling & Infrastructure**

* Design and deploy tools and infrastructure that let teams access and work with data in our data hub
* Automate repetitive operational work (backfills, access provisioning,  
  validation, reconciliation)
* Own the deployment and configuration of the supporting services behind  
  these tools

**Build the Foundation for AI-Native Work**

* Make sure data is clean, well-modeled, secure, and documented enough to support AI workflows, data agents, ML, and advanced analytics
* Partner with analysts, data scientists, and operators to productionize datasets, features, and agent-ready data
* Help make AI tools usable and trustworthy for non-technical operators

**Support Stakeholders**

* Respond to data requests from Finance, Revenue, Marketing, Operations, and property teams
* Translate business questions into the right data answers, and know when  
  something needs a new model rather than a one-off query
* Document institutional knowledge such as data quirks, definitions, and lineage

**Occasional Analytics Work**

* Build and maintain reports and dashboards as needed

**Learn the Business from the Ground Up**  
The best data work comes from understanding the operations behind the  
numbers. Expect to:

* Take part in site visits to our properties
* Join training sessions and hands-on operator learning experiences
* Spend time with the front desk, F&B, events, and revenue teams to see how the systems you support are used day to day

***What We're Looking For***  
  
**Ideal Background**

* 3+ years of experience in data engineering, or 5+ years in data science or  
  analytics
* New grads 12 years of experience in a data or analytics role) will be  
  considered if they demonstrate extremely strong proficiency, extraordinary tenacity, and genuine humility

**Required**

* Strong SQL and deep, hands-on experience with Snowflake, including building and operating pipelines with orchestration (tasks, streams, dynamic tables, or an external orchestrator)
* Experience building data pipelines and models that others depend on  
  Python (or a comparable language) for tooling, automation, and pipeline work
* Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD, or a willingness to learn it quickly
* A methodical approach to debugging: you reproduce, isolate, and find the root cause
* Strong fundamentals in coding and systems design that you can demonstrate without AI assistance
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and the judgment to manage competing requests

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with a range of business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Sigma, Power BI)
* Experience with our stack:
  + Snowflake security and governance: RBAC design, masking policies, row-level access, and data sharing
  + GitHub Actions for orchestration and deployment, alongside native  
    Snowflake orchestration
  + Transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt) and ingestion tools
  + Python services deployed on a cloud hosting platform, and infrastructure as code
  + Hospitality source systems: property management Infor HMS, F&B point of sale Toast, sales CRM, HR, and revenue management  
    Experience building with LLMs, agents, AI-powered workflows, or internal data apps
  + Data modeling and dimensional design, plus testing and observability practices

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: Take ownership of the issue queue and stakeholder requests. You learn the stack, visit a property, and become the person teams go to when something looks off.
* First 90 days: Help generate new, value-additive work: new datasets,  
  analyses, or interactive data tools that give the business something it didn't have before.
* First 6 months: Raise the quality of our data pipelines and make a major  
  change to our core Snowflake platform to make it more scalable, with  
  improvements across data security, data modeling, cost management, or  
  rollout infrastructure.

**Our Interview Process**  
We want to see how you think, so part of our process is a technical assessment  
completed without AI assistance. You should be able to work through a systems design discussion and a basic coding exercise on your own. We use AI heavily in our day-to-day work and expect you to as well, but strong fundamentals are what let you direct it well and catch it when it's wrong. Beyond that, expect conversations about your past work and how you approach stakeholders and ambiguity.  
  
**Logistics**

* In-person hybrid at our Santa Monica, CA office, 3 days per week
* Occasional travel to our properties for site visits and training
* **Compensation**: $140,000-160,000, based on experience and skills

  

***Proper Perks & Benefits***

**Culture of Growth & Belonging**

* **Culture of Growth**: A collaborative, design-forward environment that values creativity, intelligence, and curiosity — where learning and excellence are a daily practice.
* **Guided Skills Development**: Access to training, leadership programs, mentorship, and cross-property mobility to encourage achievement and discovery.
* **Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging**: We honor individuality while fostering a culture of respect and belonging across all teams.
* **Community Engagement**: Opportunities to give back through local volunteerism, sustainability, and charitable partnerships.

**Health & Wellness**

* **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision plans through Aetna, designed to fit a range of personal and family needs.
* **Wellness Access**: Company-subsidized memberships with Equinox and ClassPass, plus wellbeing
* workshops and mental health resources.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**: Confidential support for emotional wellbeing, financial planning,
* and life management through Unum.

**Time Off & Flexibility**

* **Paid Time Off**: Flexible PTO plus 11 paid holidays each year for corporate team members.
* **Paid Parental Leave**: Paid time off for eligible employees welcoming a new child through birth, adoption, or foster placement.
* **Flexible Work Practices**: Hybrid schedules for eligible roles and an emphasis on work-life balance.

**Financial Wellbeing & Core Protections**

* **401(k) Program**: Company match of 50% of employee deferrals, up to the first 4% of eligible compensation.
* **Employer-Paid Life & Disability Insurance**: Core protections with optional additional coverage.
* **Financial Education**: Access to planning tools and workshops to support long-term stability and growth.

**Lifestyle & Travel Perks**

* **Hotel Stay Benefits**: 75% off BAR (floor of $100) across the Proper portfolio.
* **Design Hotels Partnership**: 50% off participating Marriott Design Hotels.
* **Dining Discounts**: 75% off food & beverage at all Proper Hos

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Data Engineer**
**Location: Philadelphia, PA (Center City)**
Health Union powers the first and largest community-based activation and data platform, transforming healthcare by providing unparalleled support, information, and validation for millions navigating complex health conditions and their care teams. With over 125+ condition-specific online communities and 15 years of community leadership, Health Union’s authentic engagements fuel the company’s robust suite of endemic media, influencer marketing, market research, and data solutions, driving proven outcomes for patients, HCPs, and brands.
  
  
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help build and evolve the data pipelines and platform capabilities that power our enterprise data environment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Enterprise Data Platforms and working closely with our data engineering pod leads and team members, you will design and build robust data pipelines, implement data models, and ensure the reliability, quality, and compliance of the data we deliver. You will be a hands-on senior engineer who executes against the technical direction and roadmap set by our data leadership.
  
  
Strong hands-on expertise with Snowflake and core AWS data services is essential. Experience with dbt, Python, and advanced SQL is highly valued, along with solid performance-tuning, optimization, and data-validation skills.
  
  
**What You Do**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using AWS, Snowflake, Python, and dbt, from ingestion through transformation and delivery.
* Translate functional requirements into clear technical designs and well-structured, high-quality code, complete with unit testing and documentation.
* Implement and evolve data models and transformation layers (dbt on Snowflake), following the standards and technical direction set by data leadership.
* Optimize data workflows for performance, scalability, cost, and reliability.
* Safeguard the accuracy and integrity of our data through meticulous analysis, rigorous testing, data profiling, and problem resolution.
* Support data security, governance, and privacy practices to ensure appropriate use of data and compliance with company policies.
* Partner with analytics, software engineering, product, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver sound, maintainable solutions.
* Participate in code reviews and share knowledge with peers to help maintain a high bar for engineering quality.
* Contribute to quarterly and sprint planning for Data Engineering activities, and communicate progress and trade-offs clearly across project teams.
* Automate and improve aspects of our data platform to enhance efficiency and output.
* Stay current with technologies and best practices in the data engineering space, and bring ideas back to the team.

**Qualifications**
**What You Bring:**

* 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with strong, recent production experience on Snowflake and core AWS data services as the primary platform, for example S3, Lambda, MWAA/Apache Airflow for orchestration, and streaming/ingestion services such as Kinesis or Snowpipe. Familiarity with a solid subset is what matters; depth over breadth.
* Working knowledge of dbt for data modeling and transformation, Python, and advanced SQL (stored procedures, analytic functions), or the demonstrated ability to ramp quickly.
* Strong command of modern data engineering and data warehousing concepts, including relational and non-relational databases, data streams, and file stores, and of performance tuning, query optimization, data profiling, and validation.
* Experience building and maintaining reliable, well-tested data pipelines, with sound QA, testing, requirements-gathering, and documentation practices.
* Experience implementing CI/CD practices for data pipelines is a plus.
* Understanding of data security, governance, and compliance principles as they apply to data platforms.
* Openness to learning and adopting AI-driven data platform practices and agentic workflows as this becomes a growing team focus; willingness to lean in matters more than extensive prior expertise.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, analytics, product, and business partners.
* A self-motivated, proactive mindset, strong logical reasoning, and a love for learning, with an eagerness to keep growing your skills and take on more as opportunities arise.
* Experience in healthcare, ad tech, programmatic audiences, or related industries is a plus. Familiarity with clean-room environments/integrations and adtech partners (SSPs, DSPs) would be a plus.
* AWS and/or Snowflake certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate, SnowPro) are an advantage.

Annual base salary for positions at this level and job group is $95,000-$131,000, and your base pay will depend on the qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies required for this job.
  
  
At Health Union, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range that provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.
  
  
In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, a professional development budget, and paid time off available to full-time employees upon hire. You will also be granted time off for designated company-paid holidays, summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  
  
HEALTH UNION REALLY IS THE BEST PLACE TO WORK
  
  
As a dynamic organization that offers flexible work options, we foster a workplace that encourages an authentic, respectful culture of teaching and learning. We work hard and save space to form close-knit relationships that are meaningful to us individually. Health Union also offers top-tier benefits and other perks to full-time employees, starting day one. We cultivate a dynamic, collaborative work environment that values inclusion, community, excellence, and transparency. But don’t just take our word for it: The Philadelphia Inquirer, Philadelphia Business Journal, Inc., and Forbes have all named Health Union a “best place to work”-and we take pride in living up to that hype every day.
  
  
Commitment to Inclusion
  
  
At Health Union, we believe that individually we make a statement, but collectively we make an impact. Diversity and inclusion power that impact. We strive to create a sense of belonging by embracing our differences. We are an organization where everyone is valued, heard, and appreciated. Health Union encourages applicants from historically marginalized populations to consider our team as your next opportunity for change. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and advancement regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or gender expression, Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
To comply with federal law, Health Union participates in E-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E-Verify process after hire.
  
  
The position offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of two in-office days per week. Our office is located in Center City, Philadelphia.
  
  
Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the U.S for any employer.
  
  

* Candidates only. No direct calls or emails. No recruiters/agencies, please.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
***JOB SUMMARY***

The Data Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the university’s modern data platform, including data pipelines, data models, integrations, and analytics-ready datasets. This role supports Southeastern University’s ability to make timely, accurate, and informed decisions by ensuring that institutional data is reliable, accessible, secure, and well-governed.

This position works closely with Information Technology, Enterprise Applications, Data Analytics, Institutional Research, Enrollment, Advising, Financial Aid, Student Success, Finance, Advancement, and other university stakeholders to transform complex operational data into trusted data assets. The Data Platform Engineer will play a key role in helping the university move from reactive reporting and manual data processes toward a more proactive, customer-focused, and decision-driven data culture.

The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, service-minded, and able to bridge the gap between complex systems, institutional business processes, and practical data solutions.

***ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS***
----------------------------------

*Reports to:*Executive Director Enterprise Services

*Supervisory Responsibility:*N/A

*Indirect Supervisory Responsibility:* N/A

***ESSENTIAL DUTIES -****May include, but is not limited to the following:*

Data Platform Development

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that move data from core university systems into the university’s data warehouse, lakehouse, or analytics environment.
* Develop and maintain data models using SQL, dbt, and related modern data platform tools.
* Create reusable, governed, and analytics-ready datasets that support reporting, dashboards, operational workflows, and institutional decision-making.
* Support the continued development of the university’s data warehouse/data lake architecture.
* Build data structures that enable self-service analytics, AI-enabled workflows, and faster access to institutional insights.

Data Integration and Transformation

* Integrate data from university systems such as the student information system, CRM platforms, LMS, finance systems, advancement systems, housing systems, and other enterprise applications.
* Transform raw operational data into clean, standardized, and trusted data models.
* Translate business rules, source system logic, and operational processes into clear data transformations.
* Partner with application owners and business stakeholders to understand data definitions, system behavior, and reporting needs.
* Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicate records, missing fields, and process-driven data quality issues.

Data Governance, Quality, and Documentation

* Develop and maintain documentation for data models, pipelines, business definitions, lineage, and transformation logic.
* Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and testing practices to increase trust in university data.
* Support institutional data governance practices, including data stewardship, access control, data classification, and consistent definitions.
* Promote standards for naming conventions, version control, deployment processes, and data modeling practices.

**Preferred Education:**

title: Data Engineer
description:
Position Title: *Data Engineer*

**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without sponsorship.**

**Reporting Structure:**
========================

This position will be part of the Data Engineering group, reporting to the Director of Data Engineering.

**About the role**

John Burns Research and Consulting (JBREC) is a housing research and consulting firm. Builders, investors, and lenders use our data to make decisions about where and what to build. That data has to be right, consistent, and explainable.

We are hiring a Data Engineer to help build our governed analytics layer in dbt. You will turn legacy SQL Server logic into tested, documented dbt models. You will also implement the metrics behind our client data feeds, dashboards, reports, and AI-assisted analytics tools, and recommend how they should be structured.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most of your time will go to data modeling and metric implementation. The rest will go to keeping our newer pipelines reliable.

**What you'll do:**

**Build the governed model layer (about 50%)**

* Build and maintain dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers, following team conventions for naming, grain, and documentation.
* Migrate legacy SQL Server and T-SQL logic into dbt. Reconcile new outputs against existing ones before cutover so client-facing numbers don't move unexpectedly.
* Write tests and data contracts that catch problems before clients or analysts do.
* Document every model so its meaning, source, and owner are clear to anyone who reads it.

**Implement metrics in the semantic layer (about 25%)**

* Partner with research and data science to turn agreed business definitions into precise, testable implementations with explicit grain, dimensions, and calculation logic.
* Recommend how metrics should be structured and implemented, and flag inconsistencies or ambiguities in existing definitions.
* Maintain metrics in our semantic layer as the single source for client data feeds, dashboards, PDF reports, and natural-language analytics tools.
* Help retire legacy reporting by moving its metrics onto the governed layer one at a time.

**Keep our newer pipelines reliable (about 25%)**

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines on our modern stack for third-party vendor data and public data such as Census releases.
* Own day-to-day reliability for those pipelines: monitoring, alerting, triage, and runbooks that let anyone on the team resolve issues.

**Throughout**

* Work in Git with code review and CI. Review teammates' code and expect yours to be reviewed.
* Use AI coding tools effectively within our review and governance standards.

**What you bring**

* 3+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, including at least 2 years building production dbt projects.
* Strong SQL and dimensional modeling. You can explain why a model has the grain it has and what breaks if it changes.
* Hands-on experience with dbt testing, documentation, and project structure at scale (dozens to hundreds of models).
* Experience migrating legacy SQL (stored procedures, views, T-SQL) into a modern transformation layer, including validating that outputs match.
* Working Python for ingestion, automation, and tooling.
* Comfort with Git-based workflows: branches, pull requests, code review, CI.
* Clear writing. You document your work so others can use it without asking you.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with a semantic layer or metric framework (dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, Cube, LookML, or similar).
* Experience supporting natural-language or AI-assisted analytics, where metric definitions must be unambiguous.
* Familiarity with Azure data services and SQL Server.
* Experience with housing, real estate, economic, or Census data (ACS, PUMS, building permits).

  

**How we work**

You'll join the Data Engineering team within JBREC's technology organization, which also includes Software Engineering, Data Science, and IT. We treat governance as code: definitions, tests, and documentation live in the repository and go through review, rather than in separate catalog tools. You'll work closely with our research team, who are the experts on what the numbers mean.

**Each full-time employee receives:**

* $12,500 towards our comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, and flexible spending accounts including gym memberships and vacation assistance.
* Company contributes 5% of their salary and profit sharing to their 401(k), even if they do not contribute.
* 30 days of Paid Time Off including 3 weeks of personal time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays, and 5 paid days for our Winter Break when the company shuts down to rejuvenate.

Compensation and title will be based on skills, experience, and abilities, which can vary by person.

**We cannot hire anyone who requires sponsorship to work in the United States.**

Disclaimer: Nothing in this job description restricts the company’s right to assign responsibilities to this job at any time as critical features of this job are subject to change at any time.

title: DevOps Engineer – Security Focus
description:
Description:

Our Engineering Department exists at the core of our organization. This analytical and innovative team works diligently to ensure clients’ needs are exceeded through the creation and delivery of transformative technologies.

We are seeking an early-career DevOps Engineer with a focus on security to help protect Bectran’s AWS environment and platform while supporting the broader DevOps team with infrastructure and deployment initiatives. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly capable, and committed to continuous learning and professional growth. Relevant experience may come from internships, academic work, or independent projects; however, we place the greatest value on strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability. This individual will proactively research and resolve issues independently, take full ownership of projects as an individual contributor, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**What You Will Do:**

* Monitor and triage security alerts from CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, and AWS security services, escalating potential incidents as needed.
* Use Datadog to review security logs, investigate unusual activity, and help improve alert quality.
* Track vulnerabilities (CVEs) affecting our technology stack and follow up with engineering teams on fixes.
* Support SOC 2 compliance by gathering audit evidence, maintaining documentation, and verifying security controls.
* Assist with routine security maintenance such as IAM reviews, certificate renewals, and WAF rule updates.

Since its inception in 2010, Bectran has pioneered cost-effective credit management and accounts receivable automation solutions for all sizes of organizations. Bectran’s SaaS solutions — credit, collections and accounts receivable — provide seamless user experiences across various industries and empower users with robust credit evaluation services, providing more oversight, control and efficiency to companies of all sizes.

Our dedication to improving the efficiency of the order-to-cash cycle has helped companies cut down the time to process and approve credit by over 90% while significantly lowering the risk of default. We are committed to helping businesses make the transition to powerful SaaS technology solutions that save you time and money.

In accordance with Illinois' pay transparency requirements, we are committed to providing clear compensation information. The pay range for this position is $70,000 to $85,000 annually. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are subject to change based on evolving market conditions or business needs.

* 100% paid medical coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield (choice of PPO and HSA plans).
* 100% paid dental, vision, and life insurance through Principal.
* Options to participate in Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) plans.
* Short-term and long-term disability (STD/LTD) plans available for employee election through Principal.
* Retirement savings plan with a 401(k) offering Roth and traditional contributions through Principal.
* 15 days of Paid time off (PTO) and 8 holidays off annually.

**EEO Statement:**

Bectran is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, we comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Bectran embraces diversity and promotes a culture of equity and inclusion where every individual is empowered to thrive. Employees are valued for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is reflected in our company policies and practices and is a fundamental principle of how we conduct business.

**Application Instructions:**

To apply, please submit resume through the listed posting or at our webpage: https://recruiting.paylocity.com/recruiting/jobs/All/e1e0b11b-1e4a-4390-8ed5-be5ffdff3a33/Bectran-INC. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled or the posting is removed.

Applicants with disabilities may contact us at hr@bectran.com to request reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.

As Bectran continues to expand in the Fintech SaaS industry, we are seeking intelligent, energetic, and skilled individuals to join our Engineering team. If you are ready to grow your career in DevOps and security at an industry-leading company, we want to hear from you!

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **AWS Cloud Engineer** to join our Team, becoming responsible for ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of critical platforms that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

  

This person will provide day-to-day customer application support, maintain infrastructure, monitor systems, resolve incidents, while implementing automation to improve operational efficiency. They will also collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and other cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and deliver secure, scalable solutions.

  

This role requires strong AWS DevOps expertise, application support experience, problem-solving skills, and a proactive approach to optimizing our analytics infrastructure.

  

**Work Location:** This is a remote position

  

**What You Will Do:**

* Design and build AWS cloud infrastructure using IaC (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI)
* Guide ADTs on cloud solution patterns, deployment strategies, and architecture decisions; able to influence design choices and align stakeholders
* Own automation end-to-end; from IaC authorship to pipeline design to production operations
* Participate in on-call rotation and contribute to observability/monitoring practices
* Provide technical support and guidance to AWS and managed service users
* Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Monitor AWS environments, identify performance or availability issues, and troubleshoot and resolve incidents.
* Collaborate with development, security, and infrastructure teams to implement cloud solutions, improve reliability, and follow AWS best practices.
* Maintain configuration documentation, diagrams and SOP's for all environments
* Perform backups, regularly scheduled upgrades and maintenance activities during the maintenance window
* Monitor for security vulnerabilities and perform ad-hoc upgrades and maintenance as required
* Support audit activities by providing logs, reports, and system configurations
* Manage and support AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), including roles, policies, permissions, and access controls, to maintain secure and compliant cloud environments.

##### **Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

* U.S. Citizenship required with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance.
* Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
* Bachelors Degree and 8 years of experience; a Masters Degree and 6 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 12 years of experience
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of AWS architecture, networking (e.g., VPCs, routing), security (e.g., IAM & Resource Policies, encryption ), serverless/microservice architectures, and containerization (e.g., ECS, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IAC), specifically utilizing advanced Terraform skills
* Proven experience designing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including reusable/shared components for enterprise-scale delivery
* Hands-on experience monitoring, analyzing, and troubleshooting SaaS application logs
* Strong scripting skills Python and Bash, Ansible experience is plus
* Proficient in configuration management, observability (CloudWatch, Grafana), reliability, and disaster recovery practices. Proficient in the design, development, build, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance cloud engineering processes using automation tooling (e.g.,Terraform, Python, GitLab CI) for AWS workloads
* Strong Git proficiency, including common branching/release strategies (GitFlow, etc.)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Runners, as well as Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as CloudFormation
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript/Node.js or other scripting languages to automate, troubleshoot and resolve issues
* Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, and resolving high-priority incidents in large, multi-tenant environments.
* Exemplary communication, analytical skills, and technical knowledge across the client environment.
* Experience working in an Agile environment

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Solutions Developer - UCL Data Platform
description:
This role is **four** days onsite at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week

**Overview:**
=============

The Senior Developer is responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation, and production support of data integration and processing solutions supporting the UCL data platform and its upstream and downstream consumers. The role works primarily with Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW), SQL/PLSQL, Oracle Cloud/OCI, data integration pipelines, and enterprise data sources, with responsibility for moving and transforming financial data through controlled development and release processes.

  

The position requires a developer who can independently analyze complex data requirements, design efficient SQL and data-processing solutions, troubleshoot data and performance issues, and work across Finance, Technology, architecture, testing, and vendor teams.

**Primary Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain **SQL/PLSQL and Oracle ADW-based data processing solutions** , including complex queries, transformations, views, extracts, and data-loading processes. UCL's current integration model includes ADW as a core processing/data platform and requires developers to work directly with substantial SQL and extract logic.
* Develop and support **ETL/ELT and data integration pipelines** between enterprise data sources and Oracle ADW, including Snowflake-to-ADW integration and other upstream/downstream data movements.
* Analyze source-to-target requirements, data mappings, transformation logic, filters, joins, reconciliation rules, and downstream extract requirements. The existing UCL process requires integration of incoming datasets into the UCL table structure/unified layer and subsequent creation of downstream extracts.
* Partner directly with downstream consumers to understand **data requirements, required fields, filters, frequency, timing, validation criteria, and delivery expectations** , reducing unnecessary handoffs between development teams.
* Investigate and resolve **data-quality, transformation, reconciliation, and SQL defects** , determining whether problems originate in source data, business logic, integration logic, or downstream processing.
* Troubleshoot **Oracle ADW performance** , including long-running SQL, execution plans, CPU/I/O contention, parallel execution, temporary-space utilization, and other database bottlenecks.
* Design solutions capable of supporting increasing **data volume, processing frequency, batch-runtime, and SLA requirements** , including the movement from monthly toward more frequent/daily processing.
* Support integration between UCL and technologies/platforms such as **Oracle DIS, Oracle DFCS, Snowflake, Workiva, Axiom, Alteryx, OCI, and other enterprise data sources/consumers** as required by the application architecture.
* Participate in **development, unit testing, SIT, UAT/CERT, release, deployment, and production validation** , ensuring changes can be promoted safely through DEV, TEST/SIT, CERT/UAT, PREPROD, and PROD.
* Diagnose production and lower-environment issues involving **SQL logic, data discrepancies, interfaces, batch processing, performance, configuration, and data dependencies** , and work with appropriate teams through resolution. UCL/FDI delivery history shows active developer involvement in defect remediation, testing, SIT/review transitions, and release readiness.
Provide technical guidance and code/design review for other developers and help identify inefficient, incorrect, or unsustainable implementation approaches before they reach higher environments.  

  

**Development & SDLC Responsibilities:**
----------------------------------------

### **The role is not just an SQL developer. Developers operate within a controlled enterprise SDLC:**

* + Create and maintain Jira Stories/Tasks for development work and ensure work is associated with the appropriate **Jira Feature** .
  + Participate in refinement and provide technical analysis and estimates before development begins.
  + Maintain traceability between requirements, development, testing, architecture, and deployments. Feature IDs must be represented in the Solution Architecture Document, and development changes must remain traceable through the promotion lifecycle.
  + Participate in technical and architecture reviews and identify assumptions, dependencies, risks, constraints, and design issues early enough to prevent downstream rework.
  + Keep Jira work current as code/configuration progresses through **development testing review deployment** .
  + Support documentation necessary to promote application objects/configurations/code through controlled environments.

* Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
* Promote an environment that supports a culture of belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
* Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
Complete other related duties as assigned.  

  

**Scope of Technical Responsibilities:**
----------------------------------------

**Strong / hands-on**

* Oracle SQL
* PL/SQL
* Oracle database development
* Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW)
* Complex SQL optimization and performance tuning
* ETL/ELT development
* Data integration and transformation
* Source-to-target mapping
* Data reconciliation and validation
* Large-volume/batch data processing
* Relational database concepts and dimensional/data-model concepts

**Working knowledge / desirable**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Oracle DIS / enterprise data-movement technologies
* Snowflake
* REST APIs / Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS)
* Workiva/Wdata integrations
* Axiom
* Enterprise schedulers / batch processing
* Jira
* Git / source control
* CI/CD and automated deployment practices

**Education and Experience Required:**
--------------------------------------

* Associate’s degree and a minimum of 5 years' solutions development and/or relevant enterprise technology experience or a Bachelor's degree and minimum of 3 years' solutions development and/or relevant enterprise technology experience or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 7 years' education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 3 years’ solutions development and/or relevant enterprise technology experience
Advanced proficiency in a minimum of one relevant platform  

  

**Education and Experience Preferred:**
---------------------------------------

* Advanced analytical skills specific to solutions development
* Experience working in a team environment
* Ability to work autonomously
* Ability to multitask on complex projects
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Proficient verbal and written communication skills
* Experience working in an agile framework to meet business objectives

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $97,100.00 - $161,800.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

**Location**
============

Buffalo, New York, United States of America

title: Data Engineer
description:
540 is looking for a Data Engineer to develop data transformation and workflow solutions supporting an impactful U.S. Army modernization initiative. You will help deploy and operate a cloud-based replacement for a legacy financial system while developing innovative, cloud-first solutions that strengthen the Army's data management ecosystem.

In this role, you'll design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-native data solutions, with a focus on data reliability, security, governance, and performance. You'll work with large, complex datasets, contribute to technical design decisions, and collaborate across engineering teams to transform business and mission requirements into working software.

**Location**: Remote within the continental United States, East Coast working hours with some flexibility afforded. Occasional travel may be required (3-4x annually)  
**Citizenship & Clearance Requirement**: per client requirements, must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a DoW Secret clearance  
**Education Requirement:** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related engineering field (preferred)  
**540 Internal Thrive Level:** Data Engineer II or III

**WHY 540?**

540 is a forward-thinking company that the government turns to in order to #GetShitDone. We do more than talk about it, we break down barriers to innovation and build impactful tech. We're looking for someone with big ideas, who thrives on innovation and is a self-starter. If you love to learn about and work with new technologies, we want to talk to you.

**HOW YOU'LL DRIVE IMPACT**

* Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot reliable data pipelines throughout the software development lifecycle, supporting the modernization of legacy U.S. Army financial systems and migration to AWS cloud environments
* Develop Python-based workflows to ingest, transform, validate, and deliver structured and semi-structured data
* Build and support cloud-native data solutions using AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, S3, and CloudWatch
* Integrate data from multiple systems and sources, including APIs and various file formats, while supporting data accuracy, consistency, and reliability
* Work with large datasets, identify performance bottlenecks, and help improve pipeline efficiency and scalability
* Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to decisions around data integration, storage, performance, and scalability
* Implement automated testing, logging, monitoring, and error handling to support data quality and reliable system performance
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code while following established software engineering and DataOps practices
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, and stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into working software
* Support secure data management practices, including access controls, data governance, and compliance with DoW requirements
* Participate in code reviews and Agile development activities, sharing ideas and contributing to engineering improvements
* Document data transformations, pipeline processes, and technical decisions to support maintainability and downstream users
* Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows, reduce manual processes, and strengthen the reliability of the Army's data ecosystem

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 2+ years of related experience in data engineering, software development, data integration, or a closely related field
* Experience developing Python-based data transformations, scripts, or workflow automation
* Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Experience consuming data from APIs and working with file formats such as X12, JSON, flat files, or fixed-width files
* Experience working with AWS cloud services, particularly AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and CloudWatch Logs
* Familiarity with working with large datasets, including identifying and troubleshooting data processing or performance issues
* Understanding of data structures, data modeling concepts, and common approaches to organizing and transforming data
* Experience writing and maintaining automated tests using Pytest or similar testing frameworks
* Familiarity with data validation, error handling, logging, and debugging practices
* Understanding of data security, access controls, and data quality principles
* Experience using GitLab for version control and collaborative development
* Comfortable working through the terminal or command-line interface
* Experience using Jira and Confluence in an Agile development environment
* Ability to interpret ambiguous requirements, file specifications, and JSON structures to develop functional data solutions
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Must currently possess or have the ability to obtain an AWS Cloud Practitioner certification (or higher) within 30 days of hire
* Must currently possess or have the ability to obtain a CompTIA Security+ certification (or higher) within 30 days of hire

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working with DoW systems, data, or other regulated environments
* Familiarity with X12/MILS processing
* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, or other distributed data processing frameworks
* Knowledge of data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions
* Exposure to Infrastructure-as-Code tools, including Terraform or CloudFormation
* Understanding of DevOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines

title: Analytics Engineer, Semantic Layer
description:
**About Us**

Clayco is a full-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power & energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports & entertainment related building projects.

**The Role We Want You For**

Ask three people at a construction company what a job costs to complete and you will get three answers. All of them are defensible. They come from different systems, different assumptions about what is committed versus spent, and different ideas about how far along the work really is.

The semantic layer is where that gets settled. It is the set of governed definitions that say what a Clayco number means; built once, tested, documented, and used by every report, dashboard, and AI agent downstream. A metric here is not a query someone wrote. It is a decision about meaning that somebody owns.

You will build that layer. The work is SQL and modeling discipline, done carefully, on data that matters to people who will notice if you get it wrong.

**The Specifics of the Role**

  

* Build semantic models on our Snowflake platform, with tests and documentation as part of finished work rather than cleanup afterward
* Translate business logic from finance, operations, and project controls into models that hold up when someone audits them
* Move legacy reporting logic onto governed models and help retire what it replaces
* Keep models working as source systems change, so a field change upstream does not quietly break a number people trust
* Answer the definitional questions that come back from the business, and write down the answers

**Requirements**

* **Real SQL.** Window functions, complex joins, and the judgment to know when a query is correct rather than merely returning rows.
* **You care whether a number is right.** Enough to chase down a variance of a few hundred dollars because it means something is wrong with the logic, not because anyone asked you to.
* **You ask until you understand.** The willingness to tell a finance director you do not follow the calculation yet, and keep asking until you do.
* **You can be the person in the middle.** Telling two groups their reports disagree, explaining why, and helping them land on one answer.
* We will hire someone early in their career for this if the fundamentals and the curiosity are there — you would have senior engineers around you to learn from. Dimensional modeling experience, dbt, or construction background are all welcome, none are required.

**Some Things You Should Know**

* Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required.
* No other builder can offer the collaborative design-build approach that Clayco does.
* We work on creative, complex, award-winning, high-profile jobs.
* The pace is fast!
* This position is classified as a safety-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing.

**Why Clayco?**

* 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal.
* 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3).
* 2025 ENR Top 100 Design-Build Firms – Design-Build Contractor (Top 5).
* 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3).

**Benefits**

* Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance.
* Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning & development programs and more!

* The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

title: Founding Data Engineer (Pricing/Comps)
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Data Engineer (Pricing/Comps) based in United States .**
This is an opportunity to establish the data engineering foundation behind reliable pricing for an online marketplace. You will transform inconsistent, noisy sales-listing data from multiple sources into trustworthy comparable items and accurate price estimates. As a founding member of the data engineering function, you will design and own scalable ingestion pipelines, develop entity resolution systems, and build robust valuation logic. Your work will directly influence pricing accuracy, marketplace trust, and the quality of data-driven decisions. You will collaborate closely with computer vision specialists to improve item matching across sources with varying levels of detail. This role is ideal for an experienced data engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building production-grade systems from the ground up, and shaping data strategy in an early-stage environment.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Build, maintain, and own scalable, scheduled data ingestion pipelines that collect sold-listing information from multiple marketplaces and external sources.
* Design and implement entity resolution systems that match inconsistent listing descriptions, text, and images to canonical items.
* Develop pricing and valuation logic that accounts for listing recency, item condition, and the quantity and quality of comparable sales.
* Establish production-grade data quality monitoring to identify data drift, fraud, anomalies, stale listings, and unreliable information.
* Partner with the computer vision lead to define consistent item-matching standards across sources with different levels of detail and data quality.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for data sources, licensing agreements, and third-party pricing feeds.
* Communicate pricing confidence, data limitations, and uncertainty clearly to non-technical stakeholders while balancing accuracy, scalability, and practical business needs.

**Requirements**

* At least five years of data engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale, production ETL processes and data pipelines.
* Experience handling messy, inconsistent, or adversarial data in marketplaces, pricing, fraud detection, or similarly complex data environments.
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data engineering tools such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Spark, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with statistical estimation and pricing models, including regression-based approaches to identifying comparable items and estimating value.
* Demonstrated experience with entity resolution, record linkage at scale, and production data quality monitoring.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound decisions when data is incomplete, ambiguous, or unreliable.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain pricing confidence, uncertainty, and technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with pricing intelligence, data licensing, or early-stage startup environments is a plus.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary: USD $160,000–$220,000.
* Work arrangement: Remote position, with the original listing indicating eligibility in the United States and North America. Candidates based in Canada should confirm their location eligibility before applying.
* Employment type: Full-time.

description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to join the Manufacturing Operations, Transportation Operations, and Reverse (MOTOR) organization in support of our Supply Chain Intelligence team. MOTOR manages the manufacturing of datacenter racks and the movement of racks/parts through the supply chain, consisting of transportation, warehousing, and reverse logistics into and out of the data centers. This role performs helps connect the different systems across the supply chain together so operational teams have clean, actionable data to work with. This requires someone with strong analytic skills and business acumen who can work with stakeholders on strategic projects across MOTOR.
  
  
The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. Must be an expert working with data modeling with un/structured data, ingestion pipelines and ETL design and business intelligence tools with the business to identify strategic opportunities where improvements in data infrastructure creates out-sized business impact. Candidate is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), mentors other engineers in team on high quality tech, and enjoys working in a fast-paced team. Candidate will have a chance to architect the data pipelines needed for optimization and predictive analysis. We're excited to talk to those up to the challenge!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain the infrastructure to answer questions with data, using software engineering best practices, data management fundamentals, data storage principles, recent advances in distributed systems, and operational excellence best practices. Build datasets that analysts and scientists use to generate actionable insights.
* Define the data engineering processes that leverage various AWS services to improve accessibility, redundancy, data integrity, cost, and storage requirements.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* Identify opportunities to improve process automation, automate existing and new processes, maintain and deploy cloud infrastructure, and support the Agile software development lifecycle, including development, testing, and deployment.
* Develop automation solutions using Ansible Automation Platform and Red Hat. Use Python and Ansible with networking technologies, including routing and switching, to manage heterogeneous environments and integrate with internal back-end infrastructure systems.
* Perform daily checks in the EC2 console to confirm all arch\_level mvp EC2 instances are powered on. Respond to and resolve alerts from the operational and security SNS topics.
* Respond to security events and task orders created by the security team. Assist with incident response data gathering and response actions when security incidents occur.
* Monitor Citadel support tickets and address them where appropriate. Contribute to the backend-ansible-playbooks and backend-terraform code baselines based on tickets and the Citadel roadmap established by SZWO leadership. Commit code daily and apply infrastructure changes through Terraform or Ansible after the code has been committed.
* Submit configuration management requests for new features, technologies, additional servers, and network changes affecting the production zone. Coordinate changes affecting security posture, IATT, or ATO status with the security team before testing or introducing them into the AWS account, services, or servers.
* Check the DoD Security SRG webpage daily for changes affecting AWS security services. Perform daily checks of AWS security services, including Security Hub, Config, GuardDuty, and Inspector.
* Create accounts for new Citadel members on Tuesdays and Fridays as approved by the ISSO. Manage group memberships, password resets, and other account actions according to the Account Management policy defined by security.
* Administer GitLab, including weekly license-count checks, backups accounting for data exceeding the stated 400 GB supported limit, and runner deployments based on least privilege and an understanding of runner types. Manage repositories and collaborative version control.
* Use automation to reduce security compliance errors and vulnerabilities and improve GitLab security reporting. Analyze GitLab security scanning results and work with development teams to resolve identified issues.
* Perform root cause analysis for security-related issues in development environments. Investigate and resolve security, technical, and other CI/CD issues, and develop software updates and fixes.
* Assist in establishing and maintaining container standards and enforcing them. Apply industry best practices to incorporate security within a Software Factory.
* Deploy the Manticore security monitoring stack and make performance adjustments through Terraform. Deploy and manage Manticore ICD for cloud Manticore integration.
* Administer KASM and Appgate using privileged accounts, and administer Sonatype Nexus, Sonatype IQ, and Red Hat IDM. Coordinate changes affecting security posture with the security team.
* Check weekly for new releases of Citadel service components. Determine whether and when to apply upgrades and coordinate with the team and configuration management.
* Keep the security team informed of role-based access control (RBAC) and host-based access control (HBAC) changes and explain their security and access implications.

**Education/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in computer science or a similar field of study.
* Six or more years of DevOps engineering experience.
* Previous leadership experience through team leadership, technical leadership, mentorship, or management, with demonstrated ability to support team development and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Ansible automation.
* Strong Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration, engineering, troubleshooting, or automation experience.
* Experience with Git-based repositories, branching, version control, and collaborative development workflows. GitLab experience is preferred.
* Practical experience supporting or deploying resources in AWS. AWS GovCloud experience is helpful but not required.
* At least intermediate knowledge of all Citadel services in AWS GovCloud, including how they operate and how to administer, troubleshoot, and support them.
* Proficient understanding of the DCO-S Security Classification Guide.
* Experience using Terraform for infrastructure as code. Candidates with limited Terraform experience may be considered if they demonstrate strong experience with Ansible, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Git or GitLab, and AWS. Terraform training may be completed before onboarding.
* Experience developing tools and processes for automated builds, regression testing, monitoring, and releases across environments.
* Experience developing and deploying automation for monitoring and observability tools, such as Kibana, Elastic, or Splunk.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving CI/CD pipeline failures or performance issues.
* Experience scripting with Bash and Python.
* Experience with DevOps pipeline tools and technologies, including Jenkins, Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes.
* Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC certification meeting the position’s applicable DoD 8140 requirements.
* Must have an active TS/SCI security clearance.

title: Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This job delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). It involves advising management on project-level issues, guiding junior engineers, operating with little supervision, and applying knowledge of technical best practices. In this role, you will be a key contributor to our AI-powered tooling initiative, designing and building intelligent systems that enhance the productivity, reliability, and velocity of Venmo's Cloud
  
  
Infrastructure and DevOps engineering teams.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
* Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
* Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions

Our infrastructure must be delivered automatically, thoroughly tested, and scanned for vulnerabilities through synthetic tests.
  
  
As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to our critical infrastructure and cloud engineering initiatives under the guidance of senior engineers. You will help build and maintain the tools, automation, and services that power Venmo’s AWS cloud infrastructure.

* Learn and apply best practices in cloud engineering, DevOps, and SRE
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions

* 1+ years’ experience in software development or a related field
* Some experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or container technologies
* Programming and scripting experience (Python, Bash, Go, or similar)

Venmo

0

The Senior Cloud Engineer will advance the University’s mission by delivering exceptional information technology services comprehensively and consistently across customers and stakeholders. This role will execute UCSF’s vision while modeling UCSF’s culture and values.
  
  
**Department Overview**
University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is distinguished as a leading academic healthcare organization, home to groundbreaking discoveries, world-class education, and exceptional healthcare services. Infrastructure Services (IS) is the backbone of the technological infrastructure, assuring the technical services that enable the academic, medical, and research missions of the organization. Beyond a focus on maintaining systems and resolving issues, we are committed to nurturing the potential of our team members and empowering them to excel. UCSF Infrastructure Services provides 24x7 support to the University community, always upholding the highest level of responsiveness and reliability for our customers. IS values innovation and excellence in ensuring secure and efficient Information Technology (IT) services, regardless of the hour or complexity of the issue.
  
  
The Platform Services team within Infrastructure Services is committed to empowering the academic, medical, and research mission of UCSF by ensuring that all customers have seamless, secure, and accessible technological support. The team oversees the management and maintenance of various technology platforms, including system and cloud services, to guarantee they are secure, readily available, and performing optimally. Platform Services handles the management of critical software, such as Epic, ensuring it supports the highest level of medical service delivery by operating at peak performance. The team also oversees data center operations, including server management, storage, and networking equipment, to ensure the reliable delivery of health services. Additionally, it manages databases with a focus on data security, availability, and top-tier performance. All these tasks are critical not only for the smooth operation of the University’s technological infrastructure, but also for enhancing productivity, enabling the provision of high-quality health services and learning, and ultimately, improving patient and student outcomes.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Zero Trust Focus)
description:
**Overview**
Nakupuna Companies is seeking an experienced and hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate our customer's enterprise cloud environments with a focus on Zero Trust principles. This engineer will be a key technical contributor, responsible for implementing and managing cloud infrastructure, strengthening security, and driving automation within DoD-authorized cloud environments. This position is ideal for a proactive engineer who excels at building and securing cloud solutions, can independently troubleshoot complex issues, and can contribute to the strategic direction of the cloud platform.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned.
  
  

* Design, implement, and maintain secure and scalable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or Bicep.
* Apply Zero Trust principles by implementing robust identity and access controls, network segmentation, and continuous monitoring across the cloud environment.
* Implement and manage advanced cloud networking services, including VPCs, transit gateways, private endpoints, and hybrid connectivity.
* Build and operate containerized workloads using services like Amazon EKS or Azure Kubernetes Service, including the implementation of container security best practices.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts (e.g., using Python or PowerShell) to improve operational efficiency, security compliance, and infrastructure management.
* Contribute to the cloud governance framework by implementing and monitoring security policies, compliance controls, and cost management guardrails.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, networking, and security issues, providing expert-level troubleshooting and resolution.
* Integrate security and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines, supporting DevSecOps practices and enabling automated, secure deployments.
* Evaluate and recommend new cloud services and technologies to improve security posture, operational effectiveness, and performance.
* Collaborate with architects and stakeholders to contribute to the cloud technology roadmap and translate architectural designs into functional implementations.

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Strong hands-on experience deploying, administering, and troubleshooting solutions within a major commercial cloud platform (AWS or Microsoft Azure).
* Proficient in core cloud infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, IAM, and security.
* Demonstrated experience implementing cloud security and Zero Trust principles, including IAM/RBAC, least-privilege access, secrets management, and segmentation.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and scripting using technologies such as Terraform, Python, or PowerShell.
* Experience deploying or managing containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and integrating security into engineering workflows.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across cloud infrastructure, networking, and security layers.
* Experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or supporting DoD environments is highly preferred.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM field from an accredited institution, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional IT experience, including at least four (4) years of hands-on experience supporting cloud infrastructure, cloud engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Experience supporting DoD or other Federal IT environments is preferred.

**Certification:**

* Required:

+ Active certification satisfying DoD Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level II requirements, such as CompTIA Security+.

* Preferred:

+ An associate or professional-level cloud certification from a major cloud service provider (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate).

**Clearance Requirement**
s: Must currently have at least a Secret level security clearance (if located in HI) or Top Secret (if located in Virginia). Must be a U.S. citizen.
  
  
**Work Location:**

* Position is based in Arlington, VA or Honolulu, HI.
* Preferred: on-site four (4) days per week. Will consider fewer days on-site for the correct candidate.
* Occasional travel (approximately 1-2 weeks per year) within the Continental U.S. or to Hawaii may be required.
* Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required to support planned maintenance, deployments, upgrades, or incident-response activities.

**Physical Requirements:**
The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation:
  
  

* Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
* Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
* Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.
