Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.
  
  
As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Company Overview:**
**About Us:**
Atlanta-based Incident IQ is the leading workflow management platform built exclusively for K-12 districts. Trusted by over 2,000 districts, Incident IQ powers mission-critical services for more than 12 million students and educators nationwide. By connecting technology and operational workflows, Incident IQ enables schools to streamline processes, reduce administrative burdens, and focus on what matters most: supporting students.
  
  
**Purpose:**
Incident IQ is committed to creating a future where every K-12 district operates with seamless efficiency. When operations are unified on a single platform, districts gain the clarity and control needed to build a stronger foundation for student success. We’re focused on delivering the tools, support, and partnerships that help make that vision a reality.
  
  
**Mission:**
Incident IQ is on a mission to eliminate the friction of disconnected systems and clunky workflows that slow schools down. We’re reimagining the critical work that happens behind the scenes, bringing visibility, efficiency, and impact to the processes that keep classrooms running. By streamlining the complex, automating the routine, and surfacing the insights that matter most, we can create the conditions for educators to teach, students to thrive, and districts to shape the future of education.
  
  
**Senior Data Engineer Overview:**
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Data Engineer to lead the design, architecture, and population of our new BI data warehouse. This role is highly cross-functional and critical to Incident IQ's next phase of growth. You will be responsible for aggregating complex data streams from our core SaaS platform and third-party systems into a centralized data warehouse/lake. You will own the analytics foundation end-to-end, serving as an architect-engineer. This is a genuine greenfield seat: the analytics foundation you build becomes how the company and its customers answer their most important questions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Warehouse Architecture: Design, implement, and scale a modern BI data warehouse/data lake from the ground up. Foundation first — a rudimentary, queryable environment stood up early and built out over time, rather than a spreadsheet-first interim. You will design at a grain that serves internal analytics today and groundwork for future customer-facing analytics.
* Data Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain robust, automated ETL/ELT pipelines to extract and aggregate data from diverse sources, beginning with our Azure-hosted product platform and extending to operational systems (e.g., CRM) and other external APIs as product usage pipelines stabilize.
* Platform Evaluation and Recommendation: Own the written platform recommendation scored on refresh latency, aggregation performance at full volume, schema evolution, tenant isolation, three-year total cost of ownership, and migration cost. You make the case; selection and purchase are joint decisions with R&D and Finance.
* Data Quality & Governance: Establish and enforce data governance, quality checks, and performance optimization practices to ensure high data integrity and rapid query response times. You will own source-system semantics and technical implementation.
* Reliability and Continuity: Own freshness, completeness, and reconciliation against a published refresh SLA. Document to the standard that others can run the full cycle unaided.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: Minimum of 5-7 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, BI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Data Architecture, specifically within a high-growth SaaS environment.
* 0-to-1 Build Experience: You have owned a greenfield data infrastructure initiative end to end rather than contributed to one. Expect to name it and walk through what you built, what you chose against, and what you would do differently.
* Data Warehousing: Deep expertise in modern cloud data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, or AWS Redshift) and data lake architectures.
* Pipeline Development: Proven experience building complex ETL/ELT pipelines using tools like dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or similar orchestration frameworks.
* Database Mastery: Advanced proficiency in complex SQL and query tuning across relational sources (Azure SQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL). Experience integrating a non-relational source such as MongoDB into a relational warehouse is a plus rather than a requirement.
* SaaS Integrations: Hands-on experience extracting and integrating data from enterprise GTM tools such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Marketo, or similar platforms.
* Programming: Proficiency in languages such as Python, Scala, or C# for data manipulation and automation.

Personality & Soft Skills
  
  

* Strategic Builder: You don't just write scripts; you think holistically about how data architecture drives business outcomes and product differentiation.
* Pragmatic and Cost-Conscious: You are comfortable standing up something rudimentary that works and improving it, rather than waiting on the ideal platform. You weigh cost against capability and can defend the tradeoff to a non-technical audience.
* Cross-Functional Communicator: You can translate complex technical data models into plain business language for stakeholders, and vice versa.
* Autonomous Ownership: You thrive in environments where you can take a high-level goal, determine the technical path, and execute with minimal hand-holding.
* Inquisitive Problem Solver: You are naturally curious about how the business operates and how data can be used to uncover hidden efficiencies.
* Collaborative Team Player: Focused on the success of the platform and the company over personal credit.

What This Role Is Not
  
  

* Not Just a Dashboard Developer: While reporting is key, this is a heavy data engineering and architecture role. If you prefer to only build visualizations without touching the underlying pipeline and warehouse design, this is not the right fit.
* Not a Maintenance Role: We are building a new data ecosystem from the ground up. This role requires someone who thrives on creating scalable 0-to-1 solutions rather than maintaining legacy systems.
* Not an Order Taker: You will be expected to advise leadership on data strategy and best practices, not simply execute assigned tickets.

**What makes Incident IQ different:**

* We facilitate whole-person growth where employees can develop personally as well as professionally.
* We offer an energetic and collaborative environment; everyone’s opinion matters!
* We produce software that empowers K-12 schools to run efficiently, allowing for a better classroom experience for students to THRIVE!
* We provide excellent work/life balance. Two amazing offices - a Downtown Atlanta office location and one at Halcyon in Alpharetta!

Incident IQ offers a competitive salary based on experience with a benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k match, and paid-time off (PTO).
  
  
*Incident IQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

title: Sr. Cloud and Python Developer
description:
**Description**
Spatial Front, Inc. (SFI) is seeking an
**Sr. Cloud and Python Developer**
to support our growing modernization team. SFI was recently awarded the 2025 USA Today National Top Places to Work award and the 2025 Washington Post Top Workplaces.
  
  
As part of a modernization effort at Census, an enterprise analysis system will be migrated to AWS-based services, including AWS Lambda, AWS Glue, and containerized workloads. The initiative will also involve converting legacy SAS code to Python, replacing Java-based services with AWS serverless solutions developed in Python, and leveraging PostgreSQL as the primary database platform.
  
  
This transformation represents a significant shift from the current technology stack and requires expertise in cloud-native architecture, AWS services, Python development, containerization, database modernization, and DevSecOps practices. A Sr. Cloud and Python Developer is needed to provide specialized technical expertise, accelerate the modernization effort, reduce project delivery risk, and ensure continuity of critical business operations throughout the transition.
  
  
**Work Location - Remote with availability for meetings on customer site**
**Summary Of Major Job Functions**

* Migrating application from on-prem to AWS Cloud
* Refactoring the application and optimizing its functionality in the AWS Cloud
* Migrating SAS code to Python.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and support the modernization of the Census application as part of its migration to an Enterprise Data Lake (EDL) environment.
* Architect and implement cloud-native solutions utilizing AWS services, including AWS Lambda, AWS Glue, and other serverless technologies.
* Develop and maintain Python-based applications, APIs, and data processing workflows to support business and operational requirements.
* Analyze, convert, and migrate legacy SAS programs and processes to Python-based solutions.
* Modernize existing Java-based services by implementing scalable AWS serverless architectures and microservices.
* Design, develop, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL databases, including data models, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Implement and support containerized application deployments using industry-standard container technologies.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure systems engineers, developers, database administrators, and business stakeholders to define technical requirements and migration strategies.
* Support application integration, testing, deployment, and production operations within AWS cloud environments.
* Apply DevSecOps best practices, including automation, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), security compliance, and monitoring.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, database, and cloud infrastructure issues to ensure system reliability and performance.
* Provide technical expertise and leadership in cloud modernization initiatives while ensuring continuity of current operations during the migration effort.
* Support knowledge transfer, documentation, and training activities related to the implementation of new cloud-based technologies and processes.
* Assist in reducing project risk and accelerating delivery timelines by providing specialized expertise in AWS, Python, cloud migration, and database modernization technologies.
* Support the implementation of scalable, cloud-native architectures and best practices.

**Requirements**

* US Citizenship with an ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance is required
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner required
* AWS Certified Developer Associate preferred or obtained within six months of hiring.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate/Professional preferred or obtained within one year of hiring.
* Cloud Developer, Cloud Engineer, or Solutions Architect with 5+ years of experience designing and implementing cloud-based applications.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting AWS serverless solutions, including AWS Lambda, AWS Glue, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* 5+ years of Python development experience for application, API, and data processing solutions.
* Experience migrating legacy applications and codebases from on-premises environments to AWS cloud platforms.
* Experience converting or modernizing legacy processes into Python-based solutions.
* 3+ years of experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and ECS.
* Experience replacing monolithic or Java-based applications with microservices and serverless architectures.
* 3+ years of PostgreSQL database experience, including database design, performance tuning, SQL development, and data migration activities.
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and integrating enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, identity management, and federal security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and monitoring solutions.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, GitLab, or similar source-control platforms.
* Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies and participation in Scrum teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a cross-functional team responsible for application modernization, cloud migration, and operational support.

**Desired Skills & Qualifications: (Nice to haves only)**

* Experience supporting large-scale federal government IT modernization projects is highly desirable.
* Experience with Enterprise Data Lake (EDL) environments and large-scale data integration initiatives.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK).

**Additional Information**

* In order to meet the clearance requirements for this opportunity, candidates must be US Citizen.
* All candidates will be subject to a complete background check to include, but not limited to Criminal History, Education Verification, Professional Certification Verification, Verification of Previous Employment and Credit History.

The successful candidate will develop pipelines and data models, support critical production workflows, troubleshoot failures, and maintain consistent data quality across full refreshes and incremental loads. The role emphasizes collaborative development, reviewed pull requests, reliable pipeline operations, and close partnership with analytics and product teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain Dagster jobs, assets, schedules, and sensors, along with dbt models, tests, and documentation.
* Build and support data ingestion and transformation pipelines across Dagster or Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake.
* Maintain critical daily data workflows, particularly the PostgreSQL-to-Snowflake-to-dbt pipeline and third-party API integrations.
* Write and debug Python pipelines for REST API synchronization, large PostgreSQL extracts, Parquet data loads, and Snowflake COPY operations.
* Configure and troubleshoot Airbyte connections where managed data synchronization is appropriate.
* Monitor production pipeline runs and investigate failures involving AWS IAM permissions, memory constraints, Spot instances, and incorrect data watermarks.
* Execute backfills and incremental catch-ups while documenting what data was processed and why.
* Collaborate with analytics and product teams on dimensional modeling, including dimension and fact tables, incremental strategies, and data quality.
* Apply appropriate full-refresh or incremental-loading strategies while maintaining idempotency and supporting reliable backfills.
* Submit and review pull requests with clear, scoped changes, appropriate tests, and attention to potential failure scenarios.
* Make occasional Terraform updates for secrets, environment variables, and job sizing when required.
* Support release preparation, code reviews, and the creation of concise runbooks that help teammates operate pipelines.
* Maintain reliable data models and healthy pipelines while ensuring operational knowledge is shared across the team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of relational databases and data warehouse fundamentals, including keys, data grain, normalization, star schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCDs).
* Hands-on experience with Dagster or Apache Airflow, including practical orchestration work beyond writing SQL in a scheduling interface.
* Experience building and maintaining dbt models, tests, and documentation.
* Strong Python skills, including working with data at scale across extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
* Practical working knowledge of AWS services, particularly S3, IAM, and ECS/Fargate, with the ability to troubleshoot pipeline execution issues.
* Experience using Airbyte or similar extract-and-load tools.
* Ability to develop clear, reviewable pull requests and provide thorough code reviews.
* A reliability-focused approach to pipeline maintenance, data consistency, incremental processing, and production support.

**Location and Work Arrangement**

This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. The listing references Kentucky and notes that the Atlanta, Georgia location displayed on some job platforms is an administrative requirement rather than an indication that the role is office-based.

**Salary and Benefits**

The annual salary range is $150,000 to $165,000. Compensation depends on the scope of the role, national market benchmarks, the candidate’s expertise and experience, and expected business impact. Additional variable compensation is performance-based.

Benefits include:

* Equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity.
* National medical, dental, and vision insurance plans.
* Company-provided life insurance.
* Optional accident insurance, flexible spending account (FSA), and dependent care flexible spending account (DCFSA) benefits.
* Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and 11 company-observed holidays.
* 401(k) plan.
* Twelve weeks of paid leave for birth and non-birth parents.

**Interview Process**

* Applications are reviewed by a member of the PeopleOps team.
* Eligible candidates may be invited to a 30-minute video interview with PeopleOps.
* The next stage may be a 45-minute video interview with the Principal Data Scientist.
* Candidates who progress may participate in a 90-minute video panel interview with key stakeholders.
* The final interview, if required, is a 30-minute video meeting with a company leader.
* Successful candidates may then receive an offer.

**Employment Eligibility**

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. New employees must complete Form I-9 and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent on successfully completing the E-Verify process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

PadSplit is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Product Development Data & Analytics
description:
**About Rivian**
Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.
  
  
As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Analytics Engineer to join our Product Development Data & Analytics team. Our team partners with groups across Product Development, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to define, build, measure, and enhance the systems and processes that enable the successful launch of a vehicle program—including product requirements, bill of material (BOM) development, issue and change management, and prototype build and
  
  
validation.
  
  
As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will play a critical role in scaling our Product Data Catalog and building the next generation of analytics tools. You will be instrumental in democratizing our data to enable self-service analysis and refining our architecture to facilitate quality AI. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in data architecture and dbt, and the leadership to scale data driven-decision making in a rapidly evolving EV production environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Data Architecture & Modeling: Architect and maintain scalable ELT pipelines and data models for optimal data accuracy and consistency. Manage the Product Data Catalog within our enterprise Databricks Unity Catalog, ensuring clean, reliable, and intuitive semantic metric definitions using dbt.
* Advanced Analytics & Visualization: Develop and deploy mission-critical technical dashboards and data products (e.g., in Hex, Databricks AI/BI). Drive the development of core dashboards to serve everyone from executive leadership to functional working levels.
* Data Democratization: Drive initiatives to democratize data and metrics, enabling low-code and self-service analytics for users across the business to seamlessly conduct ad-hoc, root-cause analyses.
* AI Readiness & Innovation: Enrich the data catalog and refine model architecture to ensure reliability and AI comprehension. Contribute to a cross-organization knowledge base and drive the utilization of AI/ML models and agents for automation.
* Strategic Problem Solving: Proven leadership in architecting analytics platforms that solve complex operational problems. Autonomously investigate, dissect, and resolve complex business challenges spanning the vehicle development lifecycle

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of proven experience in senior or staff positions in data engineering and analytics engineering.
* Expertise in SQL, Python, and dbt.
* Proficient in data modeling principles and schema design for analytics.
* Proficient in modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks), with a strong command of latest features (Unity Catalog, Databricks AI/BI, Genie).
* Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Hex.
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD workflows for data engineering projects.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts and data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in automotive or high-volume manufacturing environments.
* Experience working with bill of materials (BOM) data.
* Experience building and maintaining robust data ingestion pipelines leveraging Spark in Databricks jobs as well as Fivetran.
* Understanding of AI/ML models as applied to data analytics or automation.

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

title: Data Engineer II - Insights, Strategy & Analytics

title: Senior Specialist, Data Engineering and Analytics

We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join our company and be part of a team that uses the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.

Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering and analytics, this individual contributor role will work across SM S&T, Digital Manufacturing Division, Digital CMC, MPI, IT, and Global Pharmaceutical Operations teams to improve access to manufacturing and process data, support analytics deployment, and enable broader use of digital and analytical capabilities. The role is well suited to a technically strong contributor who can execute independently, solve complex problems within defined priorities, and collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
  
  
This role requires a strong technical foundation, attention to detail, and the ability to translate defined business needs into reliable, scalable, and compliant data and analytics outputs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Execute data engineering and analytics deliverables in support of SM S&T priorities and business needs
* Build, maintain, and enhance data pipelines, data transformations, curated datasets, and analytical outputs
* Support delivery of dashboards, reporting, and analytical tools that improve visibility, monitoring, and decision support
* Investigate data issues and partner with relevant teams to improve data quality, completeness, and usability
* Partner with scientists, engineers, manufacturing users, and digital teams to clarify requirements and support solution delivery
* Translate defined business questions into data requirements, logic, and fit-for-purpose outputs
* Support testing, implementation, and refinement of analytics and data solutions based on user needs and feedback
* Contribute to effective communication and coordination across matrixed teams
* Improve accessibility and usability of manufacturing and process data through preparation, organization, and contextualization of datasets

title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer, Factory Software
description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!
  
  
In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by
*TIME*
as a “Best Invention”,
*MIT Technology Review*
as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and
*Fast Company*
as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.
  
  
Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.
  
  
**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**
Role Description
  
  
The Factory Software team is seeking a Data Analytics Engineer to bridge the gap between complex manufacturing data and actionable insights. In this role, you will be responsible for the development and ownership of the reporting, dashboards, and Business Intelligence (BI) infrastructure that powers our factory operations. You will function as a key partner to our Factory teams, ensuring they have the high-quality, real-time data needed to optimize production and ensure manufacturing excellence. You will collaborate closely with Factory Software Dev, Data Engineering and Platform teams to leverage our on-prem and cloud infrastructure, building scalable solutions that enable a data-driven culture on the factory floor.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated reporting and interactive dashboards to provide critical visibility into factory performance and operational metrics.
* Own the Business Intelligence (BI) space for the Factory Software team, acting as the primary point of contact for data requests and insights from factory stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Factory teams to understand their workflows and translate complex business requirements into technical data solutions and visualizations.
* Build and optimize data models and transformations (e.g., using SQL and Python) to ensure factory data is structured for efficient reporting and analysis.
* Establish and maintain standards for data quality, documentation, and dashboard performance to ensure "one version of the truth" across the manufacturing organization.
* Proactively seek opportunities to improve data accessibility and provide technical support/training to internal users on self-service BI tools.
* Liaise between manufacturing end-users and the broader Software team to drive the continuous improvement of our data systems and infrastructure.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years industry experience writing reusable code for data analysis
* Experience using SQL and Python in a collaborative environment
* Experience with exploratory and explanatory analysis of data from physical systems
* Must have strong communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of relaying technical information to non-technical stakeholders
* Must be able to work independently with excellent time management, multi-tasking and the ability to assess and prioritize competing demands
* Experience in a manufacturing, warehouse or logistics environment working with software systems and end-users to support production operations is highly desirable
* Experience collaborating with a variety of stakeholders (e.g. Engineering, Operations, and Software)
* Experience with Jira is a plus
* Desire to learn and grow professionally in a fast-paced, startup environment
* Bachelor's Degree in related field Computer Science, Data Engineering or equivalent work experience

**Where You'll Work**
This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.
  
  
*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*
*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*
*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*
*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will
**never**
solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
TITLE: Senior Analytics Engineer DEPARTMENT: Data REPORTS TO: Director of Data WHO WE ARE:
  
  
Thistle’s mission is to help people get and stay healthy while improving the sustainability of our food system. We make nutritious, delicious, ready-to-eat meals, snacks, and juices delivered right to our customers’ doorsteps. We’ve served over 27 million meals to customers all over America, but we’re just getting started. We’re launching in new cities, expanding our menu, and upgrading our user experience to mainstream a new way of eating that can genuinely heal people and our planet — and we need more teammates to join us.
  
  
Thistle is headquartered in San Francisco, but our product team is remote. Currently, the team has members in SF, LA, Oregon, Denver, Kansas City, Austin, and Philadelphia, with other Thistle departments spread across the US. You can learn more about life as a remote employee at Thistle here. While this is a remote role, the Senior Analytics Engineer will be expected to travel 2-4 times a year to visit our production facilities and collaborate with teammates in person.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Analytics Engineer will play a critical leadership role in shaping and scaling Thistle’s data infrastructure, strategy, and culture. You will be responsible for driving the evolution of our modern data stack, delivering robust and high-quality data models, and enabling strategic, data-informed decisions throughout the business.
  
  
As a senior member of the Analytics team, you’ll act as both a technical expert and thought partner to cross-functional leaders, including marketing, product, engineering, operations, and finance. Your work will have a direct impact on Thistle’s growth trajectory, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
  
  
**How You’ll Make a Difference**

* Own the architecture and governance of Thistle’s end-to-end data infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and adherence to best practices.
* Lead the design and implementation of our core data models and pipelines (ETL/ELT), enabling advanced analytics, reporting, and experimentation.
* Drive cross-functional alignment on data definitions, metrics, and source-of-truth models to ensure consistency and clarity across teams.
* Develop and mentor analytics engineers and analysts, elevating technical standards and fostering a data-driven mindset throughout the company.
* Serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership by identifying opportunities for data to unlock business value and advising on high-impact initiatives.
* Continuously optimize the performance of our data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift), workflows, and query efficiency.
* Champion best-in-class tooling and practices, including dbt, Airflow, version control, testing frameworks, and documentation standards.
* Support self-serve analytics by building scalable, intuitive data products, dashboards, and exploration tools tailored to business stakeholders.

title: Senior Corporate Enterprise Platform Engineer, Windows
description:
Role Description 

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

 This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

 You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

 Responsibilities 

- Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment. 

- Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation. 

- Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues. 

- Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate. 

- Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment. 

- Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity. 

- Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team. 

 Requirements

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
**Who we are:** World Pediatrics partners with governments, health workers, and organizations to ensure that children in lower-resource settings have access to safe, timely surgical care. The Junior Data Engineer supports the development, integration, automation, and reliability of World Pediatrics data systems. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** include but are not limited to:

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it's within reach.

What Will You Do?

**The Overview**

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and run that pipeline in a regulated environment. You will work closely with the data science/clinical teams, which owns the medical and research questions. You will also work with the Data Architect on platform standards, data models, and governance.

**The Specifics**

**Build and Evolve the Data Platform (Prolaio Data Ecosystem)**

* + Design, build, and maintain batch, streaming, and hybrid pipelines orchestrated with Dagster. These cover ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, and publishing of the data.
  + Develop and maintain dbt models in BigQuery, including staging, intermediate, and mart layers, with tests, documentation, and clear ownership.
  + Ingest and normalize heterogeneous sources (both structured and unstructured data), including cardiology wearables and device signals, EHR, claims, medication, and patient-reported data.
  + Make well-reasoned decisions about storage, compute, partitioning, cost, and APIs, and contribute to the target-state architecture and the reference patterns.

**Data Quality, Lineage, and Compliance**

* + Contribute to data lifecycle controls into pipelines: retention, access control, lineage, provenance, reproducibility, and auditability.
  + Use Dagster assets and dbt lineage to keep data traceable from source to output.
  + Support validated operation in a regulated setting by documenting pipelines, keeping traceability, and working with Quality and Security teams.
  + Back every pipeline change with thorough automated tests and data quality checks.

**Enable Data Science and ML**

* + Treat data scientists as your customers, and give them the tools and processes to experiment and iterate efficiently.
  + Contribute to the ML workflows that support feature generation, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  + Contribute to internal applications and Python libraries

**Operate and Monitor**

* + Own CI/CD for the data platform using GitLab CI, including dbt and Dagster deployments.
  + Help monitoring pipeline health, performance, and BigQuery cost with Datadog, and take part in incident response.
  + Help mentoring other engineers and setting engineering standards for the data team.

**Why Prolaio?**

* **Impactful Work:** You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
* **Innovative Environment****:** You will be part of an organization doing something that's never been done before.
* **Professional Growth****:** You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
* **Collaborative Team****:** You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

**Who You Are?**

* 6+ years in data engineering
* Expert Python and SQL
* Experience with GCP (or AWS/Azure)
* Production experience with dbt, including modeling, testing, macros, and incremental models.
* Experience with BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Redshift).
* Experience with Dagster or a comparable orchestrator (Airflow, Prefect).
* Experience with Docker and large-scale data processing.
* Experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including time-series data.
* Understanding of MLOps concepts and production ML workflows.
* Experience collaborating with data scientists, product, and clinical or quality stakeholders.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

**Additional Qualifications (Nice to Haves)**

* Hands-on GCP experience (IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, networking).
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform
* Experience with Datadog
* Metadata, lineage, and catalog tools, plus retrieval or vector tooling for AI use cases.
* Experience with Databricks
* Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, medtech, or other patient data.
* Experience in regulated or validated environments (SaMD, FDA, GxP, HIPAA).
* Streaming tools such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* **Meaningful Compensation**: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
* **Great Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
* **Flexible Spending Perks:** HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.
* **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
* **Family-First Benefits**: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
* **Security & Peace of Mind**: Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
* **Plan for the Future**: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
* **Care When You Need It:** Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life's unexpected moments.

Starting Salary is at $150,000.00 (Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

This role is part of the enterprise Information Security Modernization (ISM) program, supporting the evolution of secure, scalable API, AI gateway and API security platform capabilities. Participation in a rotating on-call support schedule is required.

Key responsibilities include:  

* Lead design and architecture of enterprise API & AI gateway platform capabilities ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Build and manage scalable API proxies and services supporting REST and SOAP-based integrations.
* Implement API security frameworks including OAuth, JWT, API key management, mTLS, and secure communication protocols.

Implement and maintain enterprise AI gateway services.

* Develop CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks to enable consistent API & AI gateway deployments and lifecycle management.

* Collaborate with developers, architects, and platform teams to translate business and technical requirements into scalable API solutions.
* Provide operational support including troubleshooting, incident response, and continuous improvement of API platform capabilities.
* Develop and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for internal users and developers.

 **Qualifications**

A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, information technology, health science, or other analytical/quantitative field and a minimum of five years of professional or research experience in data visualization, data engineering, analytical modeling techniques; OR an Associate’s degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, information technology, health science, or other analytical/quantitative field and a minimum of seven years of professional or research experience in data visualization, data engineering, analytical modeling techniques. In-depth business or practice knowledge will also be considered.

Incumbent must have the ability to manage a varied workload of projects with multiple priorities and stay current on healthcare trends and enterprise changes. Requires strong analytical skills and the ability to identify and recommend solutions and a commitment to customer service. The position requires excellent verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail, and a high capacity for learning and problem resolution.

Advanced experience in SQL is required. Strong Experience in scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, PHP, C++ or Java & API integration is required. Experience in hybrid data processing methods (batch and streaming) such as Apache Spark, Hive, Pig, Kafka is required. Experience with big data, statistics, and machine learning is required. The ability to navigate linux and windows operating systems is required. Knowledge of workflow scheduling (Apache Airflow Google Composer), Infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Docker) CI/CD (Jenkins, Github Actions) is preferred. Experience in DataOps/DevOps and agile methodologies is preferred. Experience with hybrid data virtualization such as Denodo is preferred. Working knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, SAS, ThoughtSpot, DASH, d3, React, Snowflake, SSIS, and Google Big Query is preferred.  
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) certification is preferred.

**The preferred candidate will possess:**

* **Experience designing, deploying, or operating API management platforms or gateways (Apigee X experience preferred), including API proxy development, policy enforcement, and integration patterns.**
* **Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure and container platforms (Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker), including building and supporting scalable, highly available distributed systems.**
* **Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and CI/CD pipeline development (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable automated platform provisioning and deployment.**

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
**Compensation:** $130,000-$160,000 per year  
**Location:** United States – Remote or Omaha, NE - Hybrid

**The job:**

As a Senior Data Engineer-Data Platform at Buildertrend, you'll lead the migration of our data platform onto a modern Databricks lakehouse built on dbt, replacing today's patchwork of legacy systems with a single, reliable source of truth. You'll design the pipelines that bring in data from tools like Salesforce, SQL Server and Gong, turning it into curated, trustworthy datasets that teams across the business, and the AI tools built on top of them, can rely on without double-checking the numbers. Your work directly cuts down on the manual firefighting that eats into engineering time today, and sets the technical standards other engineers will build on for years.

**What you will do:**

* Design, build and maintain Buildertrend's Databricks lakehouse using a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture in dbt, and set the layer standards, naming conventions and build rules other engineers follow.
* Build ELT pipelines with Databricks, dbt and Fivetran that bring in data from SQL Server, Salesforce, MongoDB, Gong, OpenTelemetry and vendors like Zonda, turning it into curated, analytics- and AI-ready datasets.
* Lead the exit from legacy systems like BigQuery, Data Fusion and Cloud Fusion by refactoring pipelines rather than copying them over as-is, untangling circular dependencies, and repointing tools like Tableau to the new platform with clear owners and deadlines.
* Strengthen reliability by improving SQL Server log-ship replication and Fivetran ingestion, and by building automation like auto-recovery, full-refresh jobs and watchdog orchestration that cuts down on manual fixes and outages.
* Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring and quality metrics using dbt tests, Unity Catalog and Fivetran metadata, so stakeholders can trust the numbers without double-checking them.
* Design access controls for large datasets, including permission models, per-team clusters, service principals and scoped access for AI tools, and handle privacy requests through tools like DataGrail to meet CCPA requirements.
* Set up data contracts with product engineering so upstream schema changes don't silently break the warehouse, and write documentation (data dictionary, ERDs, spec docs, column notes) clear enough for people and AI tools to use.
* Build and improve the curated data products that let stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions.
* Partner with data science, machine learning and AI teams to build and curate the datasets their models and experiments depend on, alongside the broader data products that help stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions.
* Partner with engineers, analysts, business leaders and other stakeholders to prioritize work, manage dependencies and deliver meaningful platform improvements.
* Mentor other engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate emerging technologies and grow toward a technical leadership role while using AI thoughtfully to improve productivity and engineering outcomes.

**Who you are and what you need:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field is required.
* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data science or data analytics.
* Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company is preferred.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Databricks, including building and orchestrating pipelines, managing jobs and clusters, and using Unity Catalog for governance is required.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with dbt, including building and maintaining models, tests and macros in a real production environment is required.
* Proven experience leading a data platform migration, such as moving off a legacy warehouse onto a modern lakehouse, from planning through delivery, including setting deadlines and owning the outcome.
* Experience partnering with data science, machine learning, or AI teams to build and curate datasets to support model development and experimentation.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Python and working with APIs and large, complex datasets. BigQuery or FiveTran experience is a plus!
* Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL and ELT pipelines, medallion architecture and building analytics and machine learning-ready datasets.
* Experience writing data tests, setting up freshness and alerting monitors, and building access controls or governance policies in a live production environment (not just in a sandbox or one-off project).
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, especially during a system migration where people need clear, direct answers about what's changing and when.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical work and influencing engineering standards.

* Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge

* Volunteer time off – because giving back matters

Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. Leidos is looking for our next **TS/SCI-cleared DevOps Platform Engineer/Linux Systems Administrator** to join a high-energy team deploying and maintaining common application-runtime capabilities in support of the DIA-NDOC (National Digital Exploitation OSINT Center) DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP). This role is part of a 10-year program supporting the DOMEX Data Discovery Platform (D3P) Modernization effort, where you’ll contribute to mission-critical capabilities alongside a collaborative, innovative, and growth-oriented team.

While the majority of work is performed on-site at our customer location in Bethesda, MD, we offer a flexible schedule and occasional opportunities for remote work.

As a **Platform Engineer**, you’ll operate and maintain the organization’s Kubernetes-based application platform and shared runtime services, including Elastic and Redis by performing platform configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, security hardening, capacity management, version upgrades, and automation to provide reliable, secure, and scalable platform services. You’ll also support the implementation of automation, continuous integration and delivery, and DevOps best practices across cross-functional engineer teams. In this fast-paced environment, you’ll collaborate closely with systems engineering, architecture, development, security, operations, and integration teams.

You will work with a multidisciplinary group of developers, integrators, and system administrators to:

  

* Deploy, troubleshoot, monitor, and maintain the platform for a production big-data pipeline built on Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, and Kafka .
* Administer and maintain Linux-based applications, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and system hardening.
* Integrate with the underlying physical and virtual infrastructure, ensuring system availability, reliability, security, and performance.
* Design and support scalable, redundant application infrastructure across physical and virtual environments.
* Contribute technical input to engineering documentation, diagrams, and models.
* Participate in Agile release planning, scrums, design sessions, bug triage, and related team activities.

You’re enthusiastic, collaborative, and comfortable working with teammates across a range of technical backgrounds. You also meet the following qualifications:

* Possess at least one DoD 8140.03-M IAT Level II or higher certification, e.g., CySA+, Security+CE, etc.

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools and practices
* Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills

**You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:**

* Knowledge of Agile methodologies
* Development experience (Bash, PowerShell, SALT, Python, Groovy, Java, etc.)

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

AlderPoint Technologies is looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help maintain the systems and infrastructure that business applications depend on. You'll work with cloud services, server environments, networking, and automation to keep infrastructure reliable, secure, and manageable.

The role involves both planned infrastructure work and troubleshooting when something goes wrong. You'll help investigate service issues, support deployments, review system configurations, and work with other technical teams to resolve problems.

We need someone who approaches technical changes carefully, documents their work, and communicates clearly when an issue affects system performance or delivery.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Configure, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure based on application and business requirements.
* Manage cloud resources, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and access permissions.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and resource usage to identify potential problems.
* Troubleshoot server, connectivity, configuration, and deployment issues.
* Support application releases and coordinate infrastructure changes with development and IT teams.
* Review cloud configurations and access controls to identify security concerns.
* Use scripting and automation to reduce repetitive infrastructure tasks.
* Assist with backup procedures, recovery planning, and routine maintenance.
* Investigate service interruptions and document the steps taken to resolve them.
* Review resource consumption and identify opportunities to manage cloud costs.
* Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Follow change-management processes and communicate risks before modifying production systems.

**What You'll Bring**

We are looking for someone with a practical understanding of cloud infrastructure and a methodical approach to technical problem-solving.

You should have:

* Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of cloud computing, virtual machines, storage, and infrastructure networking.
* Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments.
* An understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience with scripting tools such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Familiarity with system monitoring, access management, and infrastructure security.
* The ability to investigate technical issues and explain findings clearly.
* Good documentation habits and attention to detail.
* The ability to work with developers, IT colleagues, and other stakeholders.
* Sound judgement when making changes that could affect live services.

Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, or CI/CD tools is useful. Relevant cloud certifications are also an advantage.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to keep infrastructure records current, report problems promptly, and check changes before they affect live systems. When an issue cannot be resolved immediately, you should explain its impact, document what has been investigated, and communicate the next steps.

You'll also help identify recurring technical problems and recommend practical improvements to infrastructure reliability, security, and maintenance.

**Working Schedule**

**Days:** Monday to Friday  
**Hours:** 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Location:** Los Angeles, California

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Include your cloud infrastructure experience, the platforms and tools you have used, and any relevant certifications.

You may also describe an infrastructure project or technical problem you worked on, explaining your contribution and the outcome.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

**Applicants will be considered based on job-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**About this Role**
===================

Fandom is growing! We're looking for a **Senior Cloud Engineer** to help evolve and support the infrastructure that powers our platform for over 300 million fans around the world. This is a hands-on role focused on building reliable, scalable systems in a Linux and Kubernetes-based environment.

As part of the **TechOps team**, you'll report to the **Manager of TechOps** and work closely with developers, product engineers, and other infrastructure teams. You'll contribute to our CI/CD, monitoring, automation, and cloud efforts — helping ensure Fandom's platform remains fast, stable, and secure as we grow.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, improving deployment systems, and enabling engineering teams to move faster and safer.

**You Will...**
===============

* Design, architect, and scale high-availability routing architectures to seamlessly balance and secure global user traffic across a hybrid footprint of on-premise datacenters, AWS, and GCP.
* Manage and automate cloud and edge infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Chef, ensuring consistent configurations for Kubernetes, global Cloudflare services, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Maintain and optimize large-scale production environments, orchestrating high-availability MySQL replication, automated failover, robust disaster recovery, and system monitoring.
* Develop internal tools for operational automation, system/data backups, performance tuning, and comprehensive security monitoring.
* Drive operational excellence by leading planning meetings, retrospectives, and RCAs, while continuously evaluating systems against industry best practices.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain production stability, handle incident responses, and collaborate with/mentor cross-functional engineering teams.

**You Have...**
===============

* 5+ years of experience in Technical/Network Operations, DevOps, or SRE roles managing large-scale production platforms (e.g., 10M+ monthly active users).
* Deep proficiency in Linux systems administration, networking protocols (TCP/IP, routing), secure systems practices, and scripting/programming (Go, Python, or Bash).
* Proven hands-on experience with core infrastructure tech: Kubernetes/container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and monitoring/reliability systems (e.g., Prometheus).
* Practical experience managing production MySQL database environments, including deep familiarity with replication topologies, failover mechanisms, and performance tuning.
* Demonstrated capability using generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) to enhance productivity, paired with the ability to critically audit and verify outputs for accuracy, security, and context.

**Bonus Points...**
===================

* Advanced Cloudflare expertise, including CDN optimization, WAF security, DNS management, edge performance tuning, and Cloudflare Tunnels.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, edge caching, and centralized log management using the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
* Experience defining SLOs and instrumentation, implementing meaningful metrics, logs, and traces to reduce alert noise and drive postmortem action items.

**Benefits & Perks**
====================

* Salary Range = $122k - $204k (*Actual salary available will vary based on location and market factors.)*
* Vibrant team culture
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision
* Training (unlimited Udemy + more)
* Flexible working hours and time off
* Equity & Retirement Programs including 401K match
* Paid Parental Leave
* International work environment with start-up culture

**About Fandom**
================

Fandom is the world's largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. Reaching more than 350 million unique visitors per month and hosting more than 250,000 wikis, Fandom is the #1 source for in-depth information on pop culture, gaming, TV and film, where fans learn about and celebrate their favorite fandoms. Fandom's Gaming division manages the online video game retailer Fanatical. Fandom Productions, the content arm of Fandom, enhances the fan experience through curated editorial coverage and branded content from trusted and established publishing brands Gamespot, TV Guide and Metacritic, along with its Emmy-nominated Honest Trailers and the weekly video news program The Loop. For more information follow @getfandom or visit: www.fandom.com.

title: Platform Engineer L2
description:
**About Curative**

Curative is building the future of health insurance with a first-of-its-kind employer-based plan designed to remove financial barriers and make care truly accessible: one monthly premium with $0 copays and $0 deductibles\*. Backed by our recent **$150M in Series B funding** and valuation at **$1.275B**, Curative is scaling rapidly and investing in AI-powered service, deeper member engagement, and a smart network designed for today’s workforce.

Our north star guides everything we do: **healthcare only works when people can actually use it**. That belief drives every decision we make: from how we design our plan, support our members, to how we collaborate as a team.

If you want to do meaningful work with a team that moves fast, experiments boldly, and cares deeply, Curative is the place to do it. We’re growing fast and looking for teammates who want to help transform health insurance for the better.

**About the Platform Team**
---------------------------

The Platform team's mission is to create a highly productive environment for application developers to experiment and ship new business features and systems. We own the cloud infrastructure, developer experience tooling, CI/CD, and shared platform services that the rest of engineering builds on.

Our primary stack is **AWS, OpenTofu, Python, and Go**.

**The Role**
------------

As a Platform Engineer (L2), you'll own meaningful pieces of our infrastructure end-to-end — designing, deploying, and maintaining services that other engineers rely on every day. You'll work on projects on roughly 4-week horizons, ship infrastructure changes with minimal day-to-day guidance, and steadily deepen your specialization in cloud architecture, reliability, and developer tooling.

This role is a good fit if you've shipped production infrastructure at one or more prior organizations, have a working grasp of IaC fundamentals, and want to grow your platform engineering craft on a team that takes developer experience seriously. This is a fully remote position.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Deploy and maintain infrastructure with OpenTofu, with a focus on fault tolerance and operational simplicity.
* Own the lifecycle of services and subsystems — design, deployment, production support, and ongoing improvements.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines so application teams can ship safely and quickly.
* Investigate and resolve moderately complex infrastructure and performance issues, developing structured troubleshooting habits along the way.
* Integrate security and compliance considerations — including HIPAA — into infrastructure decisions.
* Participate in architecture design discussions, and help engineers across the org navigate cloud and automation frameworks.
* Contribute to broader platform reliability improvements and process optimization across engineering.
* Take on small-scale project leadership: scoping work, managing timelines, and coordinating with teammates.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for systems your team owns.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* A few years of professional experience as a software, platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineer, including time at more than one organization.
* Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider; AWS preferred.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code — OpenTofu, Terraform, or equivalent.
* Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency in at least one of Python or Go, and willingness to work in both.
* Solid fundamentals in networking, storage, and monitoring.
* Ability to debug production issues independently and communicate clearly about what you found.
* Comfort participating in an on-call rotation.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, finance) with compliance requirements like HIPAA.
* Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS) or other container orchestration.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
SiloSmashers, Inc. is a leading management and IT consulting firm, serving as a trusted advisor and solutions partner to a diverse range of government, business, and not-for-profit organizations. Applying proven expertise and methodologies, we help our customers align and mobilize every aspect of their operations, strengths, and resources to achieve Peak Performance and increased business value today and through the years ahead.

**Position Overview**

SiloSmashers is hiring for a Senior Data Engineer to support a government customer. This position will be responsible for architecting, developing, optimizing, and maintaining high‑performance data ingestion, transformation, streaming, and analytical pipelines within Databricks‑enabled Lakehouse environments. The selected candidate will serve as a senior technical expert for Databricks Lakehouse engineering, advanced Delta Lake optimization, governed data design (Unity Catalog), medallion‑architecture enforcement, structured streaming, and platform‑integrated cloud data engineering across enterprise platforms. This role is expected to collaborate closely with the Project Manager / Contractor Lead, federal technical teams, and cross‑task platform, SRE, governance, privacy, and development personnel.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the principal technical authority for Databricks data engineering, pipeline optimization, streaming, and Lakehouse standards across programs.
* Lead design reviews, technical roadmaps, and architectural decisions in partnership with federal SMEs and platform/security teams.
* Build and optimize batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines, Delta Lake, Auto Loader, and Workflows with robust error handling, retries, alerting, and monitoring.
* Lead and enforce medallion‑architecture ingestion and refinement patterns, data lifecycle management, and governed data storage tiering.
* Implement advanced performance tuning and cost‑efficiency strategies, including cluster/sizing optimization, serverless compute adoption, workload health monitoring, and resource governance.
* Provide root cause analysis, disruption/outage reporting, and production support for Databricks jobs, pipelines, applications, and platform features.
* Coordinate with Privacy & Governance teams to enforce Unity Catalog RBAC/ABAC, row/column‑level security, governed tags, lineage, and compliance controls.
* Mentor mid‑level/junior engineers, perform code reviews, and uphold high engineering quality through testing strategies, quality gates, reproducible builds, and DevSecOps best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing Databricks Lakehouse solutions, including:
  + Delta Lake table design, schema evolution, expectations, and medallion‑architecture (bronze/silver/gold).
  + Databricks Workflows, Jobs, Auto Loader, COPY INTO, Structured Streaming, Databricks SQL Warehouses, and Unity Catalog governance models.
  + Performance and cost optimization (Photon, file sizing, Z‑ORDER, clustering/partitioning, caching, AQE, shuffle/skew mitigation).
* Hands‑on experience building distributed data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and cloud‑native services across AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
* Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing relational and NoSQL data systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Aurora, DynamoDB) and designing efficient, secure schemas.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Git‑based workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), Databricks Repos, Asset/Bundles, Terraform/IaC, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience supporting federal environments and compliance‑aligned development.
* Experience applying agile development methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and iterative delivery.
* Experience in AI/ML DevSecOps or agentic‑AI engineering, including Databricks Model Serving, Genie, Agent Bricks, or integration with AWS Kiro or other government‑approved platforms. Mandatory

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
* Eight (8) or more years of experience (7 of which must be within the last 10 years) in data engineering, ETL/ELT pipeline development, or distributed data processing within enterprise cloud environments.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or related field; or twelve (12) total years of equivalent experience in lieu of a degree.
* Databricks Data Engineer Professional Certification
* At least one cloud-focused certification (e.g. AWS Developer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, or equivalent).
* Preferred but not required: Databricks Lakehouse Architect, Generative AI Associate/Professional, or related ML/AI certifications.
* This position requires regular, physical attendance at customer sites.

description:

Working alongside senior engineers, you will help ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of VMware, Nutanix, and Kubernetes environments across multiple data centers.

This role is ideal for an engineer with foundational infrastructure experience who is looking to build expertise in virtualization, Kubernetes, automation, and platform engineering within a large-scale enterprise environment.

**Kubernetes Platform Operations**

* Support enterprise Kubernetes environments and containerized workloads.
* Assist with cluster deployment, upgrades, and ongoing operations.
* Monitor cluster health, node performance, and application availability.

* Assist with CI/CD integrations and operational workflow automation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**About Lvt**
LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it.

This role is hybrid based out of our Seattle office.
