title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**We are Skyward.**
That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission. We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.
**Integrity:**
We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.
**Compassionate:**
If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.
**Inquisitive:**
We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.
**Unconventional:**
For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.
**Authentic:**
Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand. Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.
  
  
**We need a Cloud Engineer.**
Do you name your VPCs like they’re your children and feel a physical pang when you spot an over-provisioned instance just sitting there, eating budget, doing nothing? Do you read the AWS bill line by line, not because anyone asked, but because waste genuinely keeps you up at night?
  
  
Good. Same. We believe the best cloud environment is the one nobody notices - secure, scalable, and humming along while everyone else gets to focus on the mission. If that made you nod, stop reading the fine print and apply.
  
  
Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.
  
  
Let's go Skyward together.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build the cloud where the magic lives. Design, deploy, and operate secure, scalable AWS environments (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, Aurora, and Neptune) that keep our systems fast and our data exactly where it belongs, supporting CMS as it merges systems into one AI-driven platform.
* Respect the pillars. Build to the AWS Well-Architected Framework, balancing performance, reliability, security, and cost like they actually matter (because they do).
* Give AI a home. Stand up the cloud environment for AI, hosting open-source LLMs and ML workloads (think SageMaker, Glue, DataBrew) entirely within CMS’s AWS account, so sensitive data never wanders off.
* Keep the lights on. Implement high availability, disaster recovery, and COOP continuity so we hit our SLAs even on a genuinely bad day.
* Make security non-negotiable. Wire up AWS Security Hub, Config, and Audit Manager to keep us continuously compliant inside a FISMA Moderate boundary aligned to RMF, ARS, and IS2P2.
* Run a tidy multi-tenant house. Build isolated, segregated, quota-managed spaces where different teams can experiment with AI without elbowing each other.
* Be the bouncer. Design least-privilege IAM and role-based access controls, then keep them honest with regular access reviews and audits.
* Make it observable. Set baselines, configure monitoring and alerting, and turn system health into something the whole team can actually see, ideally before a user files a ticket.
* Chase the waste. Model cloud costs, hunt down savings with tools like AWS Trusted Advisor, and help keep our AI workspace financially sane.

What we’d like you to have:
  
  

* 3-5 years of hands-on AWS experience. You’ve built and run real environments, not just collected exam badges (though we like those too).
* Solid comfort with core AWS services: compute, networking (VPC), IAM, storage, and managed databases.
* A security-first reflex and familiarity with cloud-native security and compliance tooling (Security Hub, Config, Audit Manager, or similar).
* Automation instincts. Python, Bash, and a genuine fondness for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), because clicking around the console doesn’t scale.
* An eye for cost optimization. You know the cheapest architecture and the best architecture are usually closer than people think.
* All the curiosity. You’d rather understand why something broke than just restart it and hope.
* A sense of humor and a calm head. When something’s on fire at 2 a.m., you’re the person everyone’s relieved is on the call.

**What Would Blow Us Away**

* You’ve hosted AI/ML or LLM workloads in the cloud - SageMaker, GPU instances, or self-hosted open-source models.
* You have a few AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, SysOps, or Security Specialty) and the scars that come with real-world use.
* You’ve got federal or civic-tech experience. Bonus points if you’ve operated inside a FISMA boundary, navigated an ATO, or survived a cATO effort.

*Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.*
**And Now The Important Part. What We Offer You**

* Medical, dental, vision insurance
* 15 days of paid leave
* 7 days of sick leave
* 2 days bereavement leave
* 11 paid Federal holidays
* Up to 40 hours for jury duty
* 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
* Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
* Company provided laptop
* $5,000 per year for professional development
* $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
* $2,000 referral bonus
* Life and disability insurance
* HSA and FSA
* Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
* Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!

$115,000 - $145,000 a year
  
  
We believe great work deserves great pay. That’s why we ensure our compensation is not only competitive but also fair and transparent, as required by Maryland law. Expect a salary that matches your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the table — because you’re worth it!
  
  
At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees.
**Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.**
**Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance due to the nature of our work as a government contractor.**
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Monaco is building an AI-native revenue platform that replaces the fragmented GTM stack - CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, pipeline management with one unified system, consolidating 6–10 disconnected tools into a single platform built for the AI era.

We launched publicly in Feb 2026, are already 65 people, and have strong early product-market fit generating millions in ARR within months of launch. You'll have the chance to both scale our core systems and build new features from 0 to 1.

We've raised $85M in our Series B from Founders Fund, Benchmark, and Human Capital, and our founders previously led Brex, Apollo, and Clari.

Come join us if you want to be part of a high autonomy, high pace team reinventing one of the biggest categories in enterprise software.

**The role**
------------

You'll own the Spark pipelines on Databricks that power Monaco's analytics products, working directly with product teams to turn what they need into reliable, cost-conscious data. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a mid-level to senior engineer (roughly 2–6 years of experience).

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build, deploy, and operate production Spark data pipelines on Databricks.
* Partner with product teams to turn analytics-product needs into pipeline requirements, including data quality and freshness expectations.
* Set up monitoring and observability so pipeline reliability is measured, not assumed.
* Diagnose performance and cost problems and fix their root causes.
* Recommend pragmatic standards for running pipelines as our data and platform scale.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production Spark pipelines.
* Deep understanding of how concepts like clustering, shuffles, different join strategies, and batch versus stream processing create tradeoffs in performance, freshness, and cost.
* Experience with reliability, monitoring, and observability, and the ability to explain how you diagnosed a real pipeline failure or bottleneck.
* Strong SQL.
* Basic programming skills in any language (Python is a plus).
* Comfort working as an individual contributor, directly with product teams, and through ambiguity.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem.
* Experience with streaming pipelines and logical replication, such as replicating Postgres into Databricks.
* Experience building RAG pipelines.
* AWS infrastructure experience.
* Platform administration experience: roles, permissions, access controls, and visibility management.

**Location**
------------

* San Francisco. We're an in-person team - 5 days in the office. At this stage, proximity genuinely accelerates product quality and team cohesion.

Compensation Range: $200K - $400K

**Who We Are:**

Lowenstein Sandler is a one of the most sophisticated law firms in the United States, with over 400 lawyers and 300 business services professionals serving clients from offices in New York, Palo Alto, Roseland, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., and Wilmington. We recruit candidates who seek a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that prioritizes our clients, our colleagues, and the communities where we work and live. Committed to career development and to an inclusive workplace, the firm offers many programs and opportunities for personal and professional growth. We seek professionals for our business services group who share these values.

**What You Will Do:**

The Data Engineer plays a central role within the Software Engineering team, responsible for building and maintaining the data pipelines that feed the firm's Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse. Working closely with the Data Architect, this role ingests, transforms, and curates data from the firm's core business systems through a medallion architecture to deliver trusted, analytics-ready datasets that power reporting, business intelligence, and AI-driven applications across the firm. This role requires an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is rigorous about data quality and governance, and actively integrates AI tooling into their development workflow.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, test, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from the firm's enterprise systems into the Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse, using Data Factory pipelines, and Spark notebooks.
* Implement and maintain the bronze, silver, and gold layers of the firm's medallion architecture, covering raw ingestion, cleansing and conformance, and curated analytics-ready models.
* Partner with the Data Architect to translate logical data models into physical implementations, including star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and Power BI semantic models in the gold layer.
* Build and maintain source-system integrations across Aderant Expert, Intapp, iManage, InterAction, Dayforce, SharePoint Online, and third-party APIs, applying incremental load and change data capture patterns and normalizing key entities to the SALI/LMSS taxonomy.
* Develop transformation logic in T-SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark, with built-in data quality validation, reconciliation to source, exception handling, and alerting.
* Diagnose and trace data discrepancies end-to-end — from source system through bronze, silver, and gold layers to the final DAX measure or report — identifying and resolving root causes.
* Monitor, tune, and optimize pipeline performance, refresh windows, and Fabric capacity consumption to control cost and meet business service levels.
* Implement data governance and security controls with the Data Architect and Information Security, including workspace permissions, row-level security, sensitivity labeling, and law firm confidentiality and ethical wall requirements.
* Partner with Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, practice groups, and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, and support business intelligence developers and self-service users with reliable, well-modeled, documented datasets.
* Manage data artifacts through source control and deployment pipelines, using Fabric Git integration and Azure DevOps to promote changes across development, test, and production workspaces.
* Leverage Claude Code and other AI-powered development tools to accelerate pipeline development, testing, and documentation, and build the curated datasets that power the firm's AI and agentic applications.
* Maintain data dictionaries, lineage, and operational runbooks, and provide production support and escalation-level troubleshooting for failed or degraded data loads.

* 3-5+ years of hands-on ETL/ELT or data engineering experience building and supporting production data pipelines.

* Strong T-SQL skills, with proven hands-on experience in MS SQL Server including query optimization and performance tuning.
* Proficiency in Python and PySpark, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on Spark-based transformation.
* Experience with incremental load, change data capture, and slowly changing dimension patterns.
* Experience ingesting data from REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, flat files, SFTP sources, and direct database connections.
* Rigorous approach to data quality, including validation, reconciliation, and alerting.
* Familiarity with source control (Git) and CI/CD practices for data artifacts.
* Experience building, maintaining, and supporting analytics models for reporting.
* Power BI development experience a plus, including semantic models, DAX, and report delivery.
* Ability to deliver high-quality work quickly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with a track record of managing competing priorities effectively.
* Willingness to adopt AI-assisted development tooling as part of a regular engineering workflow.

* Languages: T-SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL; KQL a plus.
* Architecture: medallion architecture, dimensional modeling and star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, Delta Lake and Parquet formats, partitioning.
* Integration: REST APIs, JSON, XML, flat file and SFTP ingestion, ODBC/JDBC, OAuth 2.0, change data capture.
* BI and Semantic Layer: Power BI, semantic models, DAX, row-level security.
* Cloud and Security: Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Key Vault, Microsoft Purview, data sensitivity labeling and classification.

* Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
* A continuous learner who actively tracks and experiments with emerging tools, especially in the data and AI space.

Grounded in integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we invest heavily in our team’s professional growth and technical advancement. We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Futrend is seeking a Mid-Level Full Stack & DevOps Engineer to support the National Library of Medicine (NLM) in developing, modernizing, and securing enterprise web applications. This position requires strong full-stack engineering capabilities across Python/Django, Java/Spring Boot, and Node.js, paired with DevOps skills that support automated, secure, AWS-based cloud environments.

The ideal candidate thrives in complex federal IT environments, can work across multiple programming languages, and understands how to build interoperable systems for NIH stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python (Django/FastAPI), Java (Spring Boot/Quarkus), and Node.js (Express/NestJS).

* Strong skills in Linux, networking fundamentals, observability, and performance troubleshooting.

* Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Redis, or message queues (SQS, SNS, Kafka).
* Advanced Kubernetes experience (Helm charts, operators) and/or service mesh (Istio).
* Experience with secrets management, security automation, and compliance tooling.
* Familiarity with NIH/NLM systems such as MedlinePlus, DOCLINE, or DiscoverWHR.

* Frontend: React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS/JavaScript
* Cloud: AWS (EC2, Lambda, CloudFront, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM)

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**About Fervo Energy**
----------------------

Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around-the-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Senior Cloud Engineer builds, automates, and operates Fervo's Azure-native cloud platform, turning architectural designs into repeatable, well-governed infrastructure. The role centers on infrastructure as code, GitHub-based delivery, self-service platform capabilities, and automated configuration of Linux and Windows systems. Success requires hands-on engineering, demonstrated coding ability, and the discipline to manage infrastructure through version-controlled, peer-reviewed practices rather than manual change.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

*Infrastructure as Code & Delivery*

* Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or Bicep) and reusable modules to provision Azure resources consistently across environments and sites.
* Build CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and enforce GitOps workflows where changes flow through version control, pull requests, and peer review.

*Platform Engineering & Self-Service*

* Build and iterate golden paths and self-service capabilities, with guardrails codified as policy to keep provisioning within security, cost, and tagging standards.
* Document platform capabilities so internal teams can consume them without one-to-one engineering support.

*Systems Configuration & Fleet Management*

* Manage Linux and Windows configuration through automation—Ansible and SUSE Manager (or equivalent) for Linux; Microsoft Intune and/or Group Policy for Windows—rather than manual, host-by-host changes.
* Maintain baseline images and standards so new hosts, including field and edge compute, are provisioned in a known, compliant state.

*Operations, Security & Compliance*

* Operate Azure landing zones and platform services within an Entra ID / Zero Trust model, with observability across monitoring, logging, alerting, and cost.
* Ensure changes flow through auditable pipelines supporting SOX ITGC, and apply NERC CIP-aligned controls where platform components support in-scope systems.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### ***Required***

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8 years in infrastructure support or engineering with demonstrated progression.
* 6+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure automation, or platform engineering.
* Production experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or Bicep), including reusable modules and state management.
* Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD or similar product.
* Demonstrated coding ability in Python and/or PowerShell, evidenced by repositories or work samples.
* Experience managing both Linux and Windows systems through automation (e.g., Ansible, Microsoft Intune and/or Group Policy).

### ***Preferred***

* Platform engineering experience: internal developer platforms, golden paths, and self-service provisioning.
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience; Azure remains the primary platform.
* SUSE Manager (or equivalent, such as Red Hat Satellite) and Microsoft Intune at scale.
* Policy-as-code (Azure Policy, Open Policy Agent) and secrets management (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault).
* Regulated-sector experience and familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or NERC CIP.
* Certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

**Location**
------------

Fervo Energy has offices in Houston, TX, Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. This position will be eligible for some hybrid work flexibility, but regular in-office presence at our Houston office will be required.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Medical, dental, and vision plan options
* Employer-paid basic life insurance and short-term and long-term disability coverage

* Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave
* Family-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot

* An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care
* Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo's Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as stock option grants and bonus opportunities for eligible roles

Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change.

title: Cyber Security Cloud Engineer
description:
Company Overview

NCS is a leading industrial products, services and technology company whose primary end-market is car wash operators. NCS provides a full suite of manufactured equipment, installation project services, aftermarket parts and services, chemicals (detergents, protectants, etc.), and software. More specifically with equipment, NCS provides tunnel equipment, IBA (In Bay Automatic), vacuums, dryers, water systems, doors, signage, arches, and related components. NCS also sells a range of brands – on both equipment, chemicals and software today – including Armor All, Rain-X, Blue Coral, TSS, VacuTech, NCS, AMP, etc. The company sells primarily in N. America, operates 6 manufacturing plants across N. America, and has ~1600+ employees. The Company operates numerous Distribution Centers and has sales/HQ offices across N. America, with its primary corporate offices in Des Moines, Iowa and Dallas, TX. NCS is currently owned by Berkshire Partners, a leading Boston-based PE firm

**We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not currently able to sponsor work visas.**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Cyber Security Cloud Engineer is the hands-on engineer responsible for implementing, operating, and maturing security controls across NCS's cloud environment, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and the enterprise SaaS platforms that run the business. NCS operates within an established set of NIST-based enterprise security requirements that define the controls, reporting cadences, and audit expectations for the business. This role implements the security controls that protect our cloud, SaaS, identity, workload, and data environments, and serves as the security lead for integrating newly acquired companies into the NCS security framework. As NCS invests in AI to transform how we serve customers and run the business, this engineer ensures those initiatives are deployed with the required safeguards in place. The engineer also partners with Product Engineering and DevOps teams to put required security controls into practice across the software development lifecycle for NCS products, connected equipment, and customer-facing platforms. The role works closely with Infrastructure, Networking, Data, Application Development, and business stakeholders, and provides security leadership with clear visibility into control status, gaps, and remediation progress. Success in this role means delivering required controls on schedule, demonstrating their effectiveness, and reducing enterprise risk without slowing the business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cloud Security Implementation & Operations**

* Implement and maintain security controls across Azure and AWS in accordance with NCS security requirements and the enterprise security framework, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection.

* Deploy and operate cloud security posture management (CSPM/CNAPP), infrastructure-as-code guardrails, policy-as-code, and automated compliance checks that enforce required baselines and provide continuous evidence of control effectiveness.

* Operate and tune cloud-native security services (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID Protection, AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, IAM Access Analyzer) and integrate cloud telemetry into enterprise SIEM detection and response workflows.

* Execute detection engineering and incident response for cloud-hosted and identity-centric threats, including alert triage, investigation, root cause analysis, containment, and remediation coordination with managed security providers, following established playbooks and escalation paths; track emerging cloud attack techniques and recommend updates to detections, hardening, and response procedures.

**Acquisition Integration & Migration**

* Support cybersecurity due diligence for acquisitions by executing technical assessments of target environments and documenting gaps against NCS security requirements to inform prioritized integration plans.

* Execute the secure integration and migration of acquired companies onto NCS platforms, including identity consolidation into Microsoft Entra ID, tenant-to-tenant Microsoft 365 migrations, workload migrations to Azure and AWS, network and endpoint onboarding, and decommissioning of legacy infrastructure.

* Maintain and follow repeatable, documented integration playbooks and security baselines that bring acquired entities to the required security standard within defined integration timelines, with status reporting throughout.

**DevOps & Product Security**

* Implement and operate required security controls across the CI/CD pipeline in partnership with Product Engineering and DevOps teams, including static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container image scanning, and software bill of materials (SBOM) generation, with risk-based gates that protect release velocity.

* Support secure product development for NCS software, connected equipment, and customer-facing platforms through threat modeling, secure design reviews, application of secure coding standards, API security, and vulnerability management, with particular attention to payment-enabled and field-deployed systems.

* Track product security metrics, maintain developer-facing documentation, and uphold remediation SLAs that give engineering teams clear, actionable ownership of security findings.

**Compliance, Reporting & Leadership**

* Implement the data protection, DLP, identity governance, and access controls required to securely enable approved AI initiatives, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and enterprise AI tooling, in partnership with Data, IT, and business teams.

* Maintain security controls across Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint (Windows and Apple), and cloud platforms in line with NCS security requirements; produce the evidence, metrics, and documentation needed for PCI-DSS compliance, NIST CSF alignment, internal and external audits, executive security reviews, and customer security assessments.

* Mentor engineers, serve as the escalation point for complex cloud and identity security issues, and report clearly on control status, gaps, risk, and remediation progress to technical and executive audiences.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5 or more years of progressive experience in IT, with broad exposure to infrastructure, networking, identity, and enterprise systems.

* 3 or more years of hands-on experience in a dedicated cybersecurity role, including securing production workloads in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.

* Demonstrated experience implementing security controls within an established enterprise security framework, including translating defined control requirements, audit findings, and assessment results into deployed, documented, and measurable controls.

* Hands-on implementation experience with cloud security services and patterns on at least one major platform (Azure or AWS) and solid familiarity with the other, including IAM, network security, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection.

* Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation), CI/CD platforms (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab), and application security tooling (SAST/DAST, SCA, secrets and container scanning), with a track record of partnering with development teams to embed security into the SDLC.

* Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and experience supporting PCI-DSS compliance and audit or assessment processes, including evidence collection and remediation tracking.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to report control status, gaps, and remediation progress to technical and non-technical audiences.

Cardiovascular care is often the #1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. Karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in America by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

**Job Description**

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

As our Senior Data Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining systems that ingest, process, and store vast amounts of data from internal systems and external partner systems. These data systems must be scalable, robust, and within budget. In this role, Senior Data Engineer will work with a variety of technologies that support the building of meaningful models, alerts, reports, and visualizations from vast quantities of data.
  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop & maintain new and existing data systems and pipelines, with a focus on reliability, testability and ease of use.
* Assist in cleansing, discretization, imputation, selection, generalization etc. to create high quality features for the modeling process
* Work with business stakeholders to define business requirements including KPI and acceptance criteria
* Use big data, relational and non-relational data sources, to access data at the appropriate level of granularity for the needs of specific analytical projects
* Maintain up to date knowledge of the relevant data set structures and participate in defining necessary upgrades and modifications
* Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of the data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture
* Ensure a consistent, diligent approach to peer review of code and configuration change within sensible, maintained repository structures and CI/CD pipelined deployment.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews, architectural discussions and team knowledge‑sharing sessions with peers and stakeholders.
* Make best use of our observability systems & advanced analytics to surface issues, drive diagnosis and develop fixes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a relevant field is required.
* 5+ years of experience in working with big data: ETL, pipeline building, analysis and code, with expertise in at least one programming language
* Experience implementing scalable, distributed, highly available, and resilient systems using industry standard data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, GCP, AWS, etc.)
* Skilled with using software repositories, CI/CD pipelines and test automation.
* Experience with data visualization tools and techniques
* Strong skills in data processing using SQL
* Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices for ensuring scalability and reliability in cloud environments.

title: Data Engineer

* Own the delivery and ongoing success of data products, ensuring they solve the intended business problem and remain reliable, usable, and maintainable in production.
* Build and maintain ELT pipelines across staging, intermediate, and mart layers using modular engineering practices, automated testing, and production-ready deployment processes.

* Establish risk-based data quality controls that validate critical business rules, detect upstream issues early, and prevent unreliable data from reaching consumers.
* Contribute to platform reliability by incorporating monitoring, alerting, automation, and operational support into delivered solutions.
* Participate in legacy platform migration, transitioning workloads to the modern data stack while preserving data integrity and business continuity.
* Strengthen team capability through code reviews, pairing, documentation, and reusable engineering patterns that improve consistency and reduce key-person dependencies.

* Hands-on experience building data pipelines in a cloud data warehouse environment.
* SQL skills and experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or Databricks.

* Working knowledge of cloud services and modern software engineering practices, including Git and CI/CD.
* Experience applying dimensional data modeling and translating business processes into scalable data structures.

* 3+ years of experience building data pipelines in a cloud data warehouse environment.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and solution quality.
* Experience integrating data across multiple ERPs or source systems, including entity resolution and reconciliation.
* Python experience supporting data engineering automation, orchestration, or data applications.
* Experience designing data products for analytics, AI/ML, or LLM consumption.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

title: Sr. AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.
  
  
As part of H1’s hiring process, all candidates are required to participate in an in-person final interview. Depending on your location, this may require travel.
  
  
H1's Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps team is responsible for building, automating, and optimizing the AWS infrastructure that powers our healthcare data platforms and applications. As H1 continues to scale globally, our team plays a critical role in enabling engineering teams to deploy and operate secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud environments.
  
  
**What You'll Do At H1**
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for designing, building, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure at scale. This role is primarily focused on cloud infrastructure engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and cost optimization, rather than traditional Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  
  
You'll partner closely with Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and other technical teams to provision new infrastructure, improve existing environments, automate manual processes, and support the evolving needs of H1's applications and data platforms.
  
  
You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to database infrastructure and operational support, helping improve our ability to troubleshoot and resolve database-related challenges across US-based projects.
  
  
You will:
  
  

* Design, build, and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices.
* Own infrastructure projects end-to-end, from technical design and provisioning through deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Build and maintain AWS environments leveraging IAM, S3, EKS, EMR, and supporting cloud services.
* Develop automation and self-service capabilities using Python and scripting to streamline infrastructure provisioning and reduce manual effort.
* Optimize AWS infrastructure costs through resource utilization analysis, cost dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI, partnering with engineering teams to support application and infrastructure deployments.
* Support infrastructure and database-related troubleshooting, collaborating with engineering and database teams to resolve issues and improve operational efficiency.

**About You**
You're a hands-on AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys building systems, solving complex technical challenges, and automating repetitive work. You have deep experience provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure through Terraform and are comfortable owning projects independently, from initial design through production deployment.
  
  
You understand how cloud infrastructure supports modern SaaS applications and large-scale data platforms, and you're motivated by finding ways to make environments more scalable, secure, efficient, and cost-effective.
  
  
You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where priorities evolve, take ownership of technical challenges, and bring a practical, solutions-oriented approach to your work.
  
  
You Bring:
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting production AWS infrastructure, rather than primarily focusing on monitoring or SRE functions.
* The ability to independently scope, design, and execute complex cloud infrastructure projects while balancing operational priorities.
* A strong automation mindset, with experience replacing manual infrastructure processes with repeatable, scalable solutions.
* Experience supporting containerized applications and cloud-native data platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across AWS infrastructure, networking, permissions, and deployment environments.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, data engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* A team-first mindset and commitment to contributing to an inclusive, supportive engineering culture.

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or DevOps, including 5+ years working extensively with AWS.
* Strong expertise designing, building, and managing AWS infrastructure, including IAM, S3, EKS (Kubernetes), and EMR.
* Advanced proficiency with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), infrastructure provisioning, and automation.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration in AWS environments.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using CircleCI.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Bash scripting to automate infrastructure workflows and reduce manual processes.
* Experience with AWS cost optimization, resource utilization, and cloud infrastructure security and networking.
* Experience supporting or troubleshooting production databases, ideally within AWS environments.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently own complex infrastructure projects and collaborate across engineering teams.

**Compensation**
This rolepays $120,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of RSUs.
  
  
Anticipated role close date: 11/25/2026
  
  
**H1 OFFERS**

* Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
* Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
* Retirement options
* Health & charitable donation stipends
* Impactful Business Resource Groups
* The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

H1 is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Platform Engineer — AWS Cloud
description:
Axiom Space is a human space exploration company, building era-defining space infrastructure and delivering technology-driven solutions that will empower civilization to transcend Earth. Beginning with Axiom Station, successor to the International Space Station, the company is pioneering a next-generation orbital settlement that will foster groundbreaking innovation and research in microgravity and drive the global space economy of tomorrow. Today, guided by the vision of leading humanity's expansion off planet, Axiom Space is the principal provider of commercial human spaceflight services and developer of advanced spacesuits for the Moon and beyond. For more information about Axiom Space, visit www.axiomspace.com.
  
  
Axiom Space fosters a work environment inclusive of all perspectives. We are the pioneers of commercial space, leading the transformation of low-Earth orbit into a global space marketplace. Our mission-driven team is seeking a bold and dynamic Platform Engineer (AWS Cloud) who is fueled by high accountability, execution horsepower, and driven to understand our world, science/technology, and life itself, for the benefit of all on Earth and beyond.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Since Axiom Space is a very complex work environment, we are looking for a resilient, high-energy Platform Engineer (AWS Cloud), who designs, builds, and operates the AWS-first cloud infrastructure that Axiom's engineering and business teams run on. This person drives automation, infrastructure-as-code, and platform reliability practices that let internal teams ship faster and safer, while maintaining working familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 to support occasional cross-platform workloads. This role serves as an escalation point for platform architecture and technical issues beyond the scope of entry-level engineers, and contributes to the continuous improvement of Axiom's enterprise cyber security program under the direction of senior IT leadership.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Designs, builds, and maintains infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) to provision and manage AWS GovCloud environments — accounts, networking (VPC), and compute — in a repeatable, version-controlled way via AWS Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA) based architecture
* Serves as the primary escalation point for AWS platform architecture, systems design, and technical issues beyond the scope of entry-level engineers
* Builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines (AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) that automate build, test, and deployment workflows for internal engineering teams
* Administers and evolves Axiom's AWS environment as the primary cloud platform — accounts, networking, compute, and core services (EC2, S3, and related)
* Builds and maintains container and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS) to support internal application workloads
* Manages identity and access management (IAM) within AWS IAM and supports SSO/SAML/SCIM integrations, ensuring least-privilege access across the platform
* Implements monitoring, logging, and observability (e.g., CloudWatch) to track platform health, and reviews incidents and performance data to determine root cause and drive remediation
* Preserves platform assets by implementing disaster recovery and backup automation, and develops, maintains, and tests business continuity plans for cloud environments
* Develops and maintains internal tooling and self-service capabilities that give engineering teams safe, automated access to the AWS platform
* Recommends cloud platform engineering strategies, tooling, and standards by evaluating organizational outcomes, identifying problems, and anticipating requirements
* May provide technical guidance to entry-level platform and IT engineers and review their AWS-related work as needed
* Maintains basic working familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 administration to support occasional cross-platform workloads
* Communicating project progress, status, and potential issues to stakeholders and leadership
* Implementing and maintaining agile project management methodologies throughout the project lifecycle
* Perform additional job duties as assigned

**Qualifications**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Education & Experience**

* The majority of that experience should be spent building and operating production workloads on AWS
* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Engineering Science, or Engineering Management, 4+ years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Track record of making things happen in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Uses good judgement to problem-solve proactively, positively impacting hard challenges
* Demonstrated organization skills to meet tight deadlines with high quality results

**Core Skills**

* Passion for space and the mission
* Entrepreneurial, growth mindset
* High EQ and ability to collaborate within teams and cross-functionally
* Tech-solutioning in using systems and tools to move smarter and faster

**Computer Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of:
  
  

* Strong AWS administration (IAM, VPC networking, EC2/compute, S3, and core services) as the primary cloud platform — deep, hands-on expertise expected
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible or equivalent)
* CI/CD pipeline experience (AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) and scripting proficiency in Python or Bash
* Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, or equivalent)
* Identity and access management (IAM): users, groups, roles, and least-privilege policy design within AWS
* Working knowledge of Azure Cloud administration (compute, networking, storage, governance) and Microsoft 365 (including SharePoint and OneDrive administration) sufficient to support occasional Azure-hosted workloads
* General server hardware familiarity (Windows and Linux), general IT security and firewall management, and backup administration experience
* Wired and wireless networking, DHCP, and DNS; virtualization via VMware or equivalent; patch management via Windows Update or third-party
* Storage administration (users, access controls, and content governance across cloud storage)

**Preferred Certifications**
Candidates holding one or more of the following are strongly preferred:
  
  

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate

**Core Competencies**
Embody our core values of
**leadership**
,
**innovation**
, and
**teamwork.**
In addition, to perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
  
  

* Accountability
* Technical Rigor
* Execution Discipline
* Pride of Delivery

**Work Environment**
Generally, an office environment, but can involve inside or outside work depending on the task
  
  
**Requirements**

* This position may require access to export controlled technical data or technology subject to NASA regulations, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). In accordance with U.S. export control laws, final candidates may be required to undergo additional export control screening to determine eligibility for access. Meeting these requirements is a condition of employment
* Management has the prerogative to select at any level for which the position is advertised
* Must be willing to work evenings and weekends as needed to meet critical project milestones

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Senior Data Engineer**

**Salary - $****125,000 (Chicago)**

**About Retail Insight**

At Retail Insight, we're transforming the way some of the world's biggest retailers and CPG brands use data, analytics and technology to make smarter decisions.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We bring together talented people with different experiences, perspectives and expertise to solve complex problems, challenge the status quo and make a real impact for our clients.

We're growing, and we're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Engineering team.

**About the role**

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to build and support the reliable, scalable data systems that power our solutions for US retail clients.

As our US client portfolio grows, you'll work with complex data environments, helping translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. Working closely with our Chicago-based Lead Data Engineer, alongside data scientists, analysts and product teams, you'll build data pipelines and products that help our clients make better decisions.

This is a hands-on role combining strong technical skills with collaboration and clear communication. You'll contribute to the evolution of our data platform, improve reliability and performance, and help maintain high engineering standards.

You'll also work with colleagues and client stakeholders to understand their needs and support successful delivery.

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, developing and optimising batch and streaming workflows for reliability and performance.
* Contributing to the design and implementation of data architecture.
* Implementing data quality checks, monitoring and observability across pipelines.
* Applying security, access control and governance standards established by our platform team.
* Collaborating with data scientists and analysts to deliver data products that support their work.
* Working with the Lead Data Engineer to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Participating in code reviews, setting a high bar for engineering quality and contributing to team standards.
* Helping identify opportunities to optimise cloud costs and platform performance.
* Contributing to platform documentation, tooling choices and continuous improvement.

  

**What we’re looking for**

  

* Solid, demonstrable experience in data engineering, including building and maintaining production-grade Databricks pipelines.
* Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with a good understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT patterns and distributed data processing.
* Experience with Azure data platforms, including Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2 and Azure DevOps, or equivalent services on AWS or GCP.
* Experience implementing data quality checks and pipeline monitoring.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues.
* A collaborative approach, ownership of quality outcomes and a drive to learn and improve.
* A degree in computer science, data engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Willingness to travel as required.

  

**Bonus points if you also have**

  

* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.
* Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation frameworks.
* Exposure to real-time streaming technologies such as Kafka or Event Hubs.
* Exposure to retail or consumer packaged goods (CPG) data, such as point of sale, inventory or supply chain.
* Experience working directly with clients.

**Some of our extras...**

We believe in flexibility, growth, and taking care of our people, both in and out of the office.

**Hybrid & Flexible Working:** Work from anywhere benefits, plus summer hours and extra days off for life’s big moments (including your birthday and wedding).

**Generous Time Off:** 26 days PTO (accrued with service), paid volunteer days, and full support for your wellbeing, including mental health resources.

**Career & Learning:** Access to a top-tier learning platform, career progression plans, and support to create your ideal home workspace.

**Health & Financial Benefits:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 6% matched retirement plan.

**Personal Perks:** Annual phone reimbursement, onsite gym access, and customizable benefits via our online platform.

Plus much more!

**Our Interview Process**

Our interview process may vary slightly depending on the role. We’ll always let you know what to expect at each stage and give you plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way.

**People Team Introduction and Cultural Drivers Interview**

An initial conversation with a member of our People Team to learn more about you, your experience and what you’re looking for in your next role. We’ll also introduce you to Retail Insight and explain the opportunity and interview process. During the call, we’ll ask interview questions based on our cultural drivers to understand how your values, behaviours and ways of working align with ours.

**Role and Technical Interview**

This stage explores your experience and the skills most relevant to the role, as well as how you approach your work. Depending on the position, it may include a practical task, presentation or technical assessment. We’ll always explain what’s involved in advance.

**Senior Leadership Coffee Chat**

The final stage is an informal coffee chat with a member of our senior leadership team. It’s an opportunity to learn more about our business and culture, ask any remaining questions and make sure Retail Insight feels like the right fit for you.

***Be your authentic self*** *- Retail Insight is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. All employees and any job applicants will receive equal treatment. We actively seek to create an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and encouraged to contribute their best work.*

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

RDG (Risk Decision Group) provides nationwide background investigations compliant with national government standards to include support of continuous vetting for over 110 government agencies.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is looking for a **Data Architecture, Lead Associate.**

  

This work is **100% remote.**

  

This role builds and extends a greenfield data and AI platform supporting federal background investigation work. Working alongside the platform's lead engineer, you'll develop and maintain the pipelines, transformations, and data products that move the platform forward — growing your ownership as the platform matures. This is hands-on engineering in a high-trust environment where FedRAMP Moderate, NIST 800-171, and CUI handling shape how the work is built.

Active clearance preferred; candidates able to obtain one encouraged to apply.

* Build, test, and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline code that turns raw and synthetic data into governed, analysis-ready data products.

* Collaborate closely with the engineering team and maintain clear documentation of pipelines and processes.

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a T5/SSBI federally adjudicated clearance; active clearance preferred.
* 4 years building and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Hands-on ETL / data pipeline development and sound analytical data modeling.
* Working familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP fine) and version control / CI/CD workflows.
* Solid analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks experience (or a comparable lakehouse stack: Spark, Delta, dbt, Snowflake).

* Experience in regulated or accredited environments: FedRAMP, NIST 800-171, CMMC, or CUI handling.
* Active security clearance (T5/SSBI or higher).
* Government or defense contracting experience.
* Familiarity with data governance / cataloging tooling (e.g., Unity
* Catalog) and orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt).

**Soft Skills**

* Dependable, self-directed execution with minimal oversight.
* Strong collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.
* Clear documentation and knowledge-sharing.
* Eagerness to grow ownership and learn the compliance environment.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
**Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.**  
  
**This role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will design, build, and implement reusable analytics products and assets that meet client needs and extend our Human Capital service offerings.**  
  
**Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.**  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
**The Data Engineer Consultant will support data architecture and engineering delivery that enables artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and generative AI (GenAI) solutions, ensuring data is trusted, secure, observable, and scalable from ingestion through consumption. You will design and operationalize modern data and retrieval foundations to support large language model (LLM)-powered applications (e.g., Claude, GPT/Codex, Gemini) including patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and governed access to structured and unstructured data and work directly with Human Capital product managers and clients to design and deliver data-driven workforce and human capital analytics solutions, owning end-to-end solutions from data modeling to stakeholder presentations. You will build dashboards, reports, and reusable analytics products, turning complex human capital data into clear, actionable insights. You will be part of a blended onshore/offshore delivery team, partnering with data science, ML engineering, and product stakeholders to translate use cases into production-ready pipelines and platforms with strong data governance, lineage, quality controls, and monitoring.**  

* **Lead the design, development, and delivery of analytics solutions that address complex workforce and human capital challenges for clients across industries.**
* **Build and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks using Structured Query Language (SQL) and Tableau (or equivalent visualization platforms).**
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches, communicating findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.**
* **Collaborate across service lines to embed AI-enabled capabilities and emerging data methodologies into client solutions.**
* **Support business development efforts including proposals, client presentations, and thought leadership content.**
* **Design and deliver intuitive, executive-ready reports and dashboards that make complex workforce data accessible and actionable.**

  
**A successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **Effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **Ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **Ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **Ability to meet deadlines**
* **Ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**The team**  
  
**HC Forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of Human Capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply AI, data, and engineering to modernize HR experiences and outcomes.**  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* **Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science)**
* **2+ years of experience in data science, data engineering, or analytics.**
* **2+ years of modern data & AI engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, and feature engineering/serving fundamentals.**
* **1+ years of experience with machine learning concepts, large language model applications, or AI-augmented analytics workflows.**
* **2+ years of experience using Python or R for statistical modeling and data wrangling, including proficiency in Databricks or Snowflake.**
* **Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.**
* **Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.**

  
**Preferred:**  

* **Advanced degree, including a Master of Science (MS) or Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), and/or relevant certifications.**
* **Direct experience in client-facing or consulting environments, with Human Capital platforms and integrations (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM), Salesforce), or in Human Resources (HR) data domains.**
* **Experience operationalizing large language model operations (LLMOps) and machine learning operations (MLOps) capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management.**
* **Cloud experience on one or more of Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including managed data platforms and scalable compute patterns.**
* **Experience explaining complex data and technology concepts, articulating risks and trade-offs, documenting decisions, and collaborating across product, data science/ML, data engineering, platform, and security teams.**
* **Experience in analytics product development-building repeatable tools, models, or platforms rather than one-off deliverables-and ethics and privacy practices, including recognizing consent, personally identifiable information (PII), and bias boundaries and escalating appropriately.**

  
**The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.**  
  
**You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.**

title: Data Engineer/ Systems Integration Engineer
description:

This position is responsible for building scalable data pipelines, data lakes, and integration frameworks that connect disparate systems into a unified information environment. Working alongside military operators, Government stakeholders, and engineering teams, the successful candidate will develop secure, reliable data solutions that improve information accessibility, accelerate decision-making, and support rapid capability development.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

You will be the connective tissue between development and operations — accelerating delivery pipelines, strengthening cloud infrastructure, and ensuring the reliability of critical healthcare systems.

* Enforce security best practices — secrets management, IAM policies, vulnerability scanning, and HIPAA compliance controls

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
Description:

**About the Role**

As a DevOps Engineer II, you will take ownership of the architecture, strategy, and reliability of our automated deployment pipelines and infrastructure, driving operational excellence across the organization. Building on a strong foundation of DevOps execution, you will design scalable, secure infrastructure solutions, set technical standards for CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices, and lead the resolution of complex production issues. You will act as a technical leader within the DevOps function, mentoring DevOps Engineer I team members and partnering closely with development, QA, and security teams to shape how systems are built, deployed, and operated.

Your work will directly influence the organization's infrastructure strategy — from evaluating and selecting new tools and platforms to designing disaster recovery and capacity plans that keep systems resilient at scale. You will be expected to anticipate operational risk before it becomes an incident, drive continuous improvement in deployment velocity and system reliability, and translate infrastructure decisions into business impact for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. While DevOps Engineer I focuses on building and maintaining well-defined pipelines and infrastructure, this role owns the design decisions, standards, and technical direction that guide the broader team's work.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect and drive the technical strategy for CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code practices, and deployment automation across teams
* Design scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions, including disaster recovery and capacity planning
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for critical production issues, driving long-term remediation rather than short-term fixes
* Set and enforce standards, best practices, and documentation for infrastructure, security, and deployment processes across the DevOps function
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to DevOps Engineer I team members, including code/config reviews and skill development
* Evaluate, select, and integrate new tools, platforms, and technologies to improve reliability, security, and delivery velocity
* Partner with security teams to define and implement DevSecOps standards across pipelines and infrastructure
* Collaborate with engineering and product leadership to align infrastructure strategy with business priorities
* Drive cost optimization and efficiency initiatives across cloud infrastructure
* Serve as an escalation point and technical authority during high-severity production incidents, including on-call rotations

**Skills**

In this role, your ability to architect infrastructure and pipeline strategy — not just implement it — will differentiate your daily work from earlier-career DevOps roles. Your deep expertise with cloud platforms and infrastructure-as-code will enable you to design systems that scale reliably under changing demands, while your command of containerization and orchestration will guide how the broader team structures microservice deployments. Your judgment in security and observability will shape how the organization detects and prevents issues rather than simply reacting to them. Equally important are your leadership and mentorship skills, as you will be relied upon to raise the technical bar for the DevOps team and to represent the function in cross-team strategic discussions.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, system administration, or infrastructure automation, including experience designing infrastructure solutions rather than solely implementing predefined specifications
* Demonstrated experience architecting and implementing CI/CD pipeline strategy (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions) across multiple teams or products
* Advanced proficiency with Linux/Unix operating systems and scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell
* Demonstrated experience designing and provisioning cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or Bicep) at a system/architecture level
* Advanced experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), including designing microservice deployment strategies
* Strong understanding of networking, security, and system monitoring concepts, with experience defining monitoring/alerting strategy rather than just responding to alerts
* Experience leading or owning incident response and root cause analysis for production systems
* US Citizenship, ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or equivalent advanced-level certification
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to junior DevOps or infrastructure engineers
* Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef at scale
* Experience with database management, optimization, and infrastructure cost optimization (FinOps)
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments in a technical leadership capacity
* Advanced experience with logging and monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog, or Splunk, including designing observability strategy
* Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer

Remote [within the US]

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to take ownership of deploying, managing, and evolving our multi-prem platform architecture across diverse customer environments, from bare-metal data centers to commercial and IL5, IL6, and IL6+ environments. You'll play a critical role in bridging our continuously deployed SaaS platform with shrink-wrapped customer-hosted releases, ensuring alignment, consistency, and operational excellence across all footprints. This is a deeply technical role that sits at the intersection of infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, and secure automation, ideal for engineers who thrive in complex, regulated, and hybrid environments.

**WHO WE ARE:**

HiddenLayer protects the world's most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead deployment and lifecycle management of our multi-prem platform across commercial cloud, bare-metal, air-gapped, and IL4+ environments.
* Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, etc.) to automate consistent deployments across customer sites.
* Ensure our customer-hosted builds ("shrink-wrapped" software) remain closely aligned with our continuously deployed SaaS platform.
* Maintain and optimize Kubernetes clusters and container build pipelines (EKS, K0s, AKS, or on-prem distributions).
* Implement secure and reproducible container image build pipelines, aligned with our internal release processes.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to harden deployments for regulated, classified, and air-gapped customer systems.
* Document and version deployment patterns, templates, and procedures to support both automation and accreditation workflows.
* Support incident response, troubleshooting, and upgrade cycles across multiple platform footprints.
* Contribute to the overall architecture and evolution of the multi-prem reference design, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security parity with SaaS.

**WHO YOU ARE (REQUIRED):**

* U.S. Citizen (required) and eligible for U.S. Government clearance (Secret or higher preferred).
* Proven success deploying and operating complex systems across multi-cloud and on-prem environments.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, container pipelines, and infrastructure automation (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD).
* Strong foundation in networking concepts: DNS, routing, VPC design, VPNs, firewalls, and service meshes.
* Proficient with secure CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
* Experience maintaining Linux systems, observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenSearch), and automation tooling.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, DoD SRG, or NIST 800-53.

* Experience deploying workloads into AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or other regulated cloud environments.
* Experience deploying and maintaining software in classified, air-gapped, or disconnected environments.

* **Flexible Time Off:** Enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to 15 paid company holidays.
